examples.chinese: 这家新开的咖啡馆挨着一家老字号书店，两家店铺的风格形成了有趣的对比。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xīnkāi de kāfēiguǎn āizhe yī jiā lǎozìhào shūdiàn, liǎng jiā diàpù de fēngggé xíngchéngle yǒuqù de duìbǐ.
examples.english: This newly opened coffee shop is located next to an old-established bookstore, and the contrasting styles of the two shops create an interesting comparison.

examples.chinese: 学生们挨个走进了考场，每个人都显得很紧张。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēngmen āigè zǒujìnle kǎochǎng, měi ge rén dōu xiǎnde hěn jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The students entered the examination hall one by one, and each person looked very nervous.

examples.chinese: 由于最近的安全形势，机场加强了安检措施，所有乘客都要接受更严格的检查。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú zuìjìn de ānquán xíngshì, jīchǎng jiāqiáng le ānjiǎn cuòshī, suǒyǒu chéngkè dōu yào jiēshòu gèng yánggé de jiǎnchá.
examples.english: Due to the recent security situation, the airport has strengthened its safety check procedures, and all passengers must undergo more rigorous inspections.

examples.chinese: 工人们因为工资没有提高而决定罢工，这次罢工持续了两周才得到解决。
examples.pinyin: Gōngrénmen yīnwèi gōngzī méiyǒu tígāo érjué dìng bàgōng, zhè cì bàgōng chíxùle liǎng zhōu cái dé到dào jiějué.
examples.english: The workers decided to go on strike because their wages weren't increased, and this strike lasted two weeks before it was resolved.

examples.chinese: 那个小偷在警察局挨打了一顿，这是他应得的下场。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu zài jǐngchájú ái dǎ le yī dùn, zhè shì tā yīngde de xiàchǎng.
examples.english: That thief took a beating at the police station, which was what he deserved.

examples.chinese: 随着经济的发展，越来越多的白领选择远程工作以获得更好的工作生活平衡。
examples.pinyin: Suí着jīngjì de fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de báilǐng xuǎnzé yuǎnchéng gōngzuò yǐ huòdé gèng hǎo de gōngzuò shēnghuó pínghéng.
examples.english: With economic development, more and more white-collar workers are choosing remote work to achieve a better work-life balance.

examples.chinese: 为了提高办公效率，公司决定引入新的管理系统。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo bàngōng xiàoxiàolǜ, gōngsī juéding yǐnrù xīn de guǎnlǐ xìtǒng.
examples.english: In order to improve office work efficiency, the company decided to introduce a new management system.

examples.chinese: 今年的失业率下降了两个百分点，这是过去五年来最显著的改善。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de shīyè lǜ xiàjiàng le liǎng ge bǎifēndiǎn, zhè shì guòqù wǔ nián lái zuì xiǎnzhù de gǎish善。
examples.english: This year's unemployment rate dropped by two percentage points, which is the most significant improvement in the past five years.

examples.chinese: 这所大学坚持以学生为中心的办学理念，已经培养了数万名优秀毕业生。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué jiānchí yǐ xuésheng wéi zhōngxīn de bànxué lǐniàn, yǐjīng péiyǎngle shùwàn míng yōuxiù bìyèsheng.
examples.english: This university adheres to a student-centered philosophy of running the school and has already cultivated tens of thousands of excellent graduates.

examples.chinese: 我们公司在北京设立了一个新的办事处，以便更好地服务华北地区的客户。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī zài Běijīng shèlì le yīgè xīn de bànshìchù, yǐbiàn gèng hǎo de fúwù huá běi dìqū de kèhù.
examples.english: Our company has established a new office in Beijing in order to better serve customers in the North China region.

examples.chinese: 我们的队伍在半决赛中表现得非常出色，最终赢得了进入决赛的机会。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de duìwǔ zài bànjuésài zhōng biǎoxiàn de fēicháng chūcsè, zuìzhōng yíngdé le jìnrù juésài de jīhuì.
examples.english: Our team performed exceptionally well in the semifinals and ultimately won the opportunity to enter the finals.

english: particle: elucidating a previous proposition so as to diminish its effect

examples.chinese: 他不过是想引起大家的注意罢了，没有其他的目的。
examples.pinyin: Tā búguò shì xiǎng yǐnqǐ dàjiā de zhùyì罢le, méiyǒu qítā de mùdì.
examples.english: He merely wanted to attract everyone's attention, that's all; he had no other purpose.

examples.chinese: 随着互联网的发展，越来越多的人开始通过网络获取信息，而传统报刊的发行量也随之下降。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe hùliánwǎng de fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de rén kāishǐ tōngguò wǎngluò huòqǔ xìnxī, érjiǔ chuántǒng bàokān de fāxíngliàng yě suízhī xiàjiàng.
examples.english: As the internet develops, more and more people have begun obtaining information through online sources, while the circulation of traditional newspapers and periodicals has consequently declined.

examples.chinese: 傍晚时分，夕阳西下，整个城市被染成了金黄色，行人们匆匆赶往各自的目的地。
examples.pinyin: bàngwǎn shífen, xīyáng xīxià, zhěnggè chéngshì bèi rǎnchéngle jīnhuángsè, xíngrénmen qiāngqiāng gǎnwǎng gèzì de mùdìdì.
examples.english: In the evening, as the sun sets in the west, the entire city is dyed in golden hues, and pedestrians hurry towards their respective destinations.

examples.chinese: 昨晚的暴风雨来得很突然，导致整个城市停电了几个小时。
examples.pinyin: Zuówan de bàofēngyǔ lái de hěn túrán, dǎozhì zhěnggè chéngshì tíngdiàn le jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: The rainstorm last night came very suddenly, causing the entire city to lose power for several hours.

examples.chinese: 我为之前的失误表示抱歉，希望这不会影响我们的合作关系。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wèi zhīqián de shīwù biǎoshì bàoqiàn, xīwàng zhè búhuì yǐngxiǎng wǒmen de hézuò guānxi.
examples.english: I apologize for my previous mistake, and I hope it won't affect our working relationship.

examples.chinese: 这次调查最终暴露了他多年来的贪污行为。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì diàochá zuìzhōng bàolù le tā duō nián lái de tānwū xíngwéi.
examples.english: This investigation ultimately unmasked his years of corrupt behavior.

examples.chinese: 她决定报考研究生，以便能够在这个竞争激烈的社会中获得更多的机会。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédìng bàokǎo yánjiūshēng, yǐbiàn nénggoù zài zhège jìngjìng jīliè de shèhuì zhōng huòdé gèngduō de jīhuì.
examples.english: She decided to enter herself for graduate school in order to gain more opportunities in this highly competitive society.

examples.chinese: 这个丑闻在网络上爆红后，公众舆论瞬间转向。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chǒu wén zài wǎngluò shàng bào hóng hòu, gōngzhòng yúlùn shùnjiān zhuǎn xiàng.
examples.english: After this scandal went viral on the internet, public opinion shifted instantly.

examples.chinese: 昨天的暴雨导致了几条主要道路的积水，交通受到了严重影响。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān de bàoyǔ dǎozhì le jǐ tiáo zhǔyào dàolù de jīshuǐ, jiāotōng shòudào le yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Yesterday's torrential rain caused waterlogging on several main roads, which severely affected traffic.

examples.chinese: 这次恐怖袭击导致了市中心的一座建筑物爆炸，造成了大量人员伤亡。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǒngbù xíjī dǎozhìle shì zhōngxīn de yī zuò jiànzhùwù bàozhà, zàochéngle dàliàng rényuán shāngyáng.
examples.english: This terrorist attack resulted in an explosion of a building in the city center, causing a large number of casualties.

examples.chinese: 电影中过度的暴力场景可能会对青少年的心理发展造成负面影响。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng zhōng guòdù de bàolì chǎngjǐng kěnéng huì duì qīngshàonián de xīnlǐ fāzhǎn zàochéng fùmiàn yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Excessive violent scenes in movies may have negative effects on the psychological development of adolescents.

examples.chinese: 那场灾难导致了许多人失去了家园，这是一个悲惨的事件，至今仍令人感到心痛。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng zāinàn dǎozhì le xǔduō rén shīqù le jiāyuán, zhè shì yī gè bēicǎn de shìjiàn, zhìjīn réng lìng rén gǎndào xīntòng.
examples.english: That disaster caused many people to lose their homes, which was a tragic event that still breaks people's hearts to this day.

examples.chinese: 这场疫情突然爆发，导致许多企业面临前所未有的挑战。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yìqíng túrán bàofā, dǎozhì xǔduō qǐyè miànlín qiánsuǒ wèiyǒu de tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: This epidemic suddenly erupted, causing many enterprises to face unprecedented challenges.

examples.chinese: 他背着沉重的责任继续前进，即使前路充满了挑战。
examples.pinyin: Tā bēizhe chènzhòng de zérèn jìxù qiángjìn, jíshǐ qiánlù chōngmǎn le tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: He carried the heavy responsibility forward, even though the road ahead was full of challenges.

examples.chinese: 在这个炎热的夏天，穿一件轻薄的背心比穿厚重的衬衫舒服得多。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège yánrè de xiàtiān, chuān yī jiàn qīngbáo de bèixīn bǐ chuān hòuzhòng de chènshān shūfu de duō.
examples.english: On this scorching summer day, wearing a lightweight vest is much more comfortable than wearing a heavy shirt.

examples.chinese: 本次会议的主要目的是讨论公司的发展战略。
examples.pinyin: běn cì huìyì de zhǔyào mùdì shì tǎolùn gōngsī de fāzhǎn zhànlüè。
examples.english: The main purpose of this conference is to discuss the company's development strategy.

examples.chinese: 看到危险迫近，那群羚羊开始奔跑逃离捕食者的追击。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào wēixiǎn pòjìn, nàqún língyáng kāishǐ bēnpǎo táolí bǔshízhě de zhuījī.
examples.english: Seeing danger approaching, the herd of antelopes began to run away from the predator's pursuit.

examples.chinese: 法庭上，被告辩称自己并未违反租赁合同的条款。
examples.pinyin: Fǎtíng shang, bèigào biànchèn zìjǐ bìngwèi wéifǎn zūlìn hétonng de tiáokuǎn.
examples.english: In court, the defendant (tenant) argued that he did not violate the terms of the lease agreement.

examples.chinese: 本期业绩未能达到预期目标，公司管理层已经开始反思战略调整的必要性。
examples.pinyin: Běnqī yèjī wèi néng dádào yùqī mùbiāo, gōngsī guǎnlǐ céng yǐjīng kāishǐ fǎnsiǎo zhànlüè tiáozhěng de bìyàoxìng.
examples.english: The company's performance this period failed to meet expected targets, and the management has already begun to reflect on the necessity of strategic adjustments.

examples.chinese: 这个问题本身就很复杂，不能用简单的答案来解决。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí běnshēn jiù hěn fùzá, búnéng yòng jiǎndān de dáàn lái jiějué.
examples.english: This problem is inherently complex and cannot be solved with a simple answer.

examples.chinese: 无论外表如何改变，这个组织的本质仍然是追求利益最大化。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn wàibiǎo rúhé gǎibiàn, zhège zǔzhī de běnzhì仍然 shì zhuīqiú lìyì zuìdàhuà.
examples.english: No matter how the appearance changes, the essential nature of this organization remains the pursuit of maximum profit.

examples.chinese: 随着经济全球化的推进，本土企业需要加强创新能力才能在国际竞争中立足。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì quánqiú huà de tuījìn, běntǔ qǐyè xūyào jiāqiáng chuàngxīn nénghuà cáinéng zài guójì jìngjìng zhōng lìzú.
examples.english: As economic globalization advances, domestic enterprises need to strengthen their innovation capabilities to establish a foothold in international competition.

examples.chinese: 他们用各种手段逼迫我签署这份合同，但我坚决拒绝了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yòng gèzhǒng shǒuduàn bīpò wǒ qiānshǔ zhè fèn héitóng, dàn wǒ jiānjué jùjuéle.
examples.english: They used various means to coerce me into signing this contract, but I firmly refused.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅虽然装修得很现代，但菜品都是用本地食材制作的，很受欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cānting suīrán zhuāngxiū de hěn xiàndài, dàn càipǐn dōu shì yòng běndì shícái zhìzuò de, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Although this restaurant has modern decoration, all of its dishes are made with local ingredients, which makes it quite popular.

examples.chinese: 随着科技的发展，人工智能必将改变我们的生活方式。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de fāzhǎn, rénggōng zhìnéng bìjiāng gǎibiàn wǒmen de shēnghuó fāngshì.
examples.english: With the development of technology, artificial intelligence will inevitably change our way of life.

examples.chinese: 这次公务员考试的笔试成绩已经公布，我终于松了一口气。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì gōngwùyuán kǎoshì de bǐshì chéngjī yǐjīng gōngbù, wǒ终于 sōngle yī kǒu qì.
examples.english: The written examination results for this civil service exam have been announced, and I finally feel relieved.

examples.chinese: 这个小镇位于城市的边缘，却保留了最原始的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎozhèn wèiyú chéngshì de biānyuán, què bǎoliúle zuì yuánshǐ de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: This small town, located on the margin of the city, has preserved the most authentic cultural characteristics.

examples.chinese: 数学是所有理科学生的必修课程，无论你将来从事什么工作。
examples.pinyin: Shùxué shì suǒyǒu lǐkē xuésheng de bìxiū kèchéng, wúlùn nǐ jiānglái cóngshì shénme gōngzuò.
examples.english: Mathematics is a required course for all science students, regardless of what career you pursue in the future.

examples.chinese: 这家公司因为经营不善而被迫闭店，员工们都失业了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yīnwèi jīngyíng búshàn érbeì pòbì diàn, yuángōngmen dōu shīyè le.
examples.english: This company was forced to shut down due to poor management, and all the employees lost their jobs.

examples.chinese: 扁先生是我们公司的新任财务总监，他在金融领域有着丰富的经验。
examples.pinyin: Biǎn xiānsheng shì wǒmen gōngsī de xīnrèn cáiwù zǒngjīan, tā zài jīnróng lǐngyù yǒuzhе fēngfù de jīngyàn.
examples.english: Mr. Pian is our company's new Chief Financial Officer, and he has extensive experience in the financial field.

examples.chinese: 公司最近根据发展需要调整了编制，增加了市场部的人员配置。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zuìjìn gēnjù fāzhǎn xūyào tiáozhěngle biānzhì, zēngjiāle shìchǎngbù de rényuán pèizhì.
examples.english: The company recently adjusted its authorized staff according to development needs and increased the personnel allocation for the marketing department.

examples.chinese: 由于市场环境的变化，公司决定变更原来的发展战略。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú shìchǎng huánjìng de biànhuà, gōngsī juéding biàngēng yuánlái de fāzhǎn zhànlüè.
examples.english: Due to changes in the market environment, the company decided to change its original development strategy.

examples.chinese: 长期暴露在高温下会导致这种材料发生变形，从而影响其使用寿命。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī bàolù zài gāowēn xià huì dǎozhì zhè zhǒng cáiliào fāshēng biànxíng, cóngér yǐngxiǎng qì shǐyòng shòumìng.
examples.english: Prolonged exposure to high temperatures will cause this material to undergo deformation, thereby affecting its lifespan.

examples.chinese: 随着时代的发展，人们的消费观念也在不断变换。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe shídài de fāzhǎn, rénmen de xiāofèi guāinián yě zài búduàn biànhuàn.
examples.english: As times develop, people's consumption concepts are also constantly transforming.

examples.chinese: 即便是最聪明的人，也难免会犯错误。
examples.pinyin: Jíbiàn shì zuì cōngmíng de rén, yě nánmiǎn huì犯 cuòwù.
examples.english: Even the smartest people inevitably make mistakes.

examples.chinese: 他便在那时决定了要出国留学，如今已经是一名成功的工程师了。
examples.pinyin: Tā biàn zài nàshí juédìng le yào chūguó liúxué, rújīn yǐjīng shì yī míng chénggōng de gōngchéngshī le.
examples.english: As early as that time, he decided to study abroad, and by now he has already become a successful engineer.

examples.chinese: 经济危机爆发后，失业者遍地都是，社会矛盾日益尖锐。
examples.pinyin: Jīngjì wēijī爆fā hòu, shīyè zhě biàndì dōu shì, shèhuì máodùn rìyì jiānruì.
examples.english: After the economic crisis broke out, unemployed people were everywhere, and social contradictions became increasingly acute.

examples.chinese: 表面上他同意了这个计划，但实际上他心里还是有顾虑的。
examples.pinyin: Biǎomiànshang tā tóngyìle zhège jìhuà, dàn shíjìshang tā xīnli háishi yǒu gùlǜ de.
examples.english: On the surface, he agreed to this plan, but in reality, he still has reservations about it.

examples.chinese: 医生根据最新的检查结果详细向家属说明了患者的病情，并制定了进一步的治疗方案。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng gēnjù zuìxīn de jiǎnchá jiéguǒ xiáng细 xiàng jiāshǔ shuōmíng le huànzhě de bìngqíng, bìng zhìdìng le jìnybù de zhìliáo fāng'àn.
examples.english: The doctor explained the patient's condition in detail to the family members based on the latest examination results, and formulated a further treatment plan.

examples.chinese: 如果遇到紧急情况，请立即拨打报警电话。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ遇dào jǐnjí qíngkuàng, qǐng lìjí bōdǎ bàojǐng diànhuà.
examples.english: If you encounter an emergency situation, please call the police number immediately.

examples.chinese: 医生每天都要巡视各个病房，了解患者的恢复情况。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng měi tiān dōu yào xúnshì gè gè bìngfáng, liǎojiě huànzhě de huīfù qíngkuàng.
examples.english: The doctor has to make rounds through each sickroom every day to understand the patients' recovery progress.

examples.chinese: 站在海边，我被汹涌的波浪声所吸引，仿佛能听到大海深处的呼唤。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài hǎibiān, wǒ bèi xiōngyǒng de bōlàng shēng suǒ xīyǐn, fǎngfó néng tīngdào dàhǎi shēnchǔ de hūzhào.
examples.english: Standing by the seaside, I was drawn in by the sound of the surging waves, as if I could hear the call from the depths of the ocean.

examples.chinese: 这部纪录片在电视上播出后，引起了社会各界的广泛讨论。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn zài diànshìshang bōchūle, yǐnqǐle shèhuì gèjiè de guǎngfàn tǎolùn.
examples.english: After this documentary aired on television, it sparked widespread discussion across various sectors of society.

examples.chinese: 由于国际油价的波动，许多企业都在调整他们的成本预算。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú guójì yóujià de bōdòng, xǔduō qǐyè dōu zài tiáozhěng tāmen de chéngběn yùsuàn.
examples.english: Due to fluctuations in international oil prices, many enterprises are adjusting their cost budgets.

examples.chinese: 这些年来，他为了事业忙得不见人影，家人们都很担心他的身体。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē niánlái, tā wèile shìyè máng de bújiàn rényǐng, jiārénmen dōu hěn dānxīn tā de shēntǐ.
examples.english: Over the years, he has been so busy with work that he is hardly ever seen, and his family members are all very worried about his health.

examples.chinese: 由于疫情的影响，许多人在出行时感到不便，但我们必须为了公共卫生而做出这些牺牲。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yìqíng de yǐngxiǎng, xǔduō rén zài chūxíng shí gǎndào bùbiàn, dàn wǒmen bìxū wèile gōngzhòng wèishēng érzuò chūchū zhèxiē xīshēng.
examples.english: Due to the impact of the pandemic, many people feel inconvenienced when traveling, but we must make these sacrifices for public health.

examples.chinese: 自从他出国留学以后，就不再像以前那样经常和我们联系了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng tā chūguó liúxué yǐhòu, jiù búzài xiàng yǐqián nàyàng jīngcháng hé wǒmen liánxì le.
examples.english: Ever since he went abroad for studies, he no longer keeps in touch with us as frequently as before.

examples.chinese: 他精心准备了三年的项目，不料在最后关头被公司否决了。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīngxīn zhǔnbèile sān nián de xiàngmù, bùliào zài zuìhòu guānntou bèi gōngsī fǒujuéle.
examples.english: He carefully prepared the project for three years, but unexpectedly it was rejected by the company at the last moment.

english: unlikely to go so far as to

examples.chinese: 他虽然脾气不好,但也不至于对客户发火。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán píqi búhǎo, dàn yě búzhìyú duì kèhù fāhuǒ.
examples.english: Although he has a bad temper, he's unlikely to go so far as to lose his temper with clients.

english: to sit for a makeup exam

examples.chinese: 由于上次考试没有通过，他不得不参加补考来获得这个职位的资格。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú shàngcì kǎoshì méiyǒu tōngguò, tā búdébuzhī cānjiā bǔkǎo lái huòdé zhège zhíwèi de zīgé.
examples.english: Because he failed the previous exam, he had no choice but to sit for a makeup exam to obtain the qualification for this position.

examples.chinese: 由于孩子的数学成绩一直不理想，父母决定给他报名补习班，希望能在高考前有所提高。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú háizi de shùxué chéngjì yīzhí búlǐxiǎng, fùmǔ juédìng gěi tā bàomíng bǔxí bān, xīwàng néng zài gāokǎo qián yǒusuǒ tígāo.
examples.english: Because the child's math grades have been consistently unsatisfactory, the parents decided to enroll him in a tutoring class, hoping to make some improvement before the college entrance exam.

examples.chinese: 由于这学期的课程特别紧张，许多学生不得不利用周末时间补课。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú zhè xuéqī de kèchéng tèbié jǐnzhāng, xǔduō xuésheng búděbù lìyòng zhōumò shíjiān bǔkè.
examples.english: Because the coursework this semester is particularly demanding, many students have no choice but to make up missed lessons during weekends.

examples.chinese: 政府决定补助那些受灾地区的农民，帮助他们度过难关。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ juédìng bǔzhù nàxiē shòuzāi dìqū de nóngmín, bāngzhù tāmen dùguò nánguān.
examples.english: The government decided to subsidize farmers in the disaster-stricken areas to help them get through the difficult period.

examples.chinese: 这个计划如果没有领导的支持，恐怕就不成了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà rúguǒ méiyǒu lǐngdǎo de zhīchí, kǒngpà jiù bù chéng le.
examples.english: If this plan doesn't have the leader's support, I'm afraid it won't work out.

examples.chinese: 渔民们在河里捕捞了一大篮新鲜的河虾。
examples.pinyin: Yúmín men zài héli bǔ lao le yī dà lán xīnxiān de héxià.
examples.english: The fishermen caught a large basket of fresh river prawns in the river.

examples.chinese: 看到他们多年来的努力终于有了成果，我不禁感到欣慰。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào tāmen duō nián lái de nǔlì zh终于 yǒu le chéngguǒ, wǒ bùjīn gǎndào xīnwèi.
examples.english: Seeing that their years of effort finally paid off, I couldn't help but feel relieved.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的成功不仅仅取决于资金投入，更重要的是团队的执行力和创新能力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de chénggōng bùjǐnjǐn qǔjuéyú zījīn tóuruò, gèng zhòngyào de shì tuánduì de zhíxíng lì hé chuàngxīn néngLì.
examples.english: The success of this project depends not only on financial investment, but more importantly on the team's execution and innovation capability.

examples.chinese: 由于长期缺乏沟通，他们之间的关系变得越来越不通，最终导致了误会和冲突。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú chángqī quēfá gōutōng, tāmen zhījiān de guānxi biàn de yuèláiyuè búitōng, zuìzh终 dǎozhìle wùhuì he chōngtū.
examples.english: Due to prolonged lack of communication, the relationship between them became increasingly obstructed, ultimately leading to misunderstandings and conflicts.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的服务态度不怎么样，我们下次不会再来了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de fúwù tàidù bù zěnmeyàng, wǒmen xiàcì búhuì zài lái le.
examples.english: The service attitude at this restaurant is not up to much; we won't come back next time.

examples.chinese: 这部电影票价太贵了，我觉得真的不值得花这么多钱去看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng piàojià tài guì le, wǒ juéde zhēnde búzhí de huā zhème duō qián qù kàn.
examples.english: This movie ticket is too expensive. I really don't think it's worth spending so much money to watch it.

examples.chinese: 虽然他学了很多年英语，但口语水平不怎么样。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā xuéle hěnduō nián yīngyǔ, dàn kǒuyǔ shuǐpíng búzěnmeyàng.
examples.english: Although he has studied English for many years, his spoken English is not very good.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的战争，这个城市的墙壁上布满了弹孔和裂纹。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de zhànzhēng, zhège chéngshì de qiángbì shang bùmǎn le dànkǒng hé lièwén.
examples.english: After years of war, the walls of this city were covered with bullet holes and cracks.

examples.chinese: 这支部队在边境地区执行了一项艰巨的任务，赢得了当地人民的信任和尊重。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī bùduì zài biānjiè dìqū zhíxíng le yī xiàng jiānjù de rènwu, yíngde le dāngdì rénmín de xìnrèn hé zūnzhòng.
examples.english: This military unit carried out a formidable task in the border region and won the trust and respect of the local people.

examples.chinese: 公司最终采纳了员工的建议，改进了生产流程。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zuìzhōng cǎinà le yuángōng de jiànyì, gǎijìn le shēngchǎn liúchéng.
examples.english: The company ultimately accepted the employees' suggestions and improved the production process.

examples.chinese: 尽管她没有接受过专业训练，但她还是决定参赛，希望能在国际舞台上展现自己的才华。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā méiyǒu jiēshòuguò zhuānyè xùnliàn, dàn tā háishi juéhuà cān赛, xīwàng néng zài guójì wǔtái shang zhǎnxiàn zìjǐ de cáihuá.
examples.english: Although she had not received professional training, she still decided to participate in the competition, hoping to showcase her talents on the international stage.

examples.chinese: 他不小心踩到了一只蜘蛛，吓得尖叫起来。
examples.pinyin: Tā búxiǎoxin cǎidào le yī zhī zhīzhū, xiàde jiānjiào qǐlái.
examples.english: He accidentally stepped on a spider and let out a startled scream.

examples.chinese: 许多国际知名品牌都选择在这次贸易会上参展，以展示最新的产品技术。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō guójì zhīmíng pǐnpái dōu xuǎnzé zài zhè cì màoyìhuì shàng cānzhǎn, yǐ zhǎnshì zuìxīn de chǎnpǐn jìshù.
examples.english: Many internationally renowned brands chose to participate in the exhibition at this trade fair to showcase their latest product technologies.

examples.chinese: 这次国宴的每一餐都展现了中国传统烹饪的精妙之处。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì guóyàn de měi yī cān dōu zhǎnxiàn le Zhōngguó chuántǒng pēng饪 de jīngmiào zhī chù.
examples.english: Every meal of this state banquet demonstrated the sophistication of traditional Chinese culinary arts.

examples.chinese: 虽然他因为事故而残疾，但他仍然坚持完成了大学学位，激励了许多人。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā yīnwèi shìgù ér cánjī, dàn tā仍rán jiānchíle wánchéng le dàxué xuéwèi, jīlì le xǔduō rén.
examples.english: Although he became disabled due to an accident, he still persisted in completing his university degree, which inspired many people.

examples.chinese: 这家公司致力于为残疾人提供更多的就业机会和社会支持。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhìlì yú wèi cánjírén tígōng gèngduō de jiùyè jīhuì hé shèhuì zhīchí.
examples.english: This company is dedicated to providing disabled people with more employment opportunities and social support.

examples.chinese: 战争的残酷性让许多士兵在心理上留下了永久的创伤。
examples.pinyin: Zhànzhēng de cánkù xìng ràng xǔduō shìbīng zài xīnlǐ shang liúxià le yǒngjiǔ de chuāngshāng.
examples.english: The brutality of war left many soldiers with permanent psychological trauma.

examples.chinese: 公司的仓库因为管理不善，导致大量商品过期报废。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de cāngkù yīnwèi guǎnlǐ búshàn, dǎozhì dàliàng shāngpǐn guòqī bàofèi.
examples.english: The company's depot suffered significant waste of expired goods due to poor management.

examples.chinese: 那场车祸的后果很惨，两个人当场丧生。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng chēhuò de hòuguǒ hěn cǎn, liǎng ge rén dāngchǎng sàngshēng.
examples.english: The consequences of that car accident were tragic; two people died on the spot.

examples.chinese: 他在银行里藏了一笔钱，以防万一。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yínháng lǐ cángle yī bǐ qián, yǐ fáng wànyī.
examples.english: He laid by a sum of money in the bank just in case.

examples.chinese: 那个公司的老板操纵市场价格，导致许多消费者受害。
examples.pinyin: Nàge gōngsī de lǎobǎn cāozòng shìchǎng jiàgé, dǎozhì xǔduō xiāofèizhě shòuhài.
examples.english: The boss of that company manipulated market prices, causing many consumers to suffer losses.

examples.chinese: 从侧面看，这个问题比我们最初想象的要复杂得多。
examples.pinyin: Cóng cèmiàn kàn, zhège wèntí bǐ wǒmen zuìchū xiǎngxiàng de yào fùzá de duō.
examples.english: From a lateral perspective, this problem is much more complex than we initially imagined.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的厕所设施非常现代化，让我们对它的服务质量印象深刻。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cèsuǒ shèshī fēicháng xiàndàihuà, ràng wǒmen duì tā de fúwù zhìliàng yìnxiàng shēnkè.
examples.english: The restroom facilities at this restaurant are very modern, which gave us a deep impression of its service quality.

examples.chinese: 科研人员通过精密仪器测定了水样中的污染物含量。
examples.pinyin: Kēyán rényuán tōngguò jīngmì yìqì cèdìngle shuǐyàng zhōng de wūrǎnhuà wù hánliàng.
examples.english: The researchers determined the content of pollutants in the water sample using precise instruments.

examples.chinese: 这次营销活动是由我们的团队精心策划了半年多才完成的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì yíngxiāo huódòng shì yóu wǒmen de tuánduì jīngxīn cèhuà le bàn nián duō cái wánchéng de.
examples.english: This marketing campaign was carefully planned by our team over more than half a year before it was finally completed.

examples.chinese: 公司采取了一项大胆的市场策略，决定将产品价格降低三成以争取更多客户。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī cǎiqǔle yī xiàng dàdǎn de shìchǎng cèlüè, juéding jiāng chǎnpǐn jiàgé jiàngdī sān chéng yǐ zhēngqǔ gèngduō kèhù.
examples.english: The company adopted a bold market strategy, deciding to reduce product prices by thirty percent in order to attract more customers.

examples.chinese: 从经济层面来看，这个政策的实施将会对中小企业产生深远的影响。
examples.pinyin: Cóng jīngjì céngmiàn lái kàn, zhège zhèngcè de shíshī jiānghuì duì zhōngxiǎo qǐyè chǎnshēng shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: From an economic perspective, the implementation of this policy will have far-reaching effects on small and medium-sized enterprises.

examples.chinese: 城市和农村地区的发展差异仍然很大，这是我们需要重点关注的问题。
examples.pinyin: Chéngshì hé nóngcūn dìqū de fāzhǎn chāyì réngrán hěn dà, zhè shì wǒmen xūyào zhòngdiǎn guānzhù de wèntí.
examples.english: The development gap between urban and rural areas remains quite large, which is an issue we need to focus on.

examples.chinese: 警察通过DNA检测最终查出了真凶。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá tōngguò DNA jiǎncè zuìzhōng cháchūle zhēn xiōng.
examples.english: The police finally identified the real culprit through DNA testing.

examples.chinese: 在做出最终决定之前，我们需要查看所有相关的财务报告和市场分析数据。
examples.pinyin: Zài zuòchū zuìzhōng juédìng zhīqián, wǒmen xūyào chákàn suǒyǒu xiāngguān de cáiwù bàogào hé shìchǎng fēnxī shùjù.
examples.english: Before making a final decision, we need to look over all relevant financial reports and market analysis data.

english: to demolish a building and relocate the inhabitants

examples.chinese: 政府为了建设新的商业中心，对这片老城区进行了大规模的拆迁，许多住户获得了合理的补偿。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ wèile jiànshè xīn de shāngyè zhōngxīn, duì zhè piàn lǎo chéngqū jìnxíngle dà guīmó de chāiqiān, xǔduō zhùhù huòdéle héalǐ de bǔcháng.
examples.english: In order to build a new commercial center, the government carried out large-scale demolition and relocation in this old urban area, and many residents received reasonable compensation.

examples.chinese: 由于采用了新的生产技术，工厂的产量比去年提高了30%。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú cǎiyòngle xīnde shēngchǎn jìshù, gōngchǎngde chǎnliàng bǐ qùnián tíhuàle 30%.
examples.english: Thanks to the adoption of new production techniques, the factory's output increased by 30% compared to last year.

examples.chinese: 在改革开放的政策下，中国经济实现了前所未有的昌盛。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǎigé kāifàng de zhèngcè xià, Zhōngguó jīngjì shíxiàn le qiánsuǒ wèiyǒu de chāngshèng.
examples.english: Under the policy of reform and opening up, China's economy achieved unprecedented prosperity.

examples.chinese: 今年公司给了我们一个月的长假，我决定去欧洲旅游，这样可以彻底放松身心。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián gōngsī gěile wǒmen yī ge yuè de chángjià, wǒ juédìng qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu, zhèyàng kěyǐ chèdǐ fàngsōng shēnxīn.
examples.english: This year the company gave us a month-long vacation, and I decided to travel to Europe so I could completely relax and rejuvenate myself.

examples.chinese: 这条裙子的长短不太适合我，我觉得应该改短一些。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo qúnzi de chángduǎn búhuì shìhé wǒ, wǒ juéde yīnggāi gǎi duǎn yīxiē.
examples.english: The length of this skirt doesn't really suit me; I think it should be shortened a bit.

examples.chinese: 他坚持了十年的长跑训练，最终在国际比赛中获得了金牌。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiānchíle shí nián de chángpǎo xùnliàn, zuìzhōng zài guójì bǐsài zhōng huòdéle jīnpái.
examples.english: After persisting with long-distance running training for ten years, he finally won a gold medal at an international competition.

examples.chinese: 我们需要制定一个长远的发展战略，而不是只关注眼前的利益。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào zhìdìng yīgè chángyuǎn de fāzhǎn zhànlüè, érbúshì zhǐ guānzhù yǎnqián de lìyì.
examples.english: We need to formulate a long-range development strategy rather than only focusing on immediate interests.

examples.chinese: 这家公司打破了行业常规，采用了完全不同的营销策略。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī dǎpò le hángyè chángguī, cǎiyòng le wánquán búntóng de yíngxiāo cèlüè.
examples.english: This company broke industry code of conduct and adopted a completely different marketing strategy.

examples.chinese: 这段友谊能否长久存在，取决于我们是否能够互相理解和包容。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duàn yǒuyì néng fǒu chángjiǔ cúnzài, qǔjuéyú wǒmen shìfǒu néng gòu hùxiāng lǐjiě hé bāoróng.
examples.english: Whether this friendship can last permanently depends on whether we can understand and tolerate each other.

examples.chinese: 这个地区常年受到季风影响，导致降雨量非常不均匀。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū chángnián shòudào jìfēng yǐngxiǎng, dǎozhì jiàngcì liàng fēicháng búyúnmún.
examples.english: This region is affected by monsoons all year round, resulting in very uneven rainfall distribution.

examples.chinese: 这个体育馆的场地设施非常先进，能够承办国际级的竞技比赛。
examples.pinyin: Zhège tǐyùguǎn de chǎngdì shèshī fēicháng xiāngjìn, nénggoù chéngbàn guójìjí de jìngjì bǐsài.
examples.english: The facilities and grounds of this gymnasium are very advanced and can host international-level athletic competitions.

examples.chinese: 这些厂商为了降低成本，纷纷将生产线转移到劳动力更便宜的地区。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē chǎngshāng wèile jiàngdī chéngběn, fēnfēn jiāng shēngchǎnxiàn zhuǎnyídào láodònglì gèng piányi de dìqū.
examples.english: To reduce costs, these manufacturers have moved their production lines to regions with cheaper labor.

examples.chinese: 这个新建的体育场馆将承办下一届奥运会的多项比赛项目。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīnjiàn de tǐyù chǎngguǎn jiāng chéngbàn xiàyī jiè àoyùnhuì de duōxiàng bǐsài xiàngmù.
examples.english: This newly built sports venue will host multiple competition events for the next Olympic Games.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的开场场景设计得非常精妙，立刻就把观众带入了故事的氛围中。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de kāichǎng chǎngjǐng shèjì de fēicháng jīngmiào, lìkè jiù bǎ guānzhòngzhě dàirù le gùshì de fēnwèi zhōng.
examples.english: The opening scene of this film is designed so brilliantly that it immediately draws the audience into the story's atmosphere.

examples.chinese: 政府投入大量资金改善基础设施，确保城市交通畅通无阻。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tóuruò dàliàng zījīn gǎish善 jīchǔ shèshī, quèbǎo chéngshì jiāotōng chàngtōng wú'è.
examples.english: The government invested substantial funds to improve infrastructure and ensure that urban traffic flows smoothly without obstruction.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的成本已经超出了我们最初的预算。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de chéngběn yǐjīng chāochūle wǒmen zuìchū de yùsuàn.
examples.english: The cost of this project has already exceeded our original budget.

examples.chinese: 这道菜需要用大火快速炒，才能保持蔬菜的鲜脆口感。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài xūyào yòng dà huǒ kuàisù chǎo, cáinéng bǎochí shūcài de xiān脆 kǒugǎn.
examples.english: This dish needs to be stir-fried over high heat quickly in order to preserve the fresh and crispy texture of the vegetables.

examples.chinese: 这家公司的业绩已经超过了行业平均水平，成为市场上的领头羊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de yèjī yǐjīng chāoguòle hángyè pí均jūn shuǐpíng, chéngwéi shìchǎng shang de lǐngtóu yáng.
examples.english: This company's performance has already exceeded the industry average and become a market leader.

examples.chinese: 他在股市里炒股多年，最后还是被套牢了，这让他意识到投资需要更多的理性和耐心。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gǔshì lǐ chǎo gǔ duō nián, zuìhòu háishi bèi tàoláng le, zhè ràng tā yìshí dào tóuzī xūyào gèngduō de lǐxìng hé nàixin.
examples.english: After speculating in stocks in the stock market for many years, he ultimately got trapped in his positions, which made him realize that investing requires more rationality and patience.

examples.chinese: 警察要求驾驶员出示车号和驾驶证进行核实。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá yāoqiú jiàshǐyuán chūshì chēhào hé jiàshǐzhèng jìnxíng héshì.
examples.english: The police officer asked the driver to show the car number and driver's license for verification.

examples.chinese: 这家娱乐公司经常炒作一些绯闻来吸引公众的注意力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yúlè gōngsī jīngcháng chǎozuò yīxiē fēiwén lái xīyǐn gōngzhòng de zhùyìlì.
examples.english: This entertainment company often stirs up rumors to attract public attention.

examples.chinese: 今年的国际车展吸引了来自世界各地的汽车制造商展示他们最新的电动车型。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de guójì chēzhǎn xīyǐnle lái zìyú shìjiè gèdì de qìchē zhìzàoshāng zhǎnshì tāmen zuìxīn de diàndòng chēxíng.
examples.english: This year's international motor show attracted automobile manufacturers from all over the world to showcase their latest electric vehicle models.

examples.chinese: 他因为遮挡车牌被警察罚款了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi zhēdǎng chēpái bèi jǐngchá fákuǎn le.
examples.english: He was fined by the police for obscuring his license plate.

examples.chinese: 由于新的证据出现，法院决定撤销之前的判决。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú xīn de zhèngjù chūxiàn, fǎyuàn juédìng chèxiāo zhīqián de pànjué.
examples.english: Due to the emergence of new evidence, the court decided to overturn the previous verdict.

examples.chinese: 由于安全局势恶化，大使馆决定撤离所有非必要人员。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú ānquán júshì èhuà, dàshǐguǎn juédìng chèlí suǒyǒu fēi bìyào rényuán.
examples.english: Due to the deteriorating security situation, the embassy decided to withdraw all non-essential personnel.

examples.chinese: 他用一根木棍撑起了那个快要倒塌的帐篷。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng yī gēn mùzhùn chēngqǐle nàge kuàiyào dàotā de zhàngpeng.
examples.english: He propped up the tent that was about to collapse with a wooden stick.

examples.chinese: 这种新药的有效成分是从天然植物中提取的，经过多年的临床试验才被批准上市。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīn yào de yǒuxiào chéngfen shì cóng tiānrán zhíwù zhōng tíqǔ de, jīngguò duō nián de línchuáng shìyàn cái bèi pīzhǔn shàngshì.
examples.english: The active ingredient of this new drug is extracted from natural plants and was only approved for market release after years of clinical trials.

examples.chinese: 这批成品需要经过严格的质量检测，才能送往市场。
examples.pinyin: Zhè pī chéngpǐn xūyào jīngguò yánggé de zhìliàng jiǎncè, cáinéng sòngwǎng shìchǎng.
examples.english: This batch of finished products needs to go through rigorous quality inspection before it can be sent to market.

examples.chinese: 这位企业家向投资者承诺会在两年内实现利润翻倍，但最终还是没有兑现。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi qǐyèjiā xiàng tóuzīzhě chéngnuò huì zài liǎng nián nèi shíxiàn lìrùn翻bèi, dàn zuìzh終háishi méiyǒu duìxiàn.
examples.english: The entrepreneur promised investors that he would double profits within two years, but ultimately failed to deliver on his promise.

examples.chinese: 随着城市的发展，城区的房价已经远远超过了郊区。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe chéngshì de fāzhǎn, chéngqū de fàngjià yǐjīng yuǎnyuǎn chāoguòle jiāoqū.
examples.english: With the development of the city, the housing prices in the city district have far exceeded those in the suburbs.

examples.chinese: 政府制定了一系列政策来缩小城乡发展的差距。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zhìdìngle yī xìliè zhèngcè lái suōxiǎo chéngxiāng fāzhǎn de chāju.
examples.english: The government has formulated a series of policies to narrow the gap in urban and rural development.

examples.chinese: 随着经济的发展，越来越多的农民工涌入城镇寻求更好的生活机会。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì de fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de nóngmíngōng yǒngrù chéngzhèn xúnqiú gèng hǎo de shēnghuó jīhuì.
examples.english: As the economy develops, more and more migrant workers are pouring into cities and towns seeking better life opportunities.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的努力，他终于成为了一名杰出的科学家。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, tā zh终于 chéng wéi le yī míng jiéchū de kēxuéjiā.
examples.english: After years of effort, he finally became an outstanding scientist.

examples.chinese: 这次金融危机对许多小企业造成了巨大的冲击。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì jīnróng wēijī duì xǔduō xiǎo qǐyè zàochéngle jùdà de chōngjī.
examples.english: This financial crisis dealt a huge blow to many small businesses.

examples.chinese: 这位企业家持有乐观的态度，坚信市场终将回暖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi qǐyèjiā chíyǒu lèguān de tàidù, jiānxìn shìchǎng zh终jiāng huínuǎn.
examples.english: This entrepreneur maintains an optimistic attitude, firmly believing that the market will eventually recover.

examples.chinese: 地震后，这座城市花了五年时间才完全重建，许多建筑都采用了更先进的抗震技术。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu, zhè zuò chéngshì huāle wǔ nián shíjiān cái wánquán chóngjiàn, xǔduō jiànzhú dōu cǎiyòngle gèng xiāngjìn de kàngruò jìshù.
examples.english: After the earthquake, it took this city five years to completely rebuild, and many buildings adopted more advanced earthquake-resistant technology.

examples.chinese: 许多城市居民因为工作繁忙而选择饲养宠物来缓解压力。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō chéngshì jūmín yīnwèi gōngzuò繁忙 érxuǎnzé sìyǎng chǒngwù lái huǎnjiě yālì.
examples.english: Many urban residents choose to keep pets to relieve stress due to their busy work schedules.

examples.chinese: 许多年轻人崇拜那些通过自己的努力成功的企业家。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō niánqīngrén chóngbài nàxiē tōngguò zìjǐ de nǔlì chénggōng de qǐyèjiā.
examples.english: Many young people worship entrepreneurs who have achieved success through their own efforts.

examples.chinese: 公司经历了一次大规模的重组，许多部门被合并，员工也面临着重新分配。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jīnglìle yī cì dà guīmó de chóngzǔ, xǔduō bùmén bèi héngbìng, yuángōng yě miànlín zhe chóngxīn fēnpèi.
examples.english: The company underwent a large-scale reorganization, with many departments merged and employees facing reassignment.

examples.chinese: 听到警报声，士兵们立即冲向战场，准备迎接这场激烈的战斗。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào jǐngbào shēng, shìbīngmen lìjí chōngxiàng zhàncháng, zhǔnbèi yíngjiē zhè chǎng jīliè de zhàndòu.
examples.english: Upon hearing the alarm, the soldiers immediately charged toward the battlefield, ready to face this intense battle.

examples.chinese: 这位新导演的作品在电影节上出场后，立即引起了影评家的广泛关注。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi xīn dǎoyǎnjiā de zuòpǐn zài diànyǐngjié shang chūchǎng hòu, lìjí yǐnqǐ le yǐngpíng jiāhuà de guǎngfàn guānzhù.
examples.english: After this new director's work appeared at the film festival, it immediately attracted widespread attention from film critics.

english: to start out on a trip

examples.chinese: 为了应对这场自然灾害，政府出动了大量的救援队伍和医疗人员。
examples.pinyin: Wèile yìngduì zhè chǎng zìránzāihài, zhèngfǔ chūdòngle dàliàng de jiùyuán duìwu hé yīliào rényuán.
examples.english: In order to respond to this natural disaster, the government mobilized a large number of rescue teams and medical personnel.

examples.chinese: 总理将于下周出访欧洲五国，进一步加强双边经济合作。
examples.pinyin: Zǒnglǐ jiāng yú xiàzōu chūfǎng Ōuzhōu wǔ guó, jìnyībù jiāqiáng shuāngbiān jīngjì hézuò.
examples.english: The Premier will travel on business to five European countries next week to further strengthen bilateral economic cooperation.

examples.chinese: 在这个竞争激烈的时代，很多年轻人都在苦恼寻找自己的出路。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège jìngjìng jīliè de shídài, hěnduō niánqīngrén dōu zài kǔnǎo xúnzhǎo zìjǐ de chūlù.
examples.english: In this fiercely competitive era, many young people are struggling to find their own way out.

english: act in one's own capacity or on behalf o

examples.chinese: 由于谈判陷入僵局，公司董事长决定亲自出面与客户协商。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú tánpàn xiànrù jiāngjú, gōngsī dǒngshìzhǎng juédìng qīnzì chūmiàn yǔ kèhù xiéshāng.
examples.english: Since the negotiations reached a deadlock, the company's chairman decided to step in personally to negotiate with the clients.

examples.chinese: 这家公司的财务出入记录不清楚，已经引起了税务部门的调查。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de cáiwù chūrù jìlù búqīngchu, yǐjīng yǐnqǐle le shuìwù bùmén de diàochá.
examples.english: The financial inflows and outflows of this company are unclear, which has already triggered an investigation by the tax department.

examples.chinese: 如果飞机在起飞时出事，后果将不堪设想。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ fēijī zài qǐfēi shí chūshì, hòuguǒ jiāng búkān shèxiǎng.
examples.english: If an accident were to happen during the plane's takeoff, the consequences would be unimaginable.

examples.chinese: 他为了支持这个公益项目而出名，许多企业家也跟风参与。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile zhīchí zhège gōngyì xiàngmù érshang chūmíng, xǔduō qǐyèjiā yě gēnfēng cānyù.
examples.english: He lent his name to support this charitable project, and many entrepreneurs followed suit to participate.

examples.chinese: 政府最近出台了一系列措施来促进新能源产业的发展。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuìjìn chūtáile yī xìliè cuòshī lái cùjìn xīn néngliàng chǎnyè de fāzhǎn.
examples.english: The government recently launched a series of measures to promote the development of the new energy industry.

examples.chinese: 这道题看似初等，但实际上涉及很多深层的数学原理。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào tí kànsì chūděng, dàn shíjìshang涉jí hěn duō shēncéng de shùxué yuányuán.
examples.english: This problem appears elementary, but it actually involves many profound mathematical principles.

examples.chinese: 除了专业技能之外，我们还需要培养良好的沟通能力和团队合作精神。
examples.pinyin: Chúle zhuānyè jìnéng zhīwài, wǒmen háixū péiyǎng liǎnghǎo de gōutōng néngny力 hé tuánduì hézuò jīngshén.
examples.english: Apart from professional skills, we also need to develop good communication abilities and teamwork spirit.

english: to set out on a long journey

examples.chinese: 由于疫情的影响，今年很多人都改变了出行计划，选择在家远程工作。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yìqíng de yǐngxiǎng, jīnnián hěnduō rén dōu gǎibiàn le chūxíng jìhuà, xuǎnzé zài jiā yuǎnchéng gōngzuò.
examples.english: Due to the impact of the pandemic, many people this year have changed their travel plans and chosen to work remotely from home.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的厨师曾在国外学过多年，所以他能够完美融合东西方的烹饪技巧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de chúshī céng zài guówài xuéguò duō nián, suǒyǐ tā néng gòu wánměi rónghé dōngxīfāng de pēnghu饪 jìqiǎo.
examples.english: The cook at this restaurant once studied abroad for many years, so he is able to perfectly blend Eastern and Western cooking techniques.

examples.chinese: 云端储存技术的发展使得人们可以随时随地访问自己的重要文件。
examples.pinyin: Yúnduān chǔcún jìshù de fāzhǎn shǐde rénmen kěyǐ suíshí suídì fǎngwèn zìjǐ de zhòngyào wénjiàn.
examples.english: The development of cloud storage technology has enabled people to access their important files anytime and anywhere.

examples.chinese: 这个城市处处都是现代建筑，但传统文化的痕迹也随处可见。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì chùchù dōu shì xiàndài jiànzhú, dàn chuántǒng wénhuà de hénjì yě suíchù kějiàn.
examples.english: This city is filled with modern architecture everywhere, but traces of traditional culture can also be seen throughout.

examples.chinese: 李处长在会议上强调了部门今年的工作重点，要求所有员工认真执行。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ chùzhǎng zài huìyì shàng qiángdiào le bùmén jīnnián de gōngzuò zhòngdiǎn, yāoqiú suǒyǒu yuángōng rènzhēn zhíxíng.
examples.english: Director Li emphasized the department's key work priorities for this year at the meeting and required all employees to implement them seriously.

examples.chinese: 这个新的光纤技术大大提高了数据传输的速度和效率。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīn de guāngxiān jìshù dàdà tígāo le shùjù chuánshū de sùdù hé xiàolǜ.
examples.english: This new fiber optic technology has greatly increased the speed and efficiency of data transmission.

examples.chinese: 随着互联网的发展,传媒行业正在经历前所未有的变革。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe hùliánwǎng de fāzhǎn, chuánméi hángyè zhèngzài jīnglì qiánsuǒwèiyǒu de biànhuà.
examples.english: With the development of the internet, the media industry is undergoing unprecedented transformation.

examples.chinese: 关于这位明星即将退休的传言在网上传得沸沸扬扬，但他的经纪公司始终没有做出正式回应。
examples.pinyin: Guānyú zhè wèi míngxīng jíjiāng tuì休de chuányán zài wǎngshang chuán de fèifèiyáng yáng, dàn tā de jīngjì gōngsī shǐzhōng méiyǒu zuòchū zhèngshì huíyìng.
examples.english: Rumors about this celebrity's imminent retirement have been spreading wildly online, but his agency has not issued an official response.

examples.chinese: 这家公司的丑闻最终还是传出去了，导致股价大幅下跌。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de chǒuwen zuìzhōng háishi chuánchūqù le, dǎozhì gǔjià dà fúd xiàdiē.
examples.english: The scandal of this company eventually leaked out, causing the stock price to plummet significantly.

examples.chinese: 这艘货轮的船员来自世界各地，他们需要适应海上长期的工作环境。
examples.pinyin: Zhè sōu huòlún de chuányuán lái zì shìjiè gèdì, tāmen xūyào shìyìng hǎishang chángqī de gōngzuò huánjìng.
examples.english: The crew members of this cargo ship come from all over the world, and they need to adapt to the long-term working environment at sea.

examples.chinese: 在这场海上风暴中，许多船只都遭遇了严重的损害。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng hǎishang fēngbào zhōng, xǔduō chuánzhī dōu zāoyù le yánzhòng de sǔnhuài.
examples.english: During this maritime storm, many boats suffered serious damage.

examples.chinese: 这位船长凭借多年的航海经验，成功地带领船队度过了那场危险的风暴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi chuánzhǎng píngjiè duō nián de hánghǎi jīngyàn, chénggōng de dàilǐng chuánduì dùoguò le nà chǎng wēixiǎn de fēngbào.
examples.english: This captain, relying on his many years of maritime experience, successfully led the fleet through that dangerous storm.

examples.chinese: 这部电影巧妙地串联了几个看似无关的故事，最后在高潮处完美地汇聚在一起。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng qiǎomiào de chuànlián le jǐ ge kànsìsi wúguān de gùshì, zuìhòu zài gāocháo chù wánměi de huìjù zài yīqǐ.
examples.english: This film cleverly strings together several seemingly unrelated stories, which ultimately converge perfectly at the climax.

examples.chinese: 银行的服务窗口最近进行了系统升级，现在处理业务的效率提高了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yínháng de fúwù chuāngkǒu zuìjìn进行le xìtǒng shēngjī, xiànzài chǔlǐ yèwù de xiàolǜ tígāole hěnduō.
examples.english: The service windows at the bank recently underwent a system upgrade, and the efficiency of handling transactions has improved significantly.

examples.chinese: 这家公司是由几位海归企业家在十年前创建的，现在已经成为业界的领头羊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī shì yóu jǐ wèi hǎiguī qǐyèjiā zài shí nián qián chuàngjiàn de, xiànzài yǐjīng chéngwéi yèjiè de lǐngtóu yáng.
examples.english: This company was founded by several returned overseas entrepreneurs ten years ago and has now become a leader in the industry.

examples.chinese: 这个广告团队的创意总是能够吸引年轻消费者的注意力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guǎnggào tuánduì de chuàngyì zǒngshì néng gòu xīyǐn niánqīng xiāofèizhě de zhùyìlì.
examples.english: The creative ideas from this advertising team always manage to capture the attention of young consumers.

examples.chinese: 他在大学期间创办了一家科技公司，如今已经成为行业的领军企业。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài dàxué qījiān chuàngbàn le yī jiā kējì gōngsī, rújīn yǐjīng chéngwéi hángyè de lǐngjūn qǐyè.
examples.english: He founded a tech company during his university years, and it has now become a leading enterprise in the industry.

examples.chinese: 此处的文化遗产值得我们深入研究和保护。
examples.pinyin: Cǐchù de wénhuà yíchǎn zhídé wǒmen shēnrù yánjiū hé bǎohù.
examples.english: The cultural heritage at this place deserves our in-depth research and protection.

examples.chinese: 此前我们一直认为这个项目不可行，但新的数据改变了我们的想法。
examples.pinyin: Cǐqián wǒmen yīzhí rènwéi zhège xiàngmù búkěxíng, dàn xīn de shùjù gǎibiàn le wǒmen de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: Before this, we had always thought the project was not feasible, but the new data changed our minds.

examples.chinese: 此次改革涉及多个部门的利益，因此需要谨慎推进。
examples.pinyin: Cǐcì gǎigé shèjí duō ge bùmén de lìyì, yīncǐ xūyào jǐnshèn tuījìn.
examples.english: This reform touches on the interests of multiple departments, so it needs to be implemented carefully.

examples.chinese: 对于此事，我们需要与相关部门进行深入沟通，找到妥善的解决方案。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú cǐshì, wǒmen xūyào yǔ xiāngguān bùmén jìnxíng shēnyùn gōutōng, zhǎodào tuǒshàn de jiějué fāng'àn.
examples.english: Regarding this matter, we need to have in-depth communication with the relevant departments to find an appropriate solution.

examples.chinese: 他这次数学考试的成绩比上次进步了很多，虽然他只复习了三次数。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè cì shùxué kǎoshì de chéngjì bǐ shàng cì jìnbù le hěnduō, suīrán tā zhǐ fùxí le sān cì shù.
examples.english: His math test score this time improved a lot compared to last time, even though he only reviewed three times.

english: (used at the end of a letter to introduce a polite salutation)

examples.chinese: 感谢您一直以来的支持和信任，此致敬礼。
examples.pinyin: Gǎnxiè nín yīzhí yǐlái de zhīchí hé xìnrèn, cǐzhì jìnglǐ.
examples.english: Thank you for your continued support and trust. I remain respectfully yours.

examples.chinese: 他从不抱怨生活的困難，反而用樂觀的態度去面對每一個挑戰。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngbù bàoyuàn shēnghuó de kùnnan, fǎn'ér yòng lèguān de tàidù qù miànduì měi yī ge tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: He never complains about life's difficulties; instead, he faces every challenge with an optimistic attitude.

examples.chinese: 我从没想过有一天会放弃这个梦想，但现实迫使我做出了这个艰难的决定。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóngméi xiǎnguò yǒu yī tiān huì fàngqì zhège梦想, dàn xiànshí pòshǐ wǒ zuòchū le zhège艰难de jjuéding.
examples.english: I never imagined that one day I would give up this dream, but reality forced me to make this difficult decision.

examples.chinese: 她在厨房里调制酱料时加了太多醋，结果这道菜的味道过酸了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài chúfáng lǐ tiáozhì jiàngy料 shí jiāle tàiduō cù, jiéguǒ zhè dào cài de wèidào guòsuān le.
examples.english: She added too much vinegar while preparing the sauce in the kitchen, and as a result, the dish turned out too sour.

examples.chinese: 这个古老的村庄保留了许多传统的建筑风格，吸引了越来越多的游客前来探索。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǔlǎo de cūnzhuāng bǎoliúle xǔduō chuántǒng de jiànzhù fēngge, xīyǐnle yuèláiyuèduō de yóukè qiánlái tànsuǒ.
examples.english: This ancient village has preserved many traditional architectural styles, attracting more and more tourists to explore it.

examples.chinese: 为了应对恶劣的天气，政府临时搭建了一些避难所来安置受灾的民众。
examples.pinyin: Wèile yìngduì èliè de tiānqì, zhèngfǔ línshí dājiàn le yīxiē bìnànsuǒ lái ānzhì shòuzāi de mínzhòng.
examples.english: To cope with the severe weather, the government temporarily put up some shelters to accommodate the disaster-affected residents.

examples.chinese: 如果你错过了这次机会，可能就再也找不到这样好的工作了。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ cuòguòle zhè cì jīhuì, kěnéng jiù zàiyě zhǎobuhuì zhèyàng hǎo de gōngzuò le.
examples.english: If you pass up this opportunity, you might never find such a good job again.

examples.chinese: 这套服装的颜色搭配非常得体，展现了设计师的专业眼光。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào fúzhuāng de yánsè dāpèi fēicháng déytǐ, zhǎnxiàn le shèjìshī de zhuānyè yǎnguang.
examples.english: The color coordination of this outfit is very tasteful, demonstrating the designer's professional eye.

examples.chinese: 这两位导演多年来一直是完美的搭档，他们合作的每一部电影都获得了国际认可。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng wèi dǎoyǎn duō nián lái yīzhí shì wánměi de dādàng, tāmen hézuò de měi yī bù diànyǐng dōu huòdéle guójì rènkě.
examples.english: These two directors have been perfect partners for many years, and every film they collaborated on has received international recognition.

examples.chinese: 他那真诚的道歉深深打动了我，让我决定原谅他。
examples.pinyin: Tā nà zhēnchéng de dàoqiàn shēnshēn dǎdòngle wǒ, ràng wǒ juéxīn yuányóuliè tā.
examples.english: His sincere apology deeply moved me, which made me decide to forgive him.

examples.chinese: 在会议上，他不礼貌地打断了我的发言，这让我感到很尴尬。
examples.pinyin: Zài huìyì shang, tā búlǐmào de dǎduàn le wǒ de fāyán, zhè ràng wǒ gǎndào hěn gānɡà.
examples.english: During the meeting, he rudely interrupted my speech, which made me feel very embarrassed.

examples.chinese: 他们经常在周末聚在一起打牌，已经坚持了十多年，成了彼此生活中不可或缺的一部分。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen jīngcháng zài zhōumò jùzài yīqǐ dǎpái, yǐjīng jiānchíle shí duō nián, chéngle bǐcǐ shēnghuó zhōng búkě huò quē de yībùfen.
examples.english: They often gather together to play cards on weekends, and have persisted in doing so for over ten years, making it an indispensable part of each other's lives.

english: to dispatch sb to do sth

examples.chinese: 经理打发我去客户那里处理这个紧急问题。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ dǎfā wǒ qù kèh户 nàlǐ chǔlǐ zhège jǐnjí wèntí.
examples.english: The manager dispatched me to handle this urgent issue at the client's place.

examples.chinese: 他们为了争夺公司的经营权打官司已经三年了，至今还没有结果。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen wèile zhēngduó gōngsī de jīngyíngquán dǎ guānsi yǐjīng sān nián le, zhìjīn háishi méiyǒu jiéguǒ.
examples.english: They have been in a lawsuit over the company's operating rights for three years, and there is still no result to this day.

examples.chinese: 办公室里的打印机经常出故障，我们已经向公司反映多次了，但一直没有得到解决。
examples.pinyin: Bàngōngshì lǐ de dǎyìnjī jīngcháng chū gùzhàng, wǒmen yǐjīng xiàng gōngsī fǎnyìng duō cì le, dàn yīzhí méiyǒu dé到 jiějué.
examples.english: The printer in the office breaks down frequently. We have reported it to the company many times, but it has never been resolved.

examples.chinese: 这条大道连接了城市的南北两端，每天都有成千上万的车辆通行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo dàdào liánjiē le chéngshì de nánběi liǎng duān, měi tiān dōu yǒu chéngqiān shàngwàn de chēliàng tōngxíng.
examples.english: This wide road connects the north and south ends of the city, with tens of thousands of vehicles passing through it every day.

examples.chinese: 这家公司花了五年时间打造了一个完整的生态系统，现在已经成为行业领导者。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī huāle wǔ nián shíjiān dǎzào le yī ge wánzhěng de shēngtài xìtǒng, xiànzài yǐjīng chéngwéi hángyè lǐngdǎozhě.
examples.english: This company spent five years creating a complete ecosystem and has now become an industry leader.

examples.chinese: 周末的时候，大街上总是人山人海，各种小贩在叫卖着他们的商品。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò de shíhou, dàjiē shang zǒngshì rénshānrénhǎi, gèzhǒng xiǎofàn zài jiàomài zhe tāmen de shāngpǐn.
examples.english: On weekends, the street is always crowded with people, and various vendors are hawking their goods.

examples.chinese: 由于气候变化和耕地减少，全球大米产量面临严峻的挑战。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú qìhòu biànhuà hé gēngdì jiǎnshǎo, quánqiú dàmǐ chǎnyliàng miànlín yánnjùn de tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: Due to climate change and the reduction of arable land, global rice production faces severe challenges.

examples.chinese: 疫情期间，大批企业面临倒闭，失业率急剧上升。
examples.pinyin: Yìqíng qījiān, dàpī qǐyè miànlín dàobì, shīyèlǜ jíjù shàngshēng.
examples.english: During the pandemic, large quantities of enterprises faced bankruptcy, and the unemployment rate rose sharply.

examples.chinese: 这次国际编程大赛吸引了来自世界各地的顶尖技术人才参加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì guójì biānchéng dàsài xīyǐnle lái zì shìjiè gèdì de dǐngjiān jìshù réncái参加。
examples.english: This international programming competition attracted top technical talents from all over the world to participate.

examples.chinese: 这位书法大师的作品在国际艺术展上获得了广泛的认可和赞誉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi shūfǎ dàshī de zuòpǐn zài guójì yìshù zhǎn shàng huòdéle guǎngfàn de rènkě hé zànyù.
examples.english: This calligraphy master's works gained widespread recognition and praise at the international art exhibition.

examples.chinese: 政府大力支持新能源产业的发展，希望能在十年内实现碳中和的目标。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ dàlì zhīchí xīn néngnyuán chǎnyè de fāzhǎn, xīwàng néng zài shí nián nèi shíxiàn tàn zhōnghuà de mùbiāo.
examples.english: The government vigorously supports the development of the new energy industry, hoping to achieve carbon neutrality within ten years.

examples.chinese: 美国大使在联合国大会上发表了一份重要声明。
examples.pinyin: Měiguó dàshǐ zài liánhéguó dàhuì shang fābiǎole yī fèn zhòngyào shēngmíng.
examples.english: The American ambassador delivered an important statement at the United Nations General Assembly.

examples.chinese: 这个报告很重要，我待会儿再仔细看，现在先处理更紧急的事务。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bàogào hěn zhòngyào, wǒ dāihuir zài zīxì kàn, xiànzài xiān chǔlǐ gèng jǐnjí de shìwù.
examples.english: This report is important, but I'll look at it carefully in a moment; for now I need to handle more urgent matters first.

examples.chinese: 经济形势的不确定性让许多投资者感到担忧，他们开始重新评估自己的投资策略。
examples.pinyin: Jīngjì xíngshì de búquèdìngxìng ràng xǔduō tóuzīzhězhě gǎndào dānyōu, tāmen kāishǐ chóngxīn píngguǐ zìjǐ de tóuzī cèlüè.
examples.english: The uncertainty of the economic situation makes many investors feel apprehensive, and they begin to reassess their investment strategies.

examples.chinese: 互联网的诞生彻底改变了人类的信息交流方式。
examples.pinyin: Hùliánwǎng de dànshēng chèdǐ gǎibiàn le rénlèi de xìnxī jiāoliú fāngshì.
examples.english: The birth of the Internet completely changed the way humans exchange information.

examples.chinese: 在职业网球比赛中，单打选手需要承受更大的心理压力，因为他们无法依赖搭档的支持。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhíyè wǎngqiú bǐsài zhōng, dāndǎ xuǎnshǒu xūyào chéngshòu gèngdà de xīnlǐ yālì, yīnwèi tāmen wúfǎ yīlài dābàn de zhīchí.
examples.english: In professional tennis matches, singles players need to endure greater psychological pressure because they cannot rely on their partner's support.

examples.chinese: 这个政党的改革政策在各个党派之间引发了激烈的讨论。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhèngdǎng de gǎigé zhèngcè zài gègeè dǎngpài zhījiān yǐnfāle jīliè de tǎolùn.
examples.english: The reform policies of this political party sparked heated discussions among various factions.

examples.chinese: 当他听到这个消息的时候，整个人都愣住了。
examples.pinyin: Dāng tā tīngdào zhège xiāoxi de shíhou, zhěnggè rén dōu lèngzhù le.
examples.english: When he heard the news, he was completely stunned.

examples.chinese: 会议当天下午，我们就收到了总部的回复，效率之高令人印象深刻。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì dāngtiān xiàwǔ, wǒmen jiù shōudào le zǒngbù de huífu, xiàolǜ zhī gāo lìngrén yìnxiàng shēnkè.
examples.english: On the day of the meeting, we received a reply from headquarters in the afternoon, and the efficiency was impressively high.

examples.chinese: 很多人把这次失败当成了人生中最重要的一课。
examples.pinyin: Hěnduō rén bǎ zhè cì shībài dàngchéng le rénshēng zhōng zuì zhòngyào de yī kè.
examples.english: Many people regarded this failure as the most important lesson in their lives.

examples.chinese: 这辆车的挡风玻璃被石子砸了一道裂纹。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de dàngfēng bōli bèi shízi zá le yī dào lièwén.
examples.english: A crack appeared on the windshield of this car after being hit by a stone.

examples.chinese: 他把这次失败当作一个宝贵的学习机会，而不是简单的挫折。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhè cì shībài dàngzuò yī gè báoguì de xuéxí jīhuì, érbúshì jiǎndān de cuòzhé.
examples.english: He regarded this failure as a valuable learning opportunity rather than a simple setback.

examples.chinese: 公司要求员工签署保密协议，以保护客户的档案不被泄露。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yāoqiú yuángōng qiānshǔ bǎomìmì xiéyì, yǐ bǎohù kèhù de dàngàn búbèi xièlòu.
examples.english: The company requires employees to sign a confidentiality agreement to protect customers' data files from being leaked.

examples.chinese: 这份合同明年三月到期，我们需要提前准备续签的事宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétonɡ míngniánɡ sānyuè dào qī, wǒmen xūyào tíqiān zhǔnbèi xùqiān de shìyí.
examples.english: This contract falls due next March, and we need to prepare for renewal in advance.

examples.chinese: 这家出版社因为大量印刷盗版书籍而被法院判罚了五百万元。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chūbǎnshè yīnwèi dàliàng yìnshuā dào bǎn shūjí érbeǐ fǎyuàn pànfá le wǔbǎi wàn yuán.
examples.english: The publishing house was fined five million yuan by the court for printing a large number of pirated books.

examples.chinese: 这座岛屿因其独特的生态系统而被联合国列为世界自然遗产。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dǎoyǔ yīnqī dúzhǔ de shēngtài xìtǒng ér bèi liánhéguó liè wéi shìjiè zìrán yíchǎn.
examples.english: This island was designated as a UNESCO World Natural Heritage site because of its unique ecosystem.

examples.chinese: 道教在中国古代文化中占据了重要地位，对中医、武术和文学艺术都产生了深远的影响。
examples.pinyin: Dàojiào zài Zhōngguó gǔdài wénhuà zhōng zhànjù le zhòngyào dìwèi, duì zhōngyī, wǔshù hé wénxué yìshù dōu chǎnshēngle shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Taoism occupied an important position in ancient Chinese culture and had a profound influence on Chinese medicine, martial arts, and literary arts.

examples.chinese: 他为自己之前的失礼行为向老板道歉，希望能够挽回信任。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèi zìjǐ zhīqián de shīlǐ xíngwéi xiàng lǎobǎn dào qiàn, xīwàng nénggoù wǎnhuí xìnrèn.
examples.english: He apologized to his boss for his previous impolite behavior, hoping to restore trust.

examples.chinese: 这种疫苗需要在低温环境下保存，否则会失效。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yìmiáo xūyào zài dīwēn huánjìng xià bǎocún, fǒuzé huì shīxiào.
examples.english: This type of vaccine needs to be stored in a low temperature environment, otherwise it will become ineffective.

examples.chinese: 面对强大的对手，他最终还是选择了低头，这让很多人感到失望。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì qiángdà de duìshǒu, tā zuìzhōng háishi xuǎnzéle dī tóu, zhè ràng hěnduō rén gǎndào shīwàng.
examples.english: Faced with a formidable opponent, he ultimately chose submission, which disappointed many people.

examples.chinese: 经过长途飞行后，我们终于在午夜时分抵达了目的地。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò chángú fēixíng hòu, wǒmen终于 zài wǔyè shífen dǐdáe le mùdìdì.
examples.english: After a long flight, we finally reached our destination at midnight.

examples.chinese: 面对不公正的待遇，员工们决定联合起来抵抗公司的不合理规定。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì bù gōngzhèng de dàiyù, yuángōngmen juédìng liánhé qǐlái dǐkàng gōngsī de búhéelǐ guīdìng.
examples.english: Faced with unfair treatment, the employees decided to unite and resist the company's unreasonable regulations.

examples.chinese: 这份地图上的地名标注有误，我们需要联系出版社进行更正。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn dìtú shàng de dìmíng biāozhù yǒu wù, wǒmen xūyào liánxì chūbǎnshè jìnxíng gèngzhèng.
examples.english: The place names marked on this map are inaccurate, and we need to contact the publisher to make corrections.

examples.chinese: 这间办公室的地板需要定期打蜡，才能保持光亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān bàngōngshì de dìbǎn xūyào dìngqī dǎ là, cái néng bǎochí guāngliang.
examples.english: The flooring in this office needs to be waxed regularly in order to maintain its shine.

examples.chinese: 他们把地下室改成了一个舒适的娱乐室，经常在那里和朋友们聚会。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen bǎ dìxiàshì gǎichéngle yī ge shūshì de yúlè shì, jīngcháng zài nàlǐ hé péngyoumen jùhuì.
examples.english: They converted the basement into a comfortable recreation room where they frequently gather with friends.

examples.chinese: 随着环保意识的提高，越来越多的人开始购买电动汽车来替代传统燃油车。
examples.pinyin: Suí着huánjìng yìshí de tígāo, yuèláiyuè duō de rén kāishǐ gòumǎi diàndòng qìchē lái tìdài chuántǒng ránnyóu chē.
examples.english: As environmental awareness increases, more and more people are beginning to purchase electric vehicles to replace traditional gasoline cars.

examples.chinese: 在这个城市里，电车是最环保也最便宜的交通工具，每天都有成千上万的通勤者依赖它。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège chéngshì lǐ, diànchē shì zuì huánbǎo yě zuì piányi de jiāotōng gōngjù, měi tiān dōu yǒu chéngqiān shàngwàn de tōngqīn zhě yīlài tā.
examples.english: In this city, trolleybuses are the most environmentally friendly and cheapest means of transportation, and tens of thousands of commuters rely on them every day.

examples.chinese: 随着科技的进步，越来越多的智能电器开始进入普通家庭，改变了人们的生活方式。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de jìnbù, yuèláiyuè duō de zhìnéng diànqì kāishǐ jìnrù pǔtōng jiāting, gǎibiànle rénmen de shēnghuó fāngshì.
examples.english: With the advancement of technology, an increasing number of smart electrical appliances are beginning to enter ordinary households, changing people's way of life.

examples.chinese: 这个国家的电力基础设施需要进行大规模的现代化改造。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā de diànlì jīchǔ shèshī xūyào进行 dà guīmó de xiàndàihuà gǎizào.
examples.english: This country's electrical power infrastructure needs to undergo large-scale modernization.

examples.chinese: 在古代，一吊铜钱足以让一个普通家庭维持生活一段时间。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, yī diào tóngqián zúyǐ ràng yīgè pǔtōng jiātíng wéichí shēnghuó yī duàn shíjiān.
examples.english: In ancient times, a string of one hundred cash was enough to allow an ordinary family to sustain themselves for a period of time.

examples.chinese: 为了制定更有效的政策，政府部门需要深入基层调研企业的实际困难。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zhìdìng gèng yǒuxiào de zhèngcè, zhèngfǔ bùmén xūyào shēnrù jīcéng diàoyán qǐyè de shíjì kùnnan.
examples.english: In order to formulate more effective policies, government departments need to conduct in-depth investigations into the actual difficulties faced by enterprises at the grassroots level.

examples.chinese: 这款新产品的定价策略直接影响了公司在市场上的竞争力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xīn chǎnpǐn de dìngjià cèlüè zhíji接 yǐngxiǎngle gōngsī zài shìchǎng shang de jìngjìnglì.
examples.english: The pricing strategy for this new product directly affected the company's competitiveness in the market.

examples.chinese: 为了提高工作效率，公司定时召开会议来评估项目的进展情况。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ, gōngsī dìngshí zhàokāi huìyì lái píngpingguó xiàngmù de jìnzhǎn qíngkuàng.
examples.english: In order to improve work efficiency, the company holds meetings at fixed times to evaluate the project's progress.

examples.chinese: 股票市场在经济衰退期间大幅跌落，许多投资者因此蒙受了巨大损失。
examples.pinyin: Gǔpiào shìchǎng zài jīngjì衰tuì qījiān dà fú diēluò, xǔduō tóuzīzhě yīncǐ méngshòu le jùdà sǔnshī.
examples.english: The stock market fell sharply during the economic recession, causing many investors to suffer significant losses.

examples.chinese: 这家公司成功地将自己定位为高端市场的领导者，赢得了消费者的信任。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chénggōng de jiāng zìjǐ dìngwèi wéi gāoduān shìchǎng de lǐngdǎozhě, yíngdéle xiāofèizhě de xìnrèn.
examples.english: This company successfully positioned itself as a leader in the high-end market, winning consumer trust.

examples.chinese: 为了争取更好的工作条件，工人们进行了长期的斗争。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zhēngqǔ gèng hǎo de gōngzuò tiáojiàn, gōngrénmen进行le chángqī de dòuzhēng.
examples.english: In order to fight for better working conditions, the workers engaged in a prolonged struggle.

examples.chinese: 这部动画虽然画风独特，但它深刻反映了现代社会的问题，值得成年人观看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù dònghuà suīrán huàfēng dúté, dàn tā shēnkè fǎnyìngle xiàndài shèhuì de wèntí, zhídé chéngnián rén guānkàn.
examples.english: Although this animation has a unique art style, it deeply reflects problems in modern society and is worth watching for adults.

examples.chinese: 警察破获了一个贩毒集团，缴获了大量毒品和现金。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá pòhuò le yīgè fànduó jítuán, jiǎohuò le dàliàng dúpǐn hé xiànjīn.
examples.english: The police busted a drug trafficking gang and seized a large amount of narcotics and cash.

examples.chinese: 他用房子赌博，结果输得一无所有。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng fángzi dǔbó, jiéguǒ shū de yī wú suǒ yǒu.
examples.english: He gambled away his house and ended up with nothing.

examples.chinese: 他因为沉迷赌博而失去了所有的积蓄，最后不得不向家人坦白。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi chénmì dǔbó ér shīqù le suǒyǒu de jīchǔ, zuìhòu búdébuzhǔ xiàng jiārén tǎnbái.
examples.english: He lost all his savings due to his addiction to gambling and eventually had to confess to his family.

examples.chinese: 这个问题的根端在于管理层的决策不当。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí de gēn duān zàiyú guǎnlǐ céng de juécè búdàng.
examples.english: The root cause of this problem lies in the management's improper decision-making.

examples.chinese: 现代都市人面临着工作与生活平衡的巨大挑战。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài dūshì rén miànlín zhe gōngzuò yǔ shēnghuó pínghuà de jùdà tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: Modern city dwellers face tremendous challenges in balancing work and life.

english: Dragon Boat Festival (5th day of the 5th lunar month)

examples.chinese: 每年端午节，我们全家都会聚在一起包粽子，这已经成为了一种传统习俗。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián Duānwǔ Jié, wǒmen quán jiā dōu huì jù zài yīqǐ bāo zòngzi, zhè yǐjīng chéngwéi le yī zhǒng chuántǒng xísú.
examples.english: Every Dragon Boat Festival, our whole family gathers together to make zongzi, which has become a traditional custom.

examples.chinese: 这部短片虽然只有十分钟，但它深刻地反映了现代社会中人与人之间的冷漠问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù duǎnpiàn suīrán zhǐyǒu shí fēnzhōng, dàn tā shēnkè de fǎnyìngle xiàndài shèhuì zhōng rén yǔ rén zhījiān de lěngmò wèntí.
examples.english: Although this short film is only ten minutes long, it profoundly reflects the problem of indifference between people in modern society.

examples.chinese: 这位老船夫已经在这条江上渡了五十多年，对水流变化了如指掌。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo chuánfu yǐjīng zài zhè tiáo jiāng shang dù le wǔshí duō nián, duì shuǐliú biànhuà liǎo rú zhǐ zài zhǎng.
examples.english: This old ferryman has been crossing this river for over fifty years and knows the water current changes like the back of his hand.

examples.chinese: 这支队伍在国际竞赛中表现出色，赢得了众多观众的认可。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī duìwu zài guójì jìngsài zhōng biǎoxiàn chūcsè, yíngdé le zhòngduō guānzhòng de rènkě.
examples.english: This team performed excellently in the international competition and won the recognition of many spectators.

examples.chinese: 这家公司计划对外开放其研发中心，以便与国际团队更好地合作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī jìhuà duìwài kāifàng qī yánfā zhōngxīn, yǐbiàn yǔ guójì tuánduì gèng hǎo de hézuò.
examples.english: The company plans to open its research center externally in order to collaborate better with international teams.

examples.chinese: 面对强大的竞争对手，我们必须加强团队合作来对抗市场的挑战。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì qiángdà de jìngjìng duìshǒu, wǒmen bìxū jiāqiáng tuánduì hézuò lái duìkàng shìchǎng de tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: Facing formidable competitors, we must strengthen teamwork to combat market challenges.

examples.chinese: 这次谈判多半会失败，因为双方的立场差异太大了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì tánpàn duōbàn huì shībài, yīnwèi shuāngfāng de lìchǎng chāyì tài dà le.
examples.english: This negotiation will most likely fail because the two sides' positions are too far apart.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的成功需要多方面的支持，包括资金、技术和人才的配合。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de chénggōng xūyào duōfāngmiàn de zhīchí, bāokuò zījīn, jìshù hé réncái de pèihé.
examples.english: The success of this project requires multi-faceted support, including cooperation in funding, technology, and talent.

examples.chinese: 现在的教育机构越来越重视多媒体技术在课堂上的应用，以此来提高学生的学习效率。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de jiàoyù jīgòu yuèláiyuè zhòngshì duōméitǐ jìshù zài kètáng shang de yìngyòng, yǐcǐ lái tíhuà xuésheng de xuéxí xiàolǜ.
examples.english: Nowadays, educational institutions increasingly emphasize the application of multimedia technology in classrooms to improve students' learning efficiency.

examples.chinese: 这位年轻的运动员凭借出色的表现夺得了奥运会的金牌。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi niánqīng de yùndòng yuán píngjiè chūcsè de biǎoxiàn duó déle àoyùnhuì de jīnpái.
examples.english: This young athlete won the Olympic gold medal through his outstanding performance.

examples.chinese: 他蹲在地上仔细观察那些蚂蚁的活动。
examples.pinyin: Tā dūn zài dìshang zǐxì guānchá nàxiē mǎyǐ de huódòng.
examples.english: He squatted on the ground to carefully observe the ants' activities.

examples.chinese: 在这场激烈的竞争中，公司努力夺取市场份额，最终成为了行业的领导者。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè chǎng jīliè de jìngjìng zhōng, gōngsī nǔlì duóqǔ shìchǎng fèn'é, zuìzh終chéng le chéngle le háng yè de lǐngdǎo zhě.
examples.english: In this fierce competition, the company strove to seize market share and eventually became the industry leader.

examples.chinese: 如果没有王教授的帮助，我根本不可能完成这项研究，他真是我的恩人。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu Wáng jiàoshòu de bāngzhù, wǒ gēnběn búkěnéng wánchéng zhè xiàng yánjiū, tā zhēnshi wǒ de ēnrén.
examples.english: Without Professor Wang's help, I would never have been able to complete this research; he is truly my benefactor.

examples.chinese: 这家医院的儿科医生在治疗小儿哮喘方面有着丰富的临床经验。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de érkē yīshēng zài zhìliáo xiǎo'ér xiāochuǎn fāngmiàn yǒuzhe fēngfù de línbìng jīngyàn.
examples.english: The pediatricians at this hospital have rich clinical experience in treating childhood asthma.

examples.chinese: 这种疾病通常在中年时期发病，患者需要长期接受治疗。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jíbìng tōngcháng zài zhōngniánshíqī fābìng, huànzhě xūyào chángqī jiēshòu zhìliáo.
examples.english: This type of disease typically has its onset during middle age, and patients need long-term treatment.

examples.chinese: 随着可再生能源技术的发展，风力发电已经成为许多国家能源结构中不可或缺的一部分。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kězàishēng néngyuán jìshù de fāzhǎn, fēnglì fādiàn yǐjīng chéngwéi xǔduō guójiā néngliàng jiégòu zhōng búkěhuò quēshǎo de yībùfen.
examples.english: With the development of renewable energy technology, wind power generation has become an indispensable part of the energy structure in many countries.

examples.chinese: 政府今年计划向受灾地区发放更多的救济金来帮助灾民重建家园。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jīnnián jìhuà xiàng shòuzāi dìqū fāfàng gèngduō de jiùjì jīn lái bāngzhù zāimín chóngjiàn jiāyuán.
examples.english: The government plans to provide more relief funds to the disaster-stricken areas this year to help victims rebuild their homes.

examples.chinese: 这位年轻的企业家发起了一项旨在帮助农村地区发展的公益项目。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi niánqīng de qǐyèjiā fāqǐ le yī xiàng zhǐzài bāngzhù nóngcūn dìqū fāzhǎn de gōngyì xiàngmù.
examples.english: This young entrepreneur initiated a public welfare project aimed at helping the development of rural areas.

examples.chinese: 听到这个不公平的决定后，经理在会议上当众发怒，整个办公室的气氛顿时变得很尴尬。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège bù gōngpíng de juédìng hòu, jīnglǐ zài huìyì shang dāngzhòng fānù, zhěngge bàngōngshì de qìfēn dùnshí biànde hěn gāngà.
examples.english: After hearing this unfair decision, the manager got angry in front of everyone at the meeting, and the atmosphere in the entire office immediately became awkward.

examples.chinese: 公司发言人就最近的财务丑闻向媒体做出了解释。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī fāyánrén jiù zuìjìn de cáiwù chǒuwen xiàng méitǐ zuòchūle jiěshì.
examples.english: The company spokesperson made an explanation to the media regarding the recent financial scandal.

examples.chinese: 这个案件已经上了法庭，法官将在下周做出最终判决。
examples.pinyin: Zhège ànjiàn yǐjīng shàngle fǎtíng, fǎguān jiāng zài xiàzhōu zuòchū zuìzhōng pànjué.
examples.english: This case has already gone to court, and the judge will make a final ruling next week.

examples.chinese: 如果伤口长期不清洁，很容易发炎，甚至引起感染。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ shāngkǒu chángqī bù qīngjié, hěn róngyì fāyán, shènzhì yǐnqǐ gǎnrǎn.
examples.english: If a wound is not kept clean for a long time, it can easily become inflamed, and may even lead to infection.

examples.chinese: 这番言论引发了社会各界的广泛讨论和争议。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fān yánlùn yǐnfāle shèhuì gèjiè de guǎngfàn tǎolùn hé zhēngyì.
examples.english: This set of remarks sparked widespread discussion and controversy across all sectors of society.

examples.chinese: 这道番茄酱的配方是祖母传下来的秘密，几代人都守护着这个传统。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào fānqié jiàng de pèifāng shì zǔmǔ chuán xiàlái de mìmì, jǐ dàirén dōu shǒuhù zhe zhège chuántǒng.
examples.english: The recipe for this tomato sauce is a family secret passed down from grandmother, preserved by generations.

examples.chinese: 凡是想成功的人都需要付出艰苦的努力。
examples.pinyin: Fánshì xiǎng chénggōng de rén dōu xūyào fùchū jiānkǔ de nǔlì.
examples.english: Whatever people want to succeed, they all need to put in hard effort.

examples.chinese: 她在大学里主修法语，毕业后成为了一名翻译。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài dàxué lǐ zhǔxiū fǎyǔ, bìyè hòu chéngwéile le yī míng fānyì.
examples.english: She majored in French at university and became a translator after graduation.

examples.chinese: 这种细菌在温暖潮湿的环境中繁殖速度很快，容易引起食物腐败。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xìjūn zài nuǎnhuо̀ cháoshī de huánjìng zhōng fánzhí sùdù hěn kuài, róngyì yǐnqǐ shíwù fǔbài.
examples.english: This type of bacteria breeds very quickly in warm and humid environments, easily causing food spoilage.

examples.chinese: 他听了我的解释后，反问我为什么要隐瞒这么重要的信息。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīngle wǒ de jiěshì hòu, fǎnwèn wǒ wèishéme yào yǐncáng zhème zhòngyào de xìnxī.
examples.english: After listening to my explanation, he asked me in reply why I had to conceal such important information.

examples.chinese: 这部电影上映后在国际电影节上引起了强烈的反响，许多影评人都给予了高度评价。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shàngyìng hòu zài guójì diànyǐngjié shang yǐnqǐle qiángliè de fǎnxiǎng, xǔduō yǐngpíng rén dōu gěiyǔle gāodù píngjiǎ.
examples.english: After the film's release, it caused a strong repercussion at the international film festival, and many critics gave it high praise.

examples.chinese: 那名运动员因为犯规被罚下场，这影响了整个球队的表现。
examples.pinyin: Nà míng yùndòng yuán yīnwèi fàn guī bèi fá xiàchǎng, zhè yǐngxiǎngle zhěngge qiúduì de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The athlete was sent off the field for breaking the rules, which affected the entire team's performance.

examples.chinese: 他因为犯了严重的法律错误而被判处有期徒刑。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi fànle yánzhòng de fǎlǜ cuòwù ér bèi pànchǔ yǒuqī túxíng.
examples.english: He was sentenced to a fixed term of imprisonment for committing a serious legal offense.

examples.chinese: 在专制统治下，人民最终决定起来反抗，争取自由和民主。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhuānzhì tǒngzhì xià, rénmín zuìzh終 juéde qǐlái fǎnkàng, zhēngqǔ zìyóu hé mínzhǔ.
examples.english: Under authoritarian rule, the people ultimately decided to rise up in revolt to fight for freedom and democracy.

examples.chinese: 警察局正在调查一起严重的犯罪案件，嫌疑人已经被逮捕。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá jú zhèngzài diàoyú yī qǐ yánzhòng de fàn zuì ànjiàn, xiányi rén yǐjīng bèi dàibǔ.
examples.english: The police department is investigating a serious criminal case, and the suspect has already been arrested.

examples.chinese: 这支球队的防守策略在整个赛季中发挥了关键作用，帮助他们赢得了冠军。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiúduì de fángshǒu cèlüè zài zhěngge sàijì zhōng fāhuīle guānjiàn zuòyòng, bāngzhù tāmen yíngdele guàngjūn.
examples.english: This team's defensive strategy played a crucial role throughout the season, helping them win the championship.

examples.chinese: 随着利率上升，房价可能会面临下行压力，这对购房者来说既是挑战也是机遇。
examples.pinyin: Suí着lìlǜ shàngshēng, fángjià kěnéng huì miànlín xiàxíng yālì, zhè duì gòufángzhě lái shuō既是tiǎozhàn yě shì jīyù.
examples.english: As interest rates rise, house prices may face downward pressure, which presents both challenges and opportunities for homebuyers.

examples.chinese: 企业需要防范市场风险，制定完善的应急预案。
examples.pinyin: Qǐyè xūyào fángfàn shìchǎng fēngxiǎn, zhìdìng wánshàn de yìngjí yùàn'àn.
examples.english: Enterprises need to be on guard against market risks and develop comprehensive emergency plans.

examples.chinese: 听到这首歌，我仿佛回到了多年前那个青春年代。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhè shǒu gē, wǒ fǎngfú huídàole duō nián qián nàge qīngchūn niándài.
examples.english: Hearing this song, it seems as if I've returned to that youthful era from many years ago.

examples.chinese: 这艘飞船采用了最先进的推进技术，能够在极端恶劣的太空环境中安全运行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè sōu fēichuán cǎiyòngle zuì xiānnjìn de tuījìn jìshù, nénggoù zài jíduān èliè de tàikōng huánjìng zhōng ānquán yùnxíng.
examples.english: This airship adopted the most advanced propulsion technology and can operate safely in the extreme and harsh space environment.

examples.chinese: 这位经验丰富的飞行员在恶劣天气下成功地完成了紧急降落。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jīngyàn fēngfù de fēixíngyuán zài èliè tiānqì xià chénggōng de wánchéngle jǐnjí jiàngluò.
examples.english: This experienced pilot successfully completed an emergency landing in severe weather.

examples.chinese: 长期吸烟会严重损害肺部功能，导致呼吸系统疾病。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī xīyān huì yánzhòng sǔnhuài fèibù gōngnéng, dǎozhì hūxī xìtǒng jíbìng.
examples.english: Long-term smoking will seriously damage lung function and lead to respiratory system diseases.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的成功离不开团队合理的分工和高效的沟通。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de chénggōng líbukāi tuánduì héalǐ de fēngōng hé gāoxiào de沟通。
examples.english: The success of this project depends on the team's reasonable division of labour and efficient communication.

examples.chinese: 看到这种不公正的现象，他感到深深的愤怒，决定站出来为弱势群体发声。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào zhè zhǒng búgōngzhèng de xiànxiàng, tā gǎndào shēnshēn de fènnù, juédìng zhàn chūlái wèi ruòshì qúntǐ fāshēng.
examples.english: Witnessing such unfair phenomena, he felt deep indignation and decided to speak out for vulnerable groups.

examples.chinese: 这个政党因为内部意见不合而最终走向了分裂。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhèngdǎng yīnwèi nèibù yìjiàn búhé érjiǔjìng zǒuxiàng le fēnliè.
examples.english: The political party ultimately split due to internal disagreements.

examples.chinese: 两国领导人在峰会上就贸易问题进行了深入讨论，希望能够找到互利共赢的解决方案。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó lǐngdǎorén zài fēnghuì shang jiùjiù màoyì wèntí jìnxíngle shēnrù tǎolùn, xīwàng néng gòu zhǎodào hùlì gòngyíng de jiějué fāng'àn.
examples.english: The leaders of the two countries had an in-depth discussion on trade issues at the summit, hoping to find mutually beneficial solutions.

examples.chinese: 这位科学家为国家的发展奉献了自己的整个人生。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi kēxuéjiā wèi guójiā de fāzhǎn fèngxiàn le zìjǐ de zhěnggè rénshēng.
examples.english: This scientist dedicated his entire life to the development of his country.

examples.chinese: 这场政治风暴席卷了整个国家，许多高官因此失去了职位。
