examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng zhèngzhì fēngbào xíjuǎnle zhěngge guójiā, xǔduō gāo guān yīncǐ shīqùle zhíwèi.
examples.english: This political tempest swept across the entire country, causing many high-ranking officials to lose their positions.

examples.chinese: 在现代社会中，越来越多的人开始研究佛教哲学，希望能从中找到内心的平静。
examples.pinyin: Zài xiàndài shèhuì zhōng, yuèláiyuè duō de rén kāishǐ yánjiū Fójiào zhéxué, xīwàng néng cóng zhōng zhǎodào nèixīn de píngjìng.
examples.english: In modern society, an increasing number of people have begun to study Buddhist philosophy, hoping to find inner peace from it.

examples.chinese: 这座古刹供奉的佛像已经有一千多年的历史了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔ chà gōngfèng de fóxiàng yǐjīng yǒu yī qiān duō nián de lìshǐ le.
examples.english: The Buddha statue enshrined in this ancient temple has a history of over a thousand years.

examples.chinese: 他穿着得体的服装参加了这场重要的商务会议。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuānzhe déti de fúzhuāng cānjiāle zhè chǎng zhòngyào de shāngwù huìyì.
examples.english: He wore appropriate attire to attend this important business meeting.

examples.chinese: 这部电影讲述了一对父女在战争中失散多年后重逢的感人故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎngshù le yī duì fùnǚ zài zhànzhēng zhōng shīsàn duō nián hòu chóngféng de gǎnrén gùshì.
examples.english: This film tells a touching story about a father and daughter who were separated during the war and reunited after many years.

examples.chinese: 这部电影讲述了一对父子在战争中失散，多年后重逢的感人故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎngshù le yī duì fùzǐ zài zhànzhēng zhōng shīsǎn, duō nián hòu chóngféng de gǎnrén gùshì.
examples.english: This film tells a touching story of a father and son who were separated during the war and reunited many years later.

examples.chinese: 他辜负了朋友的信任，这是他一生中最后悔的决定。
examples.pinyin: Tā gūfù le péngyou de xìnrèn, zhè shì tā yīshēng zhōng zuì hòuhuǐ de juédìng.
examples.english: He betrayed his friend's trust, which was the decision he regretted most in his life.

examples.chinese: 在经历了多年的沉寂之后，这位艺术家的作品再次浮出水面，引起了评论界的广泛关注。
examples.pinyin: Zài jīnglìle duō nián de chénnjì zhīhòu, zhè wèi yìshùjiā de zuòpǐn zàicì fúchū shuǐmiàn, yǐnqǐle pínglunjie de guǎngfàn guānzhù.
examples.english: After years of obscurity, this artist's work resurfaced, attracting widespread attention from critics.

examples.chinese: 这个妇女组织在过去十年里为农村地区的教育发展做出了巨大贡献。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fùnǚ zǔzhī zài guòqù shí nián lǐ wèi nóngcūn dìqū de jiàoyù fāzhǎn zuòchūle jùdà gòngxiàn.
examples.english: This women's organization has made tremendous contributions to educational development in rural areas over the past decade.

examples.chinese: 这位副总经理在公司改革中发挥了重要作用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi fù zǒngjīnglǐ zài gōngsī gǎigé zhōng fāhuīle zhònyào zuòyòng.
examples.english: This vice general manager played an important role in the company's reform.

english: variant of 復甦|复苏[fu4 su1]

examples.chinese: 经过几年的经济衰退后，这个国家终于开始复苏了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ nián de jīngjì衰tuì hòu, zhège guójiā zh終yú kāishǐ fùsū le.
examples.english: After several years of economic recession, the country finally began to recover.

examples.chinese: 那些富人往往忽视了金钱买不到的东西，比如真正的友谊和内心的平静。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē fùrén wǎngwǎng húshìle jīnqián mǎi bu dào de dōngxi, bǐrú zhēnzhèng de yǒuyì hé nèixīn de pínjìng.
examples.english: Those rich people often overlook things that money cannot buy, such as genuine friendship and inner peace.

examples.chinese: 演员们在后台迅速改装，准备出演下一个场景。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnyuánymen zài hòutái xùnsu gǎizhuāng, zhǔnbèi chūyǎn xiàyī ge chǎngjǐng.
examples.english: The actors quickly changed their costumes backstage in preparation for the next scene.

examples.chinese: 我认为政府不应该过度干涉市场经济的发展。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi zhèngfǔ búyīnggāi guòdù gānshè shìchǎng jīngjì de fāzhǎn.
examples.english: I believe the government should not excessively interfere with the development of the market economy.

examples.chinese: 长期过量饮酒会对肝脏造成严重的损害，甚至引发肝硬化。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī guòliàng yǐnjiǔ huì duì gānzàng zàochéng yánzhòu de sǔnhuài, shènzhì yǐnfā gānyìnghuà.
examples.english: Excessive alcohol consumption over a long period can cause serious damage to the liver, and may even lead to cirrhosis.

examples.chinese: 这位企业家不仅富有，而且热心于慈善事业，每年都捐赠大笔资金给贫困地区。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi qǐyèjiā bújǐn fùyǒu, érqiě règ心yú císhàn shìyè, měi nián dōu juānzèng dà bǐ zījīn gěi píngkùn dìqū.
examples.english: This entrepreneur is not only wealthy, but also passionate about charity, donating substantial funds to impoverished regions every year.

examples.chinese: 这根旗杆在风中摇晃，象征着这个国家的坚定立场。
examples.pinyin: Zhè gēn qíjī zài fēng zhōng yáohuàng, xiàngzh征zhe zhège guójiā de jiāndìng lìchǎng.
examples.english: This flagpole swayed in the wind, symbolizing the country's firm stance.

examples.chinese: 随着科技的飞速发展，有些传统行业已经赶不上时代的步伐了。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de fēisù fāzhǎn, yǒuxiē chuántǒng hángyè yǐjīng gǎnbushàng shídài de búfá le.
examples.english: With the rapid development of technology, some traditional industries can no longer keep up with the pace of the times.

examples.chinese: 随着科技的快速发展，我们必须不断学习新知识才能赶上时代的步伐。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de kuàisù fāzhǎn, wǒmen bìxū búduàn xuéxí xīn zhīshi cáinéng gǎnshàng shídài de búfá.
examples.english: With the rapid development of technology, we must constantly learn new knowledge in order to keep up with the pace of the times.

examples.chinese: 听到这个坏消息后，他赶忙拨通了律师的电话，想要了解自己的法律权益。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège huài xiāoxī hòu, tā gǎnmáng bōtōngle lǜshī de diànhuà, xiǎngyào liǎojiě zìjǐ de fǎlǜ quányì.
examples.english: After hearing this bad news, he hurried to call his lawyer to understand his legal rights.

examples.chinese: 他们的意见刚好相反，所以这个项目最终没有通过。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen de yìjiàn gānghǎo xiāngfǎn, suǒyǐ zhège xiàngmù zuìzh终 méiyǒu tōngguò.
examples.english: Their opinions were exactly opposite, so the project ultimately did not pass.

examples.chinese: 这部纪录片通过普通人的故事展现了人性的光辉，真的很感人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùkèpiàn tōngguò pǔtōng rén de gùshì zhǎnxiànle rénxìng de guānghuī, zhēnde hěn gǎnrén.
examples.english: This documentary showcases the brilliance of human nature through ordinary people's stories, which is truly touching.

examples.chinese: 经过多轮面试，他终于获得了这个竞争激烈的岗位。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō lún miànshì, tā zh終yú huòdéle zhège jìngzhēng jīliè de gǎngwèi.
examples.english: After going through multiple rounds of interviews, he finally secured this highly competitive position.

examples.chinese: 这个港口的吞吐量在过去十年里增长了三倍，已经成为国际贸易的重要枢纽。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǎngkǒu de tūntuōliàng zài guòqù shí nián lǐ zēngzhǎngle sān bèi, yǐjīng chéngwéi guójì màoyì de zhònyào shūniǔ.
examples.english: The throughput of this harbour has tripled over the past decade and has become an important hub for international trade.

examples.chinese: 公司高层决定在下个季度进行重大的组织结构调整。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī gāocéng juédìng zài xiàge jìdù jìnxíng zhòngdà de zǔzhī jiégòu tiáozhěng.
examples.english: The company's senior management decided to make major organizational restructuring in the next quarter.

english: to have the courage to do sth

examples.chinese: 只有敢于承认自己的错误，才能真正获得他人的尊重。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu gǎnyú chéngrèn zìjǐ de cuòwù, cáinéng zhēnzhèng huòdé tārén de zūnjìng.
examples.english: Only by having the courage to admit one's own mistakes can one truly gain the respect of others.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅虽然价格昂贵，但是高档的装修和精致的菜品确实值得一试。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng suīrán jiàgé ānggui, dànshì gāodàng de zhuāngxiū hé jīngzhì de càipǐn quèshí zhídé yī shì.
examples.english: Although this restaurant is expensive, the superior quality of its decor and exquisite dishes are truly worth trying.

examples.chinese: 互联网行业在过去十年经历了多个发展高峰，每一次都带来了深刻的社会变革。
examples.pinyin: Hùliánwǎng xíngyè zài guòqù shí nián jīng历le duō ge fāzhǎn gāofēng, měi yī cì dōu dàiláile shēnkè de shèhuì biànhuà.
examples.english: The internet industry has experienced multiple peaks of development over the past decade, each bringing profound social changes.

examples.chinese: 只有接受高等教育，才能在竞争激烈的社会中立足。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jiēshòu gāoděng jiàoyù, cáinéng zài jìngjìng jīliè de shèhuì zhōng lìzú.
examples.english: Only by receiving higher education can one establish oneself in a highly competitive society.

examples.chinese: 许多学生为了在高考中取得好成绩，不得不放弃自己喜欢的爱好。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō xuésheng wèile zài gāokǎo zhōng qǔdé hǎo chéngjì, búdébù fàngqì zìjǐ xǐhuān de àihào.
examples.english: Many students have to give up their favorite hobbies in order to achieve good results in the college entrance exam.

examples.chinese: 这家公司通过投资高科技产业，成功地在国际市场上占据了领先地位。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī tōngguò tóuzī gāokējì chǎnyè, chénggōngli de zài guójì shìchǎng shang zhànjùle lǐngxiān dìwèi.
examples.english: By investing in high-tech industries, this company successfully gained a leading position in the international market.

examples.chinese: 这份稿子需要在明天之前送到编辑手里，所以我今晚得加班把它改好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn gǎozi xūyào zài míngtiān zhīqián sòngdào biānjí shǒuli, suǒyǐ wǒ jīnwǎn děi jiābān bǎ tā gǎi hǎo.
examples.english: This draft needs to be submitted to the editor before tomorrow, so I have to work overtime tonight to revise it.

examples.chinese: 这位设计师在时尚界可是个公认的高手，她的每一个作品都能引起业内的轰动。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi shèjìshī zài shíshàngjiè kěshì ge gōngrènde gāoshǒu, tā de měi yī ge zuòpǐn dōu néng yǐnqǐ yènèi de hōngdòng.
examples.english: This designer is recognized as a master in the fashion industry, and every one of her works can cause a sensation in the field.

examples.chinese: 这首歌的歌词写得很有深度，每次听都能发现新的含义。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē de gēcí xiě de hěn yǒu shēndù, měi cì tīng dōu néng fāxiàn xīn de hányì.
examples.english: The lyrics of this song are written with great depth; every time I listen, I discover new meanings.

examples.chinese: 那位歌星的演唱会门票在几小时内就被抢购一空，足以证明她在粉丝心中的影响力。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi gēxīng de yǎnchànghuì ménpiào zài jǐ xiǎoshínèi jiù bèi qiǎngòu yīkōng, zúyǐ zhèngmíng tā zài fěnsī xīnzhōng de yǐngxiǎnglì.
examples.english: That singing star's concert tickets were completely sold out within hours, which is enough to prove her influence among fans.

examples.chinese: 这家公司通过技术革新成功地降低了生产成本，提高了市场竞争力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī tōngguò jìshù géxīn chénggōng de jiàngdī le shēngchǎn chéngběn, tígāo le shìchǎng jìngjìng lìliàng.
examples.english: By means of technological innovation, this company successfully reduced production costs and enhanced its market competitiveness.

examples.chinese: 政府最近出台了一系列政策来支持工商企业的发展，特别是中小型企业。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuìjìn chūtāile yì xìliè zhèngcè lái zhīchí gōngshāng qǐyè de fāzhǎn, tèbié shì zhōngxiǎoxíng qǐyè.
examples.english: The government recently introduced a series of policies to support the development of industrial and commercial enterprises, especially small and medium-sized businesses.

examples.chinese: 这个项目是由政府和私人企业共同投资的公私合作模式。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù shì yóu zhèngfǔ hé sīrén qǐyè gòngtóng tóuzī de gōngsī hézuò móshì.
examples.english: This project is a public-private partnership model jointly invested by the government and private enterprises.

examples.chinese: 这部电影不仅获得了国际大奖，更是引发了全球观众的深刻思考。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng bújǐn huòdéle guójì dàjiǎng, gèngshì yǐnfāle quánqiú guānzhòng de shēnkè sīkǎo.
examples.english: This film not only won international awards, but even more importantly, it sparked profound reflection among global audiences.

examples.chinese: 每天清晨，隔壁农场的公鸡会准时啼鸣，成为了我们这个小镇最可靠的闹钟。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān qīngchén, gébì nóngchǎng de gōngjī huì zhǔnshí tìmíng, chéngwéi le wǒmen zhège xiǎozhèn zuì kěkào de nàozhōng.
examples.english: Every early morning, the rooster from the neighboring farm crows on time, becoming the most reliable alarm clock in our small town.

examples.chinese: 政府需要更加透明地向公众解释这项政策的目的。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xūyào gèngjiā tòumíng de xiàng gōngzhòng jiěshì zhè xiàng zhèngcè de mùdì.
examples.english: The government needs to explain the purpose of this policy to the public in a more transparent manner.

examples.chinese: 这起案件已经交给公安部门处理，他们会尽快调查真相。
examples.pinyin: Zhè qǐ ànjiàn yǐjīng jiāogěi gōngān bùmén chǔlǐ, tāmen huì jìnkuài diàochá zhēnxiàng.
examples.english: This case has been handed over to the public security authorities for handling, and they will investigate the truth as soon as possible.

examples.chinese: 这位歌手用她独特的嗓音歌唱了许多经典民族歌曲，赢得了观众的热烈掌声。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi gēshǒu yòng tā dúté de sǎngyīn gēchàng le xǔduō jīngdiǎn mínzú gēqū, yíngdéle guānzhòng de règuó zhǎngsheng.
examples.english: This singer sang many classic folk songs with her unique voice, earning warm applause from the audience.

examples.chinese: 媒体对这位政治家的激烈攻击引发了公众的广泛讨论。
examples.pinyin: Méitǐ duì zhè wèi zhèngzhìjiā de jīliè gōngjī yǐnfāle gōngzhòng de guǎngfàn tǎolùn.
examples.english: The media's fierce attack on this politician sparked widespread public discussion.

examples.chinese: 由于原材料短缺，工厂的生产能力受到了供给不足的严重制约。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yuáncái liào duǎnquē, gōngchǎng de shēngchǎn nénghuà shòudàole gōngjǐ búzú de yánzhòng zhìyuē.
examples.english: Due to a shortage of raw materials, the factory's production capacity has been severely constrained by insufficient supply.

examples.chinese: 宫教授在这所大学教了二十多年的中文文学。
examples.pinyin: Gōng jiàoshòu zài zhè suǒ dàxué jiāo le èrshí duō nián de zhōngwén wénxué.
examples.english: Professor Gong has been teaching Chinese literature at this university for over twenty years.

examples.chinese: 这位公主为了国家的和平，不得不放弃自己的幸福，嫁给了邻国的王子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi gōngzhǔ wèile guójiā de héhépíng, búdébúzhǐ fàngqì zìjǐ de xìngfú, jiàgěile língguó de wángzǐ.
examples.english: In order to secure peace for her nation, this princess had no choice but to give up her own happiness and marry the neighboring country's prince.

examples.chinese: 公司通过不断创新来巩固自己在市场上的领先地位。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī tōngguò búduàn chuàngxīn lái gǒnggù zìjǐ zài shìchǎng shàng de lǐngx先 dìwèi.
examples.english: The company consolidates its leading position in the market through continuous innovation.

examples.chinese: 这位科学家为人类医学事业做出了巨大的贡献，他的研究成果拯救了千万人的生命。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi kēxuéjiā wèi rénlèi yīxué shìyè zuò chūle jùdà de gòngxiàn, tā de yánjiū chéngguǒ zhěngjiùle qiānwàn rén de shēngmìng.
examples.english: This scientist made a tremendous contribution to human medical science; his research achievements saved the lives of millions of people.

examples.chinese: 在这个繁华的城市里，他感到了前所未有的孤独，尽管周围人来人往。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège繁华 de chéngshì lǐ, tā gǎndàole qiánsuǒwèiyǒu de gūdú, jǐnguǎn zhōuwéi rénláirénwǎng.
examples.english: In this bustling city, he felt an unprecedented loneliness, despite the crowds of people around him.

examples.chinese: 这部电影讲述了一个孤儿通过自己的努力最终改变了命运的故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎngshù le yīgè gūér tōngguò zìjǐ de nǔlì zuìzh終gǎibiàn le mìngyùn de gùshì.
examples.english: This film tells the story of an orphan who changed his fate through his own efforts.

examples.chinese: 她对古典音乐的热情使得许多人重新认识到传统艺术的价值。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì gǔdiǎn yīnyuè de règing shǐde xǔduō rén chóngxīn rènshi dào chuántǒng yìshù de jiàzhí.
examples.english: Her passion for classical music has made many people re-recognize the value of traditional art.

examples.chinese: 为了应对气候变化，各国需要构建更加完善的国际合作机制。
examples.pinyin: Wèile yīngduì qìhòu biànhuà, gèguó xūyào gòujiàn更加 wánshàn de guójì hézuò jīzhì.
examples.english: In order to address climate change, countries need to construct more comprehensive international cooperation mechanisms.

examples.chinese: 这家公司的股票在过去一年里上涨了三倍，吸引了许多投资者。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī de gǔpiào zài guòqù yī nián lǐ shàngle sān bèi, xīyǐnle xuǔduō tóuzīzhě.
examples.english: The stock of this company has tripled over the past year, attracting many investors.

examples.chinese: 我姑姑在国外工作多年，这次回国特意来看望我们全家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gūgu zài guówaì gōngzuò duō nián, zhè cì huíguó tèyì lái kànwàng wǒmen quánjiā.
examples.english: My paternal aunt has been working abroad for many years, and this time she came back specifically to visit our entire family.

examples.chinese: 投资者需要了解市场风险，不能盲目购买股票。
examples.pinyin: Tóuzīzhěyuán xūyào liǎojiě shìchǎng fēngxiǎn, búnéng mángmù gòumǎi gǔpiào.
examples.english: Investors need to understand market risks and cannot blindly purchase stocks.

examples.chinese: 由于服务器故障，公司损失了大约一百万元的交易数据。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú fúwùqì gùzhàng, gōngsī sǔnshīle dàyuē yībǎi wàn yuán de jiāoyì shùjù.
examples.english: Due to a server malfunction, the company lost approximately one million yuan worth of transaction data.

examples.chinese: 他匆匆忙忙地走过去，都没有顾一下周围的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā cōngcōng-mángmáng de zǒuguòqù, dōu méiyǒu gù yīxià zhōuwéi de rén.
examples.english: He rushed past without even glancing at the people around him.

examples.chinese: 昨晚刮起了很大的风，几乎把整条街道的垃圾都吹散了。
examples.pinyin: Zuówan guāqǐle hěn dà de fēng, jīhū bǎ zhěng tiáo jiēdào de lèsè dōu chuīsǎnle.
examples.english: Last night a strong wind blew up and scattered garbage all over the street.

examples.chinese: 沿着这条街往前走，在红绿灯处向左拐，就能看到那家著名的餐厅。
examples.pinyin: Yánzhe zhè tiáo jiē wǎng qián zǒu, zài hónglǜdēng chù xiàng zuǒ guǎi, jiù néng kàndào nàjiā zhùmíng de cāntīng.
examples.english: Walk straight ahead along this street, and turn left at the traffic light, then you'll be able to see that famous restaurant.

examples.chinese: 作为父母，我们有责任去关爱每一个孩子的身心健康发展。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi fùmǔ, wǒmen yǒu zérèn qù guānài měi yī ge háizi de shēnxīn jiànkāng fāzhǎn.
examples.english: As parents, we have the responsibility to care for every child's physical and mental health development.

examples.chinese: 这些经济数据与股市波动有着密切的关联，投资者需要密切关注。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē jīngjì shùjù yǔ gǔshì bōdòng yǒuzhe mìqiè de guānlián, tóuzizhězhě xūyào mìqiè guānzhù.
examples.english: These economic data are closely related to stock market fluctuations, and investors need to pay close attention.

examples.chinese: 这个周末，许多游客涌入古镇观光，导致景区人满为患。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò, xǔduō yóukè yǒngrù gǔzhèn guānguāng, dǎozhì jǐngqū rénmǎnwéihuàn.
examples.english: This weekend, many tourists flocked to the ancient town for sightseeing, causing the scenic area to be overcrowded.

examples.chinese: 他们因为房产纠纷打了多年的官司，最后还是决定和解了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yīnwèi fángchǎn jiūn纷 dǎle duō nián de guānsi, zuìhòu háishi juéding héjiě le.
examples.english: They had been in a lawsuit for years over a property dispute, but finally decided to settle it.

examples.chinese: 这个城市的供水管道系统已经老化，急需进行全面的基础设施改革。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de gōngshuǐ guǎndào xìtǒng yǐjīng lǎohuà, jíxū jìnxíng quánmiàn de jīchǔ shèshī gǎigé.
examples.english: The city's water supply pipeline system has already aged and urgently needs comprehensive infrastructure renovation.

examples.chinese: 随着改革开放，中国市场的发展前景变得越来越广阔。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe gǎigé kāifàng, Zhōngguó shìchǎng de fāzhǎn qiánjǐng biàn de yuèláiyuè guǎngkuò.
examples.english: With the reform and opening-up, the development prospects of the Chinese market have become increasingly vast.

examples.chinese: 这位激进的股东在股东大会上提出了一系列激进的改革方案。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jījìn de gǔdōng zài gǔdōng dàhuì shang tíchūle yī xìliè jījìn de gǎigé fāng'àn.
examples.english: This activist shareholder proposed a series of aggressive reform proposals at the shareholders' meeting.

examples.chinese: 这位科学家用他的研究成果为国家增添了光辉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi kēxuéjiā yòng tā de yánjiū chéngguǒ wèi guójiā zēngtiānle guānghuī.
examples.english: This scientist added radiance to the country through his research achievements.

examples.chinese: 这家公司已经逐步走上了健康发展的轨道，市场份额也在稳步增长。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yǐjīng zhúbù zǒushàngle jiànkāng fāzhǎn de guǐdào, shìchǎng fènʻé yě zài wěnbù zēngzhǎng.
examples.english: This company has gradually gotten onto the track of healthy development, and its market share is also steadily increasing.

examples.chinese: 他跪地请求原谅,但她转身离开了,没有回头看他一眼。
examples.pinyin: Tā guì dì qǐngqiú yuánliàng, dàn tā zhuǎnshēn líkāi le, méiyǒu huítou kàn tā yī yǎn.
examples.english: He knelt down to beg for forgiveness, but she turned and left without looking back at him once.

examples.chinese: 随着技术的进步，越来越多的消费者开始认可国产品牌的质量和创新能力。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe jìshù de jìnbù, yuèláiyuè duō de xiāofèizhě kāishǐ rènkě guóchǎn pǐnpái de zhìliàng hé chuàngxīn néng力。
examples.english: As technology advances, more and more consumers are beginning to recognize the quality and innovation capabilities of domestic brands.

examples.chinese: 挪威国会最近通过了一项关于气候变化的重要法案。
examples.pinyin: Nuó wēi guóhuì zuìjìn tōngguòle yī xiàng guānyú qìhòu biànhuà de zhòngyào fǎ'àn.
examples.english: The Norwegian Storthing recently passed an important bill on climate change.

examples.chinese: 每年国庆节，街道两旁都会悬挂五星红旗，整个城市被国旗装扮得格外庄严。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián guóqìng jié, jiēdào liǎng páng dōu huì xuánguà wǔxīng hóngqí, zhěnggè chéngshì bèi guóqí zhuāngbàn de géwài zhuāngyán.
examples.english: Every National Day, five-star red flags are hung on both sides of the streets, and the entire city is decorated by the national flag to look especially solemn.

examples.chinese: 这位国王以其睿智的决策和仁慈的统治赢得了全国人民的尊敬。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi guówáng yǐ qī ruìzhì de juécè hé réncí de tǒngzhì yíngdéle quánguó rénmín de zūnjìng.
examples.english: This king won the respect of the entire nation's people through his wise decisions and benevolent rule.

examples.chinese: 这家面包店自制的草莓果酱因为不含防腐剂，所以保质期相对较短。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā miànbāo diàn zìzhì de cǎoméi guǒjiàng yīnwèi búhán fángfǔ jì, suǒyǐ bǎozhì qī xiāngduì jiào duǎn.
examples.english: The homemade strawberry jam at this bakery has a relatively short shelf life because it contains no preservatives.

examples.chinese: 这片山区的果树种植业已经成为当地农民的主要收入来源。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn shānqū de guǒshù zhòngzhí yè yǐjīng chéngwéi dāngdì nóngmín de zhǔyào shōurù lái yuán.
examples.english: The fruit tree planting industry in this mountainous area has already become the main source of income for local farmers.

examples.chinese: 奥运会开幕式上，运动员们伴随着庄严的国歌声整齐地入场。
examples.pinyin: Àoyùnhuì kāimùshì shang, yùndòngyuáns men bànsuízhe zhuāngyán de guógē shēng zhěngqī de rùchǎng.
examples.english: At the opening ceremony of the Olympic Games, the athletes entered the venue in orderly formation accompanied by the solemn sound of the national anthem.

examples.chinese: 会议过后，领导们就开始讨论如何实施这项改革方案。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì guòhòu, lǐngdǎo men jiù kāishǐ tǎolùn rúhé shíshī zhè xiàng gǎigé fāng'àn.
examples.english: After the meeting, the leaders immediately began discussing how to implement this reform plan.

examples.chinese: 这个项目需要一个过渡期，才能从传统模式逐步转变到新的管理体系。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xūyào yīgè guòdù qī, cáinéng cóng chuántǒng móshì逐步 zhuǎnbiàn dào xīn de guǎnlǐ tǐxì.
examples.english: This project needs a transition period to gradually shift from the traditional model to a new management system.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的菜单设计得很随意，看起来就像一张廉价的海报。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cānting de càidān shèjì de hěn suíyì, kàn qǐlai jiùxiàng yī zhāng liánjià de hǎibào.
examples.english: The menu design of this restaurant is very casual, looking like a cheap throwaway poster.

examples.chinese: 这种设计理念虽然曾经流行，但现在看起来有点过时了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng shèjì lǐniàn suīrán céngjīng liúxíng, dàn xiànzài kàn qǐlai yǒudiǎn guòshí le.
examples.english: Although this design concept was once popular, it looks a bit old-fashioned now.

examples.chinese: 站在悬崖上，我看着汹涌的海浪不断拍打着礁石，感到自己的烦恼显得那么渺小。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài xuángyá shang, wǒ kànzhe xiōngyǒng de hǎilàng búduàn pāidǎ zhe jiāoshí, gǎndào zìjǐ de fánnǎo xiǎnde nàme miǎoxiǎo.
examples.english: Standing on the cliff, I watched the surging sea waves continuously crashing against the rocks, feeling that my worries seemed so insignificant.

examples.chinese: 随着经济全球化的发展，越来越多的中国企业开始在海外建立分支机构，以拓展国际市场。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì quánqiúhuà de fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de Zhōngguó qǐyè kāishǐ zài hǎiwài jiànlì fēnzhī jīgòu, yǐ tuòzhǎn guójì shìchǎng.
examples.english: With the development of economic globalization, more and more Chinese enterprises have begun to establish branch offices overseas to expand their international markets.

examples.chinese: 科学家们在海底发现了一个从未被记录过的新物种。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā men zài hǎidǐ fāxiàn le yī gè cóngwèi bèi jìlù guò de xīn wùzhǒng.
examples.english: Scientists discovered a previously undocumented new species on the seabed.

examples.chinese: 这位将军在海军服役了三十年，为国家的海上防御做出了巨大贡献。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàngjūn zài hǎijūn fúyì le sānshí nián, wèi guójiā de hǎishang fángyù zuòchū le jùdà gòngxiàn.
examples.english: This general served in the marine corps for thirty years and made tremendous contributions to the country's maritime defense.

examples.chinese: 随着全球气候变化，海洋酸化问题日益严重，威胁着海洋生态系统的未来。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe quánqiú qìhòu biànhuà, hǎiyáng suānhuà wèntí rìyì yánzhòng, wēixié zhe hǎiyáng shēngtài xìtǒng de wèilái.
examples.english: As global climate change accelerates, the problem of ocean acidification is becoming increasingly serious, threatening the future of marine ecosystems.

examples.chinese: 石油生产国在波斯湾的利益冲突引发了国际关注。
examples.pinyin: Shíyóu shēngchǎn guó zài Bōsī hǎiwān de lìyì chōn突 yǐnfāle guójì guānzhù.
examples.english: The conflicting interests of oil-producing countries in the Persian Gulf have attracted international attention.

examples.chinese: 经过医生的治疗，病人的病情已经明显好转，家属们终于松了一口气。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò yīshēng de zhìliáo, bìngrén de bìngqíng yǐjīng míngxiǎn hǎozhuǎn, jiāshǔ men终于 sōngle yī kǒuqì.
examples.english: After the doctor's treatment, the patient's condition has improved significantly, and the family members finally heaved a sigh of relief.

examples.chinese: 我好容易才找到了一个满意的工作，不想轻易放弃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hǎoróngyi cái zhǎodàole yī ge mǎnyì de gōngzuò, búxiǎng qīngyì fàngqì.
examples.english: I found a satisfactory job with great difficulty, and I don't want to give it up easily.

examples.chinese: 她从小就很好学，对任何事物都充满了好奇心，这也是她后来成为科学家的主要原因。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù hěn hàoxué, duì rènhé shìwù dōu chōngmǎnle hàoqixin, zhè yě shì tā hòuláy chéngwéi kēxuéjiā de zhǔyào yuányīn.
examples.english: She has been eager to study since childhood, and has been curious about everything, which is also the main reason she became a scientist.

examples.chinese: 他的沉默好似一堵墙，让我无法走进他的内心世界。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chénmò hǎosì yī du堵 qiáng, ràng wǒ wúfǎ zǒujìn tā de nèixīn shìjiè.
examples.english: His silence seems like a wall, making it impossible for me to enter his inner world.

examples.chinese: 这份合约的条款相当复杂,我们需要请律师仔细审查一下。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn héyuē de tiáokuǎn xiāngdāng fùzá, wǒmen xūyào qǐng lǜshī zǐx细 shěnchá yīxià.
examples.english: The terms of this contract are quite complex, so we need to have a lawyer review it carefully.

examples.chinese: 要想解决这个问题，我们必须抓住它的核心。
examples.pinyin: Yàoxiǎng jiějué zhège wèntí, wǒmen bìxū zhuāzhù tā de héxīn.
examples.english: To solve this problem, we must get to the heart of the matter.

examples.chinese: 在黑夜中行走时，我们需要格外小心，避免迷失方向。
examples.pinyin: Zài hēiyè zhōng xíngzǒu shí, wǒmen xūyào géwài xiǎoxin, bìmiǎn míshī fāngxiàng.
examples.english: When walking in the night, we need to be extra careful to avoid losing our way.

examples.chinese: 在这个多元化的社会中，不同文化背景的人需要相互尊重才能建立和谐的共存关系。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège duōyuánhuà de shèhuì zhōng, búntóng wénhuà bèijǐng de rén xūyào xiānghù zūnzhòng cáinéng jiànlì héxié de gòngcún guānxi.
examples.english: In this pluralistic society, people from different cultural backgrounds need to respect each other in order to establish harmonious coexistence.

examples.chinese: 这个项目能否成功，现在还很难说，要看后续的市场反应如何。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù néngfǒu chénggōng, xiànzài háishi hěn nánshuō, yào kàn hòuxùsuī de shìchǎng fǎnyìng rúhé.
examples.english: Whether this project will succeed is hard to say right now; it depends on how the market responds afterward.

examples.chinese: 这条横贯东西的高速公路大大缩短了两个城市之间的距离。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo héngguàn dōngxī de gāosù gōnglù dàdà suōcháng le liǎng ge chéngshì zhījiān de jùlí.
examples.english: This east-west highway that spans across the region significantly shortened the distance between the two cities.

examples.chinese: 在做出这个重大决定之前，我们需要衡量利弊得失，考虑所有可能的后果。
examples.pinyin: Zài zuòchū zhège zhòngdà juédìng zhīqián, wǒmen xūyào héngliang lìbì déshī, kǎolǜ suǒyǒu kěnéng de hòuguǒ.
examples.english: Before making this major decision, we need to weigh the pros and cons and consider all possible consequences.

examples.chinese: 他用了一个狠招，直接把竞争对手的市场份额夺走了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòngle yīge hěn zhāo, zhíjiē bǎ jìngjìng duìsh手 de shìchǎng fèn'é duó zǒu le.
examples.english: He used a ruthless move and directly snatched away his competitor's market share.

examples.chinese: 这位建筑师设计的新城市规划展现了一个宏大的愿景，将改变整个地区的发展格局。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiànzhúshī shèjì de xīn chéngshì guīhuà zhǎnxiàn le yī ge hóngdà de yuànjǐng, jiāng gǎibiàn zhěngge dìqū de fāzhǎn géjú.
examples.english: The architect's design for the new urban plan presents a grand vision that will transform the development pattern of the entire region.

examples.chinese: 去年的洪水摧毁了许多基础设施，使得当地经济遭受了巨大损失。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián de hónshuǐ cuīhuǐle xǔduō jīchǔ shèshī, shǐde dāngdì jīngjì zāoshòule jùdà sǔnshī.
examples.english: Last year's deluge destroyed a lot of infrastructure, causing the local economy to suffer enormous losses.

examples.chinese: 在这个论坛上，用户之间的互动越来越频繁，形成了一个充满活力的社区。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège lùntán shang, yònghùzhě zhījiān de hùdòng yuèláiyuè píngfán, xíngchéngle yī ge chōngmǎn huóli de shèqū.
examples.english: On this forum, the interaction between users has become increasingly frequent, forming a vibrant community.

examples.chinese: 在制定政策时，我们不能忽略任何一个细节，否则可能会带来严重的后果。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhìdìng zhèngcè shí, wǒmen búnéng hūlüè rènhé yī gè xìjié, fǒuzé kěnéng huì dàilái yánzhòng de hòuuǒ.
examples.english: When formulating policies, we cannot overlook any detail, otherwise it may lead to serious consequences.

examples.chinese: 长期在户外工作的人需要做好防晒措施，否则容易患皮肤癌。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī zài hùwài gōngzuò de rén xūyào zuòhǎo fángshài cuòshī, fǒuzé róngyì huàn pífu'ái.
examples.english: People who work outdoors for long periods need to take proper sun protection measures, otherwise they are prone to skin cancer.

examples.chinese: 政府采取了一系列措施来保护和维护文化遗产的完整性。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔle yī xìliè cuòshī lái bǎohù hé wéihù wénhuà yíchǎn de wánzhěngxìng.
examples.english: The government has taken a series of measures to protect and maintain the integrity of cultural heritage.

examples.chinese: 这个花瓶虽然看起来很精美，但它只是用来装饰的摆设，实际上并没有什么实用价值。
examples.pinyin: Zhège huāpíng suīrán kàn qǐlai hěn jīngměi, dàn tā zhǐshì yònglái zhuāngshì de băishè, shíjì shang bìng méiyǒu shénme shíyòng jiàzhí.
examples.english: Although this flower vase looks quite exquisite, it's merely a decorative ornament with no practical value in reality.

examples.chinese: 这个项目花费了公司大量的时间和资源，但最终获得了丰厚的回报。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù huāfèi le gōngsī dàliàng de shíjiān hé zīyuán, dàn zuìzh终 huòdé le fēnghòu de huíbào.
examples.english: This project consumed a lot of the company's time and resources, but ultimately yielded substantial returns.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的花生酱做得很地道，我每次来都会点他们的花生黄瓜凉菜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de huāshēng jiàng zuò de hěn dìdào, wǒ měi cì lái dōu huì diǎn tāmen de huāshēng huángguā liángcài.
examples.english: This restaurant's peanut sauce is very authentic, and I always order their peanut and cucumber cold dish whenever I come here.

examples.chinese: 通过坦诚的沟通，两国领导人成功化解了这场贸易争端。
examples.pinyin: Tōngguò tǎnchéng de gōutōng, liǎng guó lǐngdǎo rén chénggōng huàjiě le zhè chǎng màoyì zhēnduān.
examples.english: Through candid communication, the leaders of the two countries successfully resolved this trade dispute.

examples.chinese: 他总是幻想有一天能够实现自己的梦想，但从未付出实际行动。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì huànxiǎng yǒu yītiān nénggòu shíxiàn zìjǐ de梦想，dàn cóngwèi付出 shíjì xíngdòng.
examples.english: He always imagines that one day he can realize his dreams, but he has never taken any actual action.

examples.chinese: 这把老紫砂壶已经传了三代，每次用它泡茶都能品出不同的韵味。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǎ lǎo zǐshā hú yǐjīng chuánle sān dài, měi cì yòngtā paochá dōu néng pǐnchū búfǔng de yùnwèi.
examples.english: This old Yixing teapot has been passed down through three generations, and every time I use it to brew tea, I can taste different subtle flavors.

examples.chinese: 医生需要耐心地向患者解释治疗方案，确保他们充分理解可能的风险和益处。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng xūyào nàix心地xiàng huànzhě jiěshì zhìliáo fāng'àn, quèbǎo tāmen ch充fèn lǐjiě kěnéng de fēngxiǎn hé yìchǔ.
examples.english: Doctors need to patiently explain the treatment plan to patients to ensure they fully understand the possible risks and benefits.

examples.chinese: 对于这些批评，公司负责人很快做出了回应，承诺会改进产品质量。
examples.pinyin: Duìyú zhèxiē pípíng, gōngsī fùzérén hěnkuài zuòchūle huíyìng, chéngnuò huì gǎijìn chǎnpǐn zhìliàng.
examples.english: In response to these criticisms, the company's director quickly made a statement and promised to improve product quality.

examples.chinese: 这位皇帝在位期间推行了一系列改革，深刻影响了整个帝国的政治制度。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi huángdì zài wèi qījiān tuīxíng le yī xìliè gǎigé, shēnkè yǐngxiǎng le zhěngge帝guó de zhèngzhì zhìdù.
examples.english: This emperor implemented a series of reforms during his reign that profoundly influenced the political system of the entire empire.

english: to meet with (sb who is paying a visit)

examples.chinese: 总经理明天会见来自欧洲的投资者，讨论合作项目的细节。
examples.pinyin: Zǒng jīnglǐ míngtiān huìjiàn lái zì Ōuzhōu de tóuzīzhě, tǎolùn hézuò xiàngmù de xìjié.
examples.english: The general manager will meet with investors from Europe tomorrow to discuss the details of the cooperation project.

examples.chinese: 作为学生会会长，她需要处理很多复杂的行政事务，同时还要平衡学业和社团工作。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi xuéshenghuì huìzhǎng, tā xūyào chǔlǐ hěnduō fùzá de xíngzhèng shìwù, tóngshí háiyào pínghéng xuéyè hé shètuán gōngzuò.
examples.english: As the president of the student council, she needs to handle many complex administrative affairs while also balancing her studies and club work.

examples.chinese: 这场战争毁了整个城市的经济，需要很多年才能恢复。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng zhànzhēng huǐle zhěngge chéngshì de jīngjì, xūyào hěnduō nián cái néng huīfù.
examples.english: This war destroyed the city's entire economy, and it will take many years to recover.

examples.chinese: 他们几个年轻人经常在一起混，整天无所事事。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen jǐ ge niánqīng rén jīngcháng zài yīqǐ hùn, zhěngtiān wúsuǒ shìshì.
examples.english: Those young people often hang around together, doing nothing all day.

examples.chinese: 这位艺术家用独特的技法将传统绘画与现代元素完美融合在一起。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yìshùjiā yòng dúté de jìfǎ jiāng chuántǒng huìhuà yǔ xiàndài yuánsù wánměi rónghé zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: This artist skillfully blended traditional painting with modern elements using a unique technique.

examples.chinese: 由于管理不善，公司的财务状况陷入了严重的混乱。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú guǎnlǐ búshàn, gōngsī de cáiwù zhuàngkuàng xiànrù le yánzhòng de hùnluàn.
examples.english: Due to poor management, the company's financial situation fell into serious disorder.

examples.chinese: 这个项目混合了传统工艺和现代技术，取得了意想不到的成功。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù hùnhéle chuántǒng gōngyì hé xiàndài jìshù, qǔdéle yìxiǎng búdào de chénggōng.
examples.english: This project combined traditional craftsmanship with modern technology and achieved unexpected success.

examples.chinese: 这位年轻的企业家在商业圈里非常活跃，经常参加各种行业论坛和投资会议。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi niánqīng de qǐyèjiā zài shāngyè quānli fēicháng huóyuè, jīngcháng cānjiā gèzhǒng hángyè lùntán hé tóuzī huìyì.
examples.english: This young entrepreneur is very active in the business circle and frequently participates in various industry forums and investment conferences.

examples.chinese: 随着科技的进步，中国的火箭技术已经达到了世界先进水平。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de jìnbù, Zhōngguó de huǒjiàn jìshù yǐjīng dádàole shìjiè xiāngjìn shuǐpíng.
examples.english: With the advancement of technology, China's rocket technology has reached advanced levels in the world.

examples.chinese: 在城市中心，机动车的排放量已经成为影响空气质量的主要因素。
examples.pinyin: Zài chéngshì zhōngxīn, jīdòngchē de pāifàngliàng yǐjīng chéngwéi yǐngxiǎng kōngqì zhìliàng de zhǔyào yīnsù.
examples.english: In the city center, the emissions from motor vehicles have already become a major factor affecting air quality.

examples.chinese: 他整天昏昏沉沉的，医生说可能是睡眠不足导致的。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhěngtiān hūnhūn chénchén de, yīshēng shuō kěnéng shì shuìmián búzú dǎozhì de.
examples.english: He's been muddle-headed all day long, and the doctor said it's probably caused by insufficient sleep.

examples.chinese: 这个贪污案件的背后隐藏着一个复杂的权力机关。
examples.pinyin: Zhège tānwū ànjiàn de bèihòu yǐncáng zhe yīgè fùzá de quánlì jīguān.
examples.english: Behind this corruption case lies a complex government mechanism.

examples.chinese: 在欧洲历史上，基督教的传播深刻影响了整个文明的发展进程。
examples.pinyin: Zài Ōuzhōu lìshǐ shang, jīdūjiào de chuánbō shēnkè yǐngxiǎngle zhěngge wénmíng de fāzhǎn jìnchéng.
examples.english: Throughout European history, the spread of Christianity profoundly influenced the development process of the entire civilization.

examples.chinese: 这家工厂的机械设备已经过时了，需要进行现代化改造。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng de jīxiè shèbèi yǐjīng guòshí le, xūyào jìnxíng xiàndàihuà gǎizào.
examples.english: The mechanical equipment in this factory is already outdated and needs to be modernized.

examples.chinese: 他用激情和执着追求自己的艺术梦想，最终成为了一名杰出的导演。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng jīqíng hé zhízháo zhuīqiú zìjǐ de yìshù梦想, zuìzh終chéng le yī míng jiéchū de dǎoyǎn.
examples.english: He pursued his artistic dreams with passion and perseverance, eventually becoming an outstanding director.

examples.chinese: 在春节期间，人们喜欢在家里贴上吉祥的对联和装饰品，祈祷新的一年能够平安顺利。
examples.pinyin: Zài chūnjié qījiān, rénmen xǐhuān zài jiālǐ tiē shang jíxiáng de duìlián hé zhuāngshìpǐn, qídào xīn de yī nián nénggoù píng'ān shùnlì.
examples.english: During the Spring Festival, people like to paste auspicious couplets and decorations at home, praying that the new year will be peaceful and smooth.

examples.chinese: 他对待工作的态度有点极端，要么全力以赴，要么彻底放弃。
examples.pinyin: Tā duìdài gōngzuò de tàidù yǒudiǎn jíduān, yàome quánlì yǐ fù, yàome chèdǐ fàngqì.
examples.english: His attitude toward work is somewhat extreme—either he commits fully or gives up completely.

examples.chinese: 在偏远山区，缺乏及时的急救设施往往会导致患者错过黄金抢救时间。
examples.pinyin: Zài piānyuǎn shānqū, quēfá jíshí de jíjiù shèshī wǎngwǎng huì dǎozhì huànzhě cuòguò huángjīn qiǎngjiù shíjiān.
examples.english: In remote mountainous areas, the lack of timely first aid facilities often causes patients to miss the golden window for rescue.

examples.chinese: 这部纪录片集中展现了中国传统文化的精髓。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn jízhōng zhǎnxiàn le Zhōngguó chuántǒng wénhuà de jīngsuǐ.
examples.english: This documentary concentrates on showcasing the essence of traditional Chinese culture.

examples.chinese: 随着医疗技术的进步，许多曾经的绝症疾病现在都能得到有效的治疗。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe yīliào jìshù de jìnbù, xǔduō céngjīng de juézhèng jíbìng xiànzài dōu néng huòdào yǒuxiào de zhìliáo.
examples.english: With the advancement of medical technology, many previously incurable diseases can now be effectively treated.

examples.chinese: 这家餐饮公司计划在未来三年内加盟五十家分店，以扩大市场占有率。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cānyǐn gōngsī jìhuà zài wèilái sān nián nèi jiāméng wǔshí jiā fēn店，yǐ kuòdà shìchǎng zhànnyǒu lǜ。
examples.english: The catering company plans to franchise fifty branches within the next three years to expand its market share.

examples.chinese: 吉利汽车近年来在新能源车领域的表现令人印象深刻，市场份额不断增长。
examples.pinyin: Jílì qìchē jìnnián lái zài xīn néngliàng chē lǐngyù de biǎoxiàn lìngrén yìnxiàng shēnkè, shìchǎng fèn'é búduàn zēngzhǎng.
examples.english: In recent years, Geely's performance in the new energy vehicle sector has been impressive, with its market share continuously growing.

examples.chinese: 随着生活水平的提高，越来越多的消费者愿意购买高端家电来改善家居体验。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe shēnghuó shuǐpíng de tígāo, yuèláiyuè duō de xiāofèizhě yuànyì gòumǎi gāoduān jiādiàn lái gǎishàn jiājū tǐyàn.
examples.english: As living standards improve, more and more consumers are willing to purchase high-end household appliances to enhance their home living experience.

examples.chinese: 我们需要共同努力保护地球这个共同的家园，为后代留下美好的环境。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào gòngtóng nǔlì bǎohù dìqiú zhège gòngtóng de jiāyuán, wèi hòudài liúxià měihǎo de huánjìng.
examples.english: We need to work together to protect the Earth, our common home, and leave a beautiful environment for future generations.

examples.chinese: 这次论坛邀请了来自世界各地的知名专家作为嘉宾，为我们分享最新的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì lùntán yāoqǐngle lái zì shìjiè gèdì de zhīmíng zhuānjiā zuòwéi jiābīn, wèi wǒmen fēnxiǎng zuìxīn de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: This forum invited renowned experts from around the world as esteemed guests to share their latest research findings with us.

examples.chinese: 这次失败的经历给予了我宝贵的人生启示。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài de jīngyàn jǐyǔle wǒ báoguì de rénshēng qǐshì.
examples.english: This experience of failure gave me valuable life lessons.

examples.chinese: 许多人喜欢在假日里远离城市的喧嚣，去山区寻求内心的宁静。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō rén xǐhuān zài jiàrì lǐ yuǎnl离 chéngshì de xuānxiao, qù shānqū xúnqiú nèixīn de níngjìng.
examples.english: Many people like to escape the hustle and bustle of the city during holidays and seek inner peace in mountainous areas.

examples.chinese: 政府需要加强对食品安全的监督，确保消费者的健康权益。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ xūyào jiāqiáng duì shí品 ānquán de jiāndū, quèbǎo xiāofèizhě de jiànkāng quányì.
examples.english: The government needs to strengthen supervision of food safety to ensure consumers' health rights.

examples.chinese: 医院需要持续监测患者的血压变化，以便及时调整治疗方案。
examples.pinyin: Yīyuàn xūyào chíxù jiāncè huànzhě de xuèyā biànhuà, yǐbiàn jíshí tiáozhěng zhìliáo fāng'àn.
examples.english: The hospital needs to continuously monitor changes in the patient's blood pressure in order to adjust the treatment plan in time.

examples.chinese: 他在街道上捡到了一个装满现金的钱包，毫不犹豫地交给了警察。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài jiēdào shang jiǎndàole yīge zhuāng mǎn xiànjīn de qiánbāo, háobù yóyù de jiāogěile jǐngchá.
examples.english: He picked up a wallet full of cash on the street and immediately handed it over to the police without hesitation.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的简介听起来很吸引人，但我看了以后觉得有点失望。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jiǎnjiè tīng qǐlai hěn xīyǐnrén, dàn wǒ kàn le yǐhòu juéde yǒudiǎn shīwàng.
examples.english: The brief introduction of this movie sounds quite appealing, but after watching it, I felt a bit disappointed.

examples.chinese: 这位武侠小说里的剑客用一把古老的剑创造了许多传奇故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi wǔxiá xiǎoshuō lǐ de jiànkè yòng yī bǎ gǔlǎo de jiàn chuàngzào le xǔduō chuányì gùshì.
examples.english: This swordsman in the martial arts novel created many legendary stories with an ancient sword.

examples.chinese: 这幅画的真伪需要由专业的艺术家来鉴定，不能凭肉眼判断。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà de zhēnwěi xūyào yóu zhuānyè de yìshùjiā lái jiàndìng, búnéng píng ròuyǎn pànduàn.
examples.english: The authenticity of this painting needs to be appraised by professional artists; it cannot be judged by the naked eye alone.

examples.chinese: 他像离弦的箭一样冲出去，生怕错过这个机会。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiàng líxián de jiàn yīyàng chōngchūqù, shēngpà cuòguò zhège jīhuì.
examples.english: He rushed out like an arrow leaving the bowstring, afraid of missing this opportunity.

examples.chinese: 这个将军问题困扰了我们整个团队好几个月。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiāngjūn wèntí kùnrǎole wǒmen zhěngge tuánduì hǎo jǐ ge yuè.
examples.english: This major problem has been troubling our entire team for several months.

examples.chinese: 教授讲课的风格虽然传统，但他深厚的学术功底使得学生们始终保持高度的专注。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu jiǎngkè de fēnggé suīrán chuántǒng, dàn tā shēnhòu de xuéshù gōngdǐ shǐdé xuéshengmen始终 bǎochí gāodù de zhuānzhù.
examples.english: Although the professor's teaching style is traditional, his profound academic foundation keeps students highly engaged.

examples.chinese: 这道菜需要用上好的豆酱来调味，才能体现出传统的风味。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài xūyào yòng shànghǎo de dòujiàng lái tiáowèi, cáinéng tǐxiànchūlái chuántǒng de fēngwèi.
examples.english: This dish needs to be seasoned with high-quality soybean paste to bring out its traditional flavor.

examples.chinese: 他因为自己的成就而感到骄傲，但这种骄傲很快就被现实的挑战所打击。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi zìjǐ de chéngjiù érhuà gǎndào jiāoào, dàn zhè zhǒng jiāoào hěnkuài jiù bèi xiànshí de tiǎozhàn suǒ dǎjī.
examples.english: He felt proud of his achievements, but this pride was soon dampened by real challenges.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的招牌菜用的酱油都是从日本进口的，难怪味道这么独特。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de zhāopái cài yòngde jiàngyóu dōu shì cóng Rìběn jìnkǒu de, nánguài wèidào zhème dúte.
examples.english: No wonder this restaurant's signature dishes taste so unique—they import all their soy sauce from Japan.

examples.chinese: 媒体的焦点集中在这位新任CEO如何扭转公司的颓势上。
examples.pinyin: Méitǐ de jiāodiǎn jízhōng zài zhè wèi xīnrèn CEO rúhé niǔzhuǎn gōngsī de tuísè shang.
examples.english: The media's focal point is concentrated on how the newly appointed CEO will reverse the company's declining situation.

examples.chinese: 这位批评家用尖锐的言辞指出了这部电影的缺陷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi pīpíngjiā yòng jiānruì de yáncí zhǐchūle zhè bù diànyǐng de quēxiàn.
examples.english: This critic pointed out the film's flaws with sharp criticism.

examples.chinese: 侦探仔细检查了现场的每一个脚印，希望能找到犯罪分子的线索。
examples.pinyin: Zhēntàn zǐxì jiǎnchá le xiànchǎng de měi yī gè jiǎoyìn, xīwàng néng zhǎodào fànzuì fènzǐ de xiànsuǒ.
examples.english: The detective carefully examined every footprint at the crime scene, hoping to find clues about the criminal.

examples.chinese: 那座古老的教堂在城市改革中被保护下来，成为了重要的文化遗产。
examples.pinyin: Nà zuò gǔlǎo de jiàotáng zài chéngshì gǎigé zhōng bèi bǎohù xiàlái, chéngwéile zhòngyào de wénhuà yíchǎn.
examples.english: That ancient tabernacle was preserved during the city's renovation and became an important cultural heritage.

examples.chinese: 教育部最近发布了新的高考改革方案，引起了社会各界的广泛讨论。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoyùbù zuìjìn fābuāle xīnde gāokǎo gǎigé fāng'àn, yǐnqǐle shèhuì gèjiè de guǎng泛 tǎolùn.
examples.english: The Ministry of Education recently released a new college entrance examination reform plan, which has sparked widespread discussion across society.

examples.chinese: 公司已经接收了来自客户的所有反馈意见，现在正在进行深入的分析和评估。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yǐjīng jiēshōule láizì kèhù de suǒyǒu fǎnkuì yìjiàn, xiànzài zhèngzài jìnxíng shēnrù de fēnxī hé píngū.
examples.english: The company has received all feedback from customers and is now conducting in-depth analysis and evaluation.

examples.chinese: 在街头采访时，记者发现许多年轻人对政治问题漠不关心。
examples.pinyin: Zài jiētóu cǎifǎng shí, jìzhě fāxiàn xǔduō niánqīngrén duì zhèngzhì wèntí màobù guānxīn.
examples.english: When conducting street interviews, the reporter found that many young people were indifferent to political issues.

examples.chinese: 我觉得这个决定可能会对公司的长期发展产生深远的影响。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhège juédìng kěnéng huì duì gōngsī de chángqī fāzhǎn chǎnshēng shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: I sense that this decision may have a profound impact on the company's long-term development.

examples.chinese: 今年的春节假期特别长，很多人都选择出国旅游。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de chūnjié jiàqī tèbié cháng, hěnduō rén dōu xuǎnzé chūguó lǚyóu.
examples.english: This year's Spring Festival holiday is particularly long, so many people have chosen to travel abroad.

examples.chinese: 许多人在节假日选择旅游，导致景区人满为患。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō rén zài jiéjiàrì xuǎnzé lǚyóu, dǎozhì jǐngqū rénmǎnwéikè.
examples.english: Many people choose to travel during public holidays, which causes tourist attractions to become overcrowded.

examples.chinese: 随着环保意识的提高，越来越多的企业开始投资节能技术来降低运营成本。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe huánbǎo yìshi de tíhigh, yuèláiyuè duō de qǐyè kāishǐ tóuzī jié néng jìshù lái jiàngdī yùnyíng chéngběn.
examples.english: As environmental awareness increases, more and more enterprises are beginning to invest in energy-saving technology to reduce operating costs.

examples.chinese: 这位科学家在量子物理领域的杰出贡献为整个学科带来了革命性的进展。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi kēxuéjiā zài liàngzǐ wùlǐ lǐngyù de jiéchū gòngxiàn wéi zhěnggè xuékē dàilái le gémìngxìng de jìnzhǎn.
examples.english: This scientist's outstanding contributions in the field of quantum physics brought revolutionary progress to the entire discipline.

examples.chinese: 他揭开了这个商业丑闻背后的真相，引起了社会的广泛关注。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiēkāile le zhège shāngyè chǒuwén bèihòu de zhēnxiàng, yǐnqǐle le shèhuì de guǎngfàn guānzhù.
examples.english: He exposed the truth behind this business scandal, which aroused widespread public attention.

examples.chinese: 报名截止时间是下周五，请不要错过。
examples.pinyin: bàomíng jiézhǐ shíjiān shì xiàzhōu wǔ, qǐng búyào cuòguò.
examples.english: The registration deadline is next Friday, please don't miss it.

examples.chinese: 这个复杂的数学问题困扰了我很久，直到我找到了一个巧妙的方法来解开它。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fùzá de shùxué wèntí kùnrǎo le wǒ hěnjiǔ, zhídào wǒ zhǎodào le yīgè qiǎomiào de fāngfǎ lái jiěkāi tā.
examples.english: This complex math problem bothered me for a long time, until I found a clever way to solve it.

examples.chinese: 这位专家在纪录片中详细解说了古代丝绸之路的贸易路线和文化交流。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhuānjiā zài jìlùpiàn zhōng xiáng细 jiěshuō le gǔdài sīchóu zhī lù de màoyì lùxiàn hé wénhuà jiāoliú.
examples.english: This expert explained in detail the trade routes and cultural exchanges of the ancient Silk Road in the documentary.

examples.chinese: 截至今年年底，我们公司的营业收入已经突破了五亿元。
examples.pinyin: Jiézhì jīnnián niándi底，wǒmen gōngsī de yíngyè shōuruì yǐjīng túpòle le wǔ yì yuán.
examples.english: By the end of this year, our company's revenue has already exceeded 500 million yuan.

examples.chinese: 科技与艺术的界限在当代社会变得越来越模糊。
examples.pinyin: Kējì yǔ yìshù de jièxiàn zài dāngdài shèhuì biàn de yuèláiyuè móhu.
examples.english: The boundary between technology and art has become increasingly blurred in contemporary society.

examples.chinese: 这笔投资的金额虽然很大，但考虑到长期回报，我们认为是值得的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ tóuzī de jīné suīrán hěn dà, dàn kǎolǜ dào chángqī huíhuò, wǒmen rènwéi shì zhídé de.
examples.english: Although the amount of this investment is quite large, considering the long-term returns, we believe it is worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 我们应该借鉴国外先进的管理经验，但也要结合本国的实际情况。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi jièjiàn guówaì xiāngjìn de guǎnlǐ jīngyàn, dàn yě yào jiéhé běnguó de shíjì qíngkuàng.
examples.english: We should learn from advanced foreign management experience, but also adapt it to our own national circumstances.

examples.chinese: 这件古董器皿是用金钱打造的，在拍卖会上获得了高价。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn gǔdǒng qìmǐn shì yòng jīnqián dǎzào de, zài pāimàihuì shang huòdéle gāojià.
examples.english: This antique vessel was crafted from pewter and fetched a high price at the auction.

examples.chinese: 他尽力争取这个机会，但最后还是没有成功。
examples.pinyin: Tā jìnlì zhēngqǔ zhège jīhuì, dàn zuìhòu háishi méiyǒu chénggōng.
examples.english: He exhausted his efforts to seize this opportunity, but ultimately he still didn't succeed.

examples.chinese: 敌军决定在黎明时分进攻我们的阵地，所以我们整夜都在做防御准备。
examples.pinyin: Díjūn juédìng zài líming shífen jìngōng wǒmen de zhèndi, suǒyǐ wǒmen zhěngyè dōu zài zuò fángyù zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: The enemy army decided to attack our position at dawn, so we spent the whole night preparing our defenses.

examples.chinese: 近日股市波动较大，许多投资者都在重新评估自己的投资策略。
examples.pinyin: Jìnrì gǔshì bōdòng jiào dà, xǔduō tóuzīzhě dōu zài chóngxīn píngūn zìjǐ de tóuzī cèlüè.
examples.english: In the past few days, the stock market has fluctuated significantly, and many investors have been reassessing their investment strategies.

examples.chinese: 他因为长期对着屏幕工作，年纪轻轻就患上了近视，不得不戴眼镜。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi chángqī duìzhe píngmù gōngzuò, niánjì qīngqīng jiù huànshàngle jìnshì, búdébuó dàiy眼镜。
examples.english: Because he worked facing screens for extended periods, he developed myopia at a young age and had to wear glasses.

examples.chinese: 这个科技公司在短短五年内取得了惊人的发展速度，已经成为行业的领导者。
examples.pinyin: Zhège kējì gōngsī zài duǎnduǎn wǔ nián nèi qǔdéle jīngrén de fāzhǎn sùdù, yǐjīng chéngwéile hángyè de lǐngdǎozhě.
examples.english: This tech company has achieved alarming growth speed in just five years and has already become a leader in the industry.

examples.chinese: 这位艺术家用了十年的时间才精心打磨出这件杰作，每一个细节都体现了他的精力和才华。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yìshùjiā yòngle shí nián de shíjiān cái jīngxīn dǎmó chū zhè jiàn jiéuzuò, měi yī ge细节 dōu tǐxiàn le tā de jīnglì hé cáihuá.
examples.english: It took this artist ten years to carefully craft this masterpiece, with every detail reflecting his energy and talent.

examples.chinese: 这件瓷器虽然年代久远，但保存得非常精美，堪称艺术珍品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn cíqì suīrán niándài jiǔyuǎn, dàn bǎocún de fēicháng jīngměi, kānchèng yìshù zhēnpǐn.
examples.english: Although this piece of porcelain is quite ancient, it has been preserved exquisitely and is considered an artistic treasure.

examples.chinese: 这家酒庄出产的葡萄酒被誉为精品，在国际比赛中屡获殊荣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā jiǔzhuāng chūchǎn de pútaojiǔ bèi yùyì wéi jīngpǐn, zài guójì bǐsài zhōng lǚ huò shūróng.
examples.english: The wines produced by this winery are regarded as premium products and have won numerous awards at international competitions.

examples.chinese: 这个古镇保留了许多明清时期的建筑，包括几口古井，见证了几百年的历史变迁。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǔzhèn bǎoliúle xǔduō míngqīng shíqī de jiànzhù, bāokuò jǐ kǒu gǔjǐng, jiànzhèngle jǐ bǎi nián de lìshǐ biànhuà.
examples.english: This ancient town has preserved many Ming and Qing dynasty buildings, including several old wells, which have witnessed centuries of historical changes.

examples.chinese: 收到朋友寄来的礼物时，她脸上露出了惊喜的表情。
examples.pinyin: Shōudào péngyou jìlái de lǐwù shí, tā liǎn shang lùchūle jīngxǐ de biǎoqíng.
examples.english: When she received the gift her friend sent, a surprised and delighted expression appeared on her face.

examples.chinese: 随着科技的发展，金融行业正在经历前所未有的变革。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de fāzhǎn, jīnróng hángyè zhèngzài jīng历 qiánsuǒ wèiyǒu de biànhuà.
examples.english: With the development of technology, the finance industry is undergoing unprecedented changes.

examples.chinese: 这座城市的主要景点大多集中在老城区，吸引了来自世界各地的游客。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de zhǔyào jǐngdiǎn dàduō jízhōng zài lǎo chéngqū, xīyǐnle lái zì shìjiè gèdì de yóukè.
examples.english: The main scenic spots of this city are mostly concentrated in the old district, attracting tourists from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 这两家公司因为合同条款产生了严重的纠纷，最后不得不诉诸法律解决。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī yīnwèi hétonɡ tiáokuǎn chǎnshēnɡle yánzhòu de jiūfēn, zuìhòu búdébuǒ sùsuō fǎlǜ jiějué.
examples.english: The two companies had serious disputes over contract clauses and ultimately had to resort to legal action to resolve them.

examples.chinese: 经理当众纠正了员工的错误做法，希望能改善公司的工作效率。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ dāngzhòng jiūzhèng le yuángōng de cuòwù zuòfǎ, xīwàng néng gǎishàn gōngsī de gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
examples.english: The manager corrected the employee's mistaken approach in front of everyone, hoping to improve the company's work efficiency.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的努力，他终于净化了自己的心灵，找到了内心的平静。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, tā zh終于 jìnghuà le zìjǐ de xīnlíng, zhǎodào le nèixīn de pínggjìng.
examples.english: After years of effort, he finally purified his soul and found inner peace.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的酒水价格虽然偏高，但品质确实值得这个价钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cānting de jiǔshuǐ jiàgé suīrán piānhigh, dàn pǐnzhì quèshí zhídé zhège jiàqian.
examples.english: Although the beverage prices at this restaurant are somewhat high, the quality is truly worth the price.

examples.chinese: 那位医生凭借先进的手术技术救命了许多濒临死亡的患者。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi yīshēng píngjiè xiāngjìn de shǒushù jìshù jiùmìngle xǔduō bīnlín sǐwáng de huànzhě.
examples.english: That doctor saved the lives of many patients on the brink of death through advanced surgical techniques.

examples.chinese: 地震发生后，救援队立即赶往灾区，争分夺秒地搜救被困人员。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn fāshēng hòu, jiùyuán duì lìjí gǎnwǎng zāiqū, zhēngfēnduómiǎo de sōujiù bèikùn rényuán.
examples.english: After the earthquake occurred, the rescue team immediately rushed to the disaster area, racing against time to search for and save trapped people.

examples.chinese: 政府已经向受灾地区提供了大量的救助资金和物资。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yǐjīng xiàng shòuhuài dìqū tígōngle dàliàng de jiùzhù zījīn hé wùzī.
examples.english: The government has already provided substantial financial aid and relief supplies to the disaster-stricken areas.

examples.chinese: 从山顶俯瞰，整个城市的夜景美得令人窒息。
examples.pinyin: Cóng shānding fǔkàn, zhěngge chéngshì de yèjǐng měi de lìngrén zhìxī.
examples.english: Looking down from the mountaintop, the night view of the entire city is breathtakingly beautiful.

examples.chinese: 就算你有再多的钱，也买不到真正的幸福。
examples.pinyin: Jiùsuàn nǐ yǒu zài duō de qián, yě mǎi bu dào zhēnzhèng de xìngfú.
examples.english: Even if you had ever more money, you still couldn't buy true happiness.

examples.chinese: 他虽然表面上同意了，但就是说，他心里根本不想参与这个项目。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán biǎomiàn shang tóngyìle, dàn jiùshìshuō, tā xīnlǐ gēnběn búxiǎng参与 zhège xiàngmù.
examples.english: Although he agreed on the surface, that is to say, he fundamentally didn't want to participate in this project.

examples.chinese: 据最新的研究数据显示，这个地区的经济增长率已经超过了全国平均水平。
examples.pinyin: Jù zuì xīn de yánjiū shùjù xiǎnshì, zhège dìqū de jīngjì zēngzhǎnglǜ yǐjīng chāoguòle quánguó pí均njūn shuǐpíng.
examples.english: According to the latest research data, the economic growth rate of this region has already exceeded the national average.

examples.chinese: 许多企业在灾难面前都积极捐款，这种社会责任感值得肯定。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō qǐyè zài zāinàn miànqián dōu jījí juānkuǎn, zhè zhǒng shèhuì zérèngan zhí de kěndìng.
examples.english: Many enterprises actively made donations in the face of disaster, and this sense of social responsibility deserves recognition.

examples.chinese: 这场棋局的胜负取决于最后的几步棋。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng qíjú de shèngfù qǔjué yú zuìhòu de jǐ bù qì.
examples.english: The outcome of this chess game depends on the last few moves.

examples.chinese: 在这次慈善晚宴上，许多企业家都慷慨地捐款支持教育事业的发展。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè cì císhàn wǎnyàn shang, xǔduō qǐyèjiā dōu kāngkǎi de juānkuǎn zhīchí jiàoyù shìyè de fāzhǎn.
examples.english: At this charity gala, many entrepreneurs generously donated money to support the development of education.

examples.chinese: 这位慈善家向贫困地区的学校捐赠了一大笔资金，帮助那些无法上学的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi císhàn jiā xiàng pinkùn dìqū de xuéxiào juānzèng le yī dà bǐ zījīn, bāngzhù nàxiē wúfǎ shàngxué de háizi.
examples.english: This philanthropist donated a large sum of money to schools in impoverished areas to help children who cannot afford to go to school.

examples.chinese: 许多企业积极捐助灾区的重建工作，希望能尽快恢复当地的经济发展。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō qǐyè jījí juānzhù zāiqū de chóngjiàn gōngzuò, xīwàng néng jìnkuài huīfù dāngdì de jīngjì fāzhǎn.
examples.english: Many enterprises actively donated to the reconstruction efforts in the disaster area, hoping to quickly restore the local economic development.

examples.chinese: 这部话剧获得了许多国际奖项的认可。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù huàjù huòdéle xǔduō guójì jiǎngxiàng de rènkě.
examples.english: This theatrical play has received recognition from many international awards.

examples.chinese: 公司的长期发展战略取决于管理层的决策是否正确。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de chángqī fāzhǎn zhànlüè qǔjuéyú guǎnlǐcéng de juécè shìfǒu zhèngquè.
examples.english: The company's long-term development strategy depends on whether the management's policy decisions are correct.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的挫折和反思，他终于觉悟到了生活的真正意义。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de cuòzhé hé fǎnsī, tā终于 juéwù dàole shēnghuó de zhēnzhèng yìyì.
examples.english: After years of setbacks and reflection, he finally came to understand the true meaning of life.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的结局绝妙，完全颠覆了我对整个故事的理解。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jiéjú juémiào, wánquán diānfù le wǒ duì zhěngge gùshì de lǐjiě.
examples.english: The ending of this movie is absolutely brilliant, completely overturning my understanding of the entire story.

examples.chinese: 绝大多数学生认为这次改革对他们的未来发展有很大帮助。
examples.pinyin: Juédàduōshù xuésheng rènwéi zhè cì gǎigé duì tāmen de wèilái fāzhǎn yǒu hěn dà bāngzhù.
examples.english: The vast majority of students believe that this reform will greatly help their future development.

examples.chinese: 这支舰队拥有多艘先进的军舰，足以保护我国的海上贸易安全。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī jiàn duì yōngyǒu duō sōu xiānhuà de jūnjiàn, zúyǐ bǎohù wǒ guó de hǎishang màoyì ānquán.
examples.english: This fleet possesses several advanced warships, which are sufficient to protect our country's maritime trade security.

examples.chinese: 这次国际冲突涉及复杂的军事战略和外交博弈。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì guójì chōn突 shè jí fùzá de jūnshì zhànlüè hé wàijiāo báoyì.
examples.english: This international conflict involves complex military strategy and diplomatic maneuvering.

examples.chinese: 这个国家的军队在国际维和任务中表现出了高度的专业精神。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā de jūnduì zài guójì wéihéhuà rènwu zhōng biǎoxiànchūle gāodù de zhuānyè jīngshén.
examples.english: The military personnel of this country demonstrated a high degree of professionalism in international peacekeeping missions.

examples.chinese: 这个智能家居系统可以让你用手机远程控制所有的灯光开关，非常方便。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhìnéng jiājū xìtǒng kěyǐ ràng nǐ yòng shǒujī yuǎnchéng kòngzhì suǒyǒu de dēngguāng kāiguān, fēicháng fāngbiàn.
examples.english: This smart home system allows you to remotely control all the light switches with your phone, which is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 这位企业家用创新的思维开创了一个全新的产业领域。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi qǐyèjiā yòng chuàngxīn de sīwéi kāichuàngle yī ge quánxīn de chǎnyè lǐngyù.
examples.english: This entrepreneur opened up an entirely new industrial sector with innovative thinking.

examples.chinese: 这个房间长期没有人住，我们需要打开窗户开通空气流通。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān chángqī méiyǒu rén zhù, wǒmen xūyào dǎkāi chuānghu kāitong kōngqì liútōng.
examples.english: This room has been unoccupied for a long time, so we need to open the windows to allow air circulation.

examples.chinese: 这家公司计划在五个城市开设新的分支机构，以扩大其市场份额。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī jìhuà zài wǔ ge chéngshì kāishè xīn de fēnzhī jīgòu, yǐ kuòdà qī shìchǎng fèneé.
examples.english: This company plans to open new branch offices in five cities in order to expand its market share.

examples.chinese: 为了赶上项目截止日期，整个团队这几天都在开夜车，大家都累得不行了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gǎnshang xiàngmù ji截zhǐ rìqī, zhěngge tuánduì zhè jǐ tiān dōu zài kāi yèchē, dàjiā dōu lèi de búxíng le.
examples.english: In order to meet the project deadline, the entire team has been burning the midnight oil these past few days, and everyone is exhausted.

examples.chinese: 从这个角度看，我们看得见城市的全景，但看不见细节。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhège jiǎodù kàn, wǒmen kàndéjiàn chéngshì de quánjǐng, dàn kànbujiàn xìjié.
examples.english: From this angle, we can see the full view of the city, but we cannot see the details.

examples.chinese: 这部小说的开头非常引人入胜，我一口气读了三章。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō de kāitóu fēicháng yǐnrén rùshèng, wǒ yīkǒuqì dúle sān zhāng.
examples.english: The beginning of this novel is extremely captivating; I read three chapters in one sitting.

examples.chinese: 从这个角度看，我们需要重新评估整个项目的可行性。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhège jiǎodù kàn, wǒmen xūyào chóngxīn píngguī zhěnggè xiàngmù de kěxíngxìng.
examples.english: From this perspective, we need to reassess the feasibility of the entire project.

examples.chinese: 由于人手不足，他被临时安排去看管仓库里的贵重物品。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú rénshǒu búzú, tā bèi línshí ānpái qù kānguǎn cāngkù lǐ de guìzhòng wùpǐn.
examples.english: Due to insufficient staff, he was temporarily assigned to look after the valuable items in the warehouse.

examples.chinese: 许多人把这次失败看作是一个重要的学习机会，而不是终点。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō rén bǎ zhè cì shībài kànzuò shì yī ge zhòngyào de xuéxí jīhuì, érbushì zhōngdiǎn.
examples.english: Many people look upon this failure as an important learning opportunity, rather than an endpoint.

examples.chinese: 经过几个月的治疗和康复训练，他终于能够重新回到工作岗位上。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè de zhìliáo he kāngfù xùnliàn, tā终于 néng gòu chóngxīn huídào gōngzuò gǎngwèi shang.
examples.english: After several months of treatment and rehabilitation training, he was finally able to return to his work position.

english: believe something/someone will be worthy in the future

examples.chinese: 我很看好这家初创公司，他们的产品创新能力特别强。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn kànhǎo zhè jiā chūshǐhuà gōngsī, tāmen de chǎnpǐn chuàngxīn néngliì tèbié qiáng.
examples.english: I'm very optimistic about this startup; their product innovation capability is particularly strong.

examples.chinese: 由于疫情的影响，今年的高考考场进行了严格的防疫措施，每个学生都必须佩戴口罩参加考试。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yìqíng de yǐngxiǎng, jīnnián de gāokǎo kǎochǎng jìnxíngले yánggé de fángyì cuòshī, měi ge xuésheng dōu bìxū pèidài kòuzhào cānjiā kǎoshì.
examples.english: Due to the impact of the epidemic, this year's college entrance exam rooms implemented strict epidemic prevention measures, and every student had to wear a mask to take the test.

examples.chinese: 许多环保组织对政府的环境政策提出了强烈的抗议。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō huánbǎo zǔzhī duì zhèngfǔ de huánjìng zhèngcè tíchūle qiángliè de kàngyì.
examples.english: Many environmental organizations lodged strong protests against the government's environmental policies.

examples.chinese: 这个项目获得了国家科研基金的支持，为期三年。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù huòdéle guójiā kēyán jījīn de zhīchí, wéiqī sān nián.
examples.english: This project received support from the national research fund for a period of three years.

examples.chinese: 这辆客车从北京出发，经过了五个小时的长途旅行才到达目的地。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng kèchē cóng běi jīng chūfā, jīngguòle wǔ ge xiǎoshí de chánggtú lǚxíng cái dàodá mùdìdì.
examples.english: This coach departed from Beijing and arrived at its destination after a five-hour long-distance journey.

examples.chinese: 这次考试的考题出得特别灵活，不少学生都反映题目超出了平时的复习范围。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì de kǎotí chūde tèbié línghuó, búshao xuésheng dōu fǎnyìng tímù chāochūle píngshí de fùxí fànwéi.
examples.english: The exam questions this time were particularly flexible and creative, and many students reflected that the questions went beyond the scope of their usual review.

examples.chinese: 随着技术的进步，许多国家都在加大对空军现代化的投入，以维护自己的空中安全。
examples.pinyin: Suí着jìshù de jìnbù, xǔduō guójiā dōu zài jiādà duì kōngjūn xiàndàihuà de tóuruò, yǐ wéihù zìjǐ de kōngzhōng ānquán.
examples.english: With technological advancement, many countries have been increasing their investment in air force modernization to maintain their own aerial security.

examples.chinese: 只要你肯付出努力，就一定能实现你的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ kěn fùchū nǔlì, jiù yīdìng néng shíxiàn nǐ de梦想.
examples.english: As long as you are willing to put in the effort, you will definitely be able to realize your dreams.

examples.chinese: 这次研究生入学考试的口试环节将考查学生的学术表达能力和临场反应。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì yánjiūshēng rùxué kǎoshì de kǒushì huánjié jiāng kǎochá xuésheng de xuéshù biǎodá nénghuà hé línchǎng fǎnyìng.
examples.english: The oral examination component of this graduate entrance exam will assess students' academic expression ability and on-the-spot reaction.

examples.chinese: 这件衣服的扣子掉了，我需要重新缝上去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de kòuzi diào le, wǒ xūyào chóngxīn féng shàngqu.
examples.english: A button fell off this piece of clothing, and I need to sew it back on.

examples.chinese: 这位杰出的领导人跨越了多个领域,在政治、商业和文化方面都取得了显著的成就。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiéchū de lǐngdǎo rén kuàyuè le duō ge lǐngyù, zài zhèngzhì, shāngyè hé wénhuà fāngmiàn dōu qǔdéle xiǎnzhù de chéngjiù.
examples.english: This outstanding leader spanned multiple fields and achieved remarkable accomplishments in politics, business, and culture.

examples.chinese: 这班快车虽然票价比较贵，但是能节省我们很多时间，还是值得的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bān kuàichē suīrán piàojià bǐjiào guì, dànshì néng jiéshěng wǒmen hěnduō shíjiān, háishi zhídé de.
examples.english: Although this express train is more expensive, it can save us a lot of time, so it's still worth it.

examples.chinese: 那个独裁者对反对者采取了极其酷烈的镇压措施。
examples.pinyin: Nàge dúcái zhě duì fǎnduì zhě cǎiqǔle jíqī kùliè de zhènYā cuòshī.
examples.english: The dictator took extremely ruthless suppression measures against those who opposed him.

examples.chinese: 这个地区蕴藏着丰富的矿产资源，吸引了许多大型采矿公司的投资。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yùncáng zhe fēngfù de kuàngchǎn zīyuán, xīyǐnle xǔduō dàxíng cǎikuàng gōngsī de tóuzī.
examples.english: This region contains abundant mineral resources, which has attracted investments from many large mining companies.

examples.chinese: 站在山顶上，眼前是一片宽阔的平原，延伸到远方的地平线。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài shānding shàng, yǎnqián shì yī piàn kuānkuò de pínyuán, yánshēn dào yuǎnfāng de dìpíngxiàn.
examples.english: Standing on the mountaintop, an expansive plain stretched out before my eyes, extending to the distant horizon.

examples.chinese: 他出身于一个阔绰的商人家庭，从小就见识了世面。
examples.pinyin: Tā chūshēn yú yī gè kuòchuò de shāngrén jiātíng, cóngxiǎo jiù jiànshi le shìmiàn.
examples.english: He came from a wealthy merchant family and was exposed to the ways of the world from a young age.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的商业合作，两家公司之间建立了密切的来往关系。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de shāngyè hézuò, liǎng jiā gōngsī zhījiān jiànlìle mìqiē de láiwang guānxi.
examples.english: After years of business cooperation, the two companies established a close association with each other.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的成功主要赖于团队的紧密合作和领导层的有力支持。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de chénggōng zhǔyào làiyú tuánduì de jǐnmì hézuò hé lǐngdǎocéng de yǒulì zhīchí.
examples.english: The success of this project mainly depends on the close cooperation of the team and the strong support from the leadership.

english: particle: used when informing sb. of st.; indicating excitement/doubt/comfort/etc.

examples.chinese: 别担心啦，这件事我已经替你处理好了。
examples.pinyin: Bié dānxin la, zhè jiàn shì wǒ yǐjīng tì nǐ chǔlǐ hǎo le.
examples.english: Don't worry about it! I've already taken care of this matter for you.

examples.chinese: 在这个污染日益严重的时代，能够看到一片清澈的蓝天已经成为一种奢侈。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège wūrǎn rìyì yánzhòng de shídài, nénggoù kàndào yī piàn qīngchè de lántiān yǐjīng chéngwéi yī zhǒng shèchǐ.
examples.english: In this era of increasingly serious pollution, being able to see a clear blue sky has become a luxury.

english: regular column or segment (in a publication or broadcast program)

examples.chinese: 这个电视台新推出的财经栏目吸引了很多投资者的关注。
examples.pinyin: Zhège diànshìtái xīn tuīchū de cáijīng lánmù xīyǐnle hěnduō tóuzīzhě de guānzhù.
examples.english: The financial column newly launched by this TV station has attracted the attention of many investors.

examples.chinese: 随着经济发展，越来越多的蓝领工人开始重视职业培训和技能提升。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de lánlǐng gōngrén kāishǐ zhòngshì zhíyè pèixùn hé jìnéng tíshēng.
examples.english: As the economy develops, more and more blue-collar workers are beginning to pay attention to vocational training and skill development.

examples.chinese: 这个合作关系建立在相互信任的牢固基础之上，双方都承诺长期合作。
examples.pinyin: Zhège hézuò guānxì jiànlì zài xiānghù xìnrèn de láogù jīchǔ zhī shang, shuāngfāng dōu chěngnuò cháng期 hézuò.
examples.english: This cooperative relationship is built on a firm foundation of mutual trust, and both parties are committed to long-term cooperation.

examples.chinese: 在这个陌生的城市里，遇到一个老乡真是太幸运了，我们立刻就有了共同的话题。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège mòshēng de chéngshì lǐ, yùdào yīge lǎoxiāng zhēnshi tài xìngyùn le, wǒmen lìkè jiù yǒule gòngtóng de huàtí.
examples.english: Meeting a fellow townsman in this unfamiliar city was really lucky; we immediately found common topics to discuss.

examples.chinese: 在这个充满虚伪的社会里，有人敢于泼冷水来批评你的梦想，这样的朋友其实值得珍惜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège chōngmǎn xūwěi de shèhuì lǐ, yǒurén gǎnyú pō lěngshuǐ lái píhuà nǐ de mèngxiǎng, zhèyàng de péngyou qíshí zhídé zhēnxī.
examples.english: In a society full of hypocrisy, those who dare to throw cold water on your dreams by criticizing them are actually friends worth cherishing.

examples.chinese: 现在越来越多的年轻人开始重视理财，通过投资基金和股票来实现财富增值。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài yuèláiyuè duō de niánqīngrén kāishǐ zhòngshì lǐcái, tōngguò tóuzī jījīn hé gǔpiào lái shíxiàn cáifù zēngzhí.
examples.english: Nowadays, an increasing number of young people are starting to pay attention to financial management, realizing wealth appreciation through investing in funds and stocks.

examples.chinese: 学校的礼堂经过装修后焕然一新，成为了举办各种重要活动的理想场所。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de lǐtáng jīngguò zhuāngxiū hòu huànyī yīxīn, chéngwéile jǔbàn gèzhǒng zhòngyào huódòng de lǐxiǎng chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: After renovation, the school's assembly hall looks brand new and has become an ideal venue for holding various important events.

examples.chinese: 这块木头的纹理很清晰，木工根据它的理来设计家具。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài mùtou de wénlǐ hěn qīngxī, mùgōng gēnjù tā de lǐ lái shèjì jiājù.
examples.english: The grain of this piece of wood is very clear, and the carpenter designed the furniture according to its texture.

examples.chinese: 这项改革需要政府部门和社会各界的共同努力和支持力度。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé xūyào zhèngfǔ bùmén hé shèhuì gè jiè de gòngtóng nǔlì hé zhīchí lìdù.
examples.english: This reform requires joint efforts and strong support from government departments and all sectors of society.

examples.chinese: 在做出重大决定之前，我们需要保持理智，而不是被情绪所左右。
examples.pinyin: Zài zuòchū zhòngdà juédìng zhīqián, wǒmen xūyào bǎochíchí lǐzhì, érbúshì bèi qíngxù suǒ zuǒyòu.
examples.english: Before making major decisions, we need to maintain reason rather than be swayed by emotions.

examples.chinese: 这个国际联盟的成立标志着各国在经济合作上迈出了重要一步。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójì liánméng de chénglì biāozhìzhe gèguó zài jīngjì hézuò shang màichūle zhòngyào yībù.
examples.english: The establishment of this international alliance marks an important step forward in economic cooperation among nations.

examples.chinese: 这项投资政策的出台既有利于经济增长，也有利于环境保护。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng tóuzī zhèngcè de chūtái jì yǒulì yú jīngjì zēngzhǎng, yě yǒulì yú huánjìng bǎohù.
examples.english: The introduction of this investment policy is beneficial to both economic growth and environmental protection.

examples.chinese: 他最近工作效率下降，似乎变得越来越懒，这让团队的其他成员感到很失望。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn gōngzuò xiàolǜ xiàjiàng, sìhū biàn de yuè lái yuè lǎn, zhè ràng tuánduì de qítā chéngyuán gǎndào hěn shīwàng.
examples.english: Recently, his work efficiency has declined, and he seems to be becoming increasingly lazy, which has disappointed the other team members.

examples.chinese: 今年的篮球联赛吸引了许多国际顶级球队参加。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián de lánqiú liánsài xīyǐnle xǔduō guójì dǐngjí qiúduì cānjiā.
examples.english: This year's basketball league has attracted many top international teams to participate.

examples.chinese: 夏天的时候，我更喜欢穿凉鞋去散步，这样既透气又舒适。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, wǒ gèng xǐhuān chuān liángxié qù sǎnbù, zhèyàng jì tòuqì yòu shūshì.
examples.english: In summer, I prefer to wear sandals when taking a walk, as they are both breathable and comfortable.

examples.chinese: 这条河的两侧都是茂密的森林，形成了一道天然的屏障。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hé de liǎngcè dōu shì màomì de sēnlín, xíngchéngle yī dào tiānránde píngzhàng.
examples.english: On both sides of this river are dense forests, forming a natural barrier.

examples.chinese: 他用两手紧紧握住那份珍贵的文件，生怕弄丢。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng liǎngshǒu jǐnjǐn wòzhù nà fèn zhēnguì de wénjiàn, shēngpà nòngdiào.
examples.english: He gripped the precious document tightly with both hands, afraid of losing it.

examples.chinese: 工作了一整天，我们坐在咖啡馆里聊天儿，放松一下紧绷的神经。
examples.pinyin: Gōngzuòle yì zhěng tiān, wǒmen zuòzài kāfēiguǎn lǐ liáo tiānr, fàngsōng yíxià jǐnbǐng de shénnjīng.
examples.english: After working all day, we sat in a coffee shop chatting to relax our tense nerves.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的困难程度超乎想象，但我们还是决定聊以自慰，继续坚持下去。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de kùnnan chéngdù chāohū xiǎngxiàng, dàn wǒmen háishi juéding liáo yǐ zìwèi, jìxù jiānchí xiàqù.
examples.english: The difficulty of this project exceeded our expectations, but we decided to endure with some self-comfort and continued to persist.

examples.chinese: 两家公司决定联手开发这款新产品，以便在国际市场上更具竞争力。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī juédìng liánshǒu kāifā zhè ku�ǎn xīn chǎnpǐn, yǐbiàn zài guójì shìchǎng shang gèng jù jìngjìnglì.
examples.english: The two companies decided to join hands to develop this new product in order to be more competitive in the international market.

examples.chinese: 一个优秀的领导者需要灵活地应对不同的市场变化，而不是死守旧的经营策略。
examples.pinyin: Yī ge yōuxiù de lǐngdǎozhě xūyào línghuó de yìngduì búdòng de shìchǎng biànhuà, érbúshì sǐ shǒu jiù de jīngyíng cèlüè.
examples.english: An excellent leader needs to respond nimbly to different market changes, rather than rigidly adhering to old business strategies.

examples.chinese: 长期的干旱导致大地裂开了许多深深的缝隙。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī de gānhàn dǎozhì dàdì liègāi le xǔduō shēnshēn de fèngxì.
examples.english: The prolonged drought caused the earth to split open with many deep cracks.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的结局出乎我的意料，完全颠覆了我之前的预期。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jiéjú chūhū wǒ de yìliào, wánquán diānfù le wǒ zhīqián de yùqī.
examples.english: The ending of this movie was beyond my expectation, completely subverting my previous assumptions.

examples.chinese: 这位领袖凭借卓越的远见和坚定的信念，成功地带领团队度过了最困难的时期。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǐngxiù píngjiè zhuóyuè de yuǎnjiàn hé jiāndìng de xìnniàn, chénggōng de dàilǐng tuánduì dùguò le zuì kùnnan de shíqī.
examples.english: This leader successfully guided the team through the most difficult period with his outstanding vision and firm conviction.

examples.chinese: 如果你今天赶不上会议，请在系统里留言，让我们知道你的想法。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ jīntiān gǎnbushàng huìyì, qǐng zài xìtǒng lǐ liúyán, ràng wǒmen zhīdào nǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: If you can't make it to the meeting today, please leave a message in the system so we know your thoughts.

examples.chinese: 除了经济因素之外，还有另一个重要的社会问题需要我们关注。
examples.pinyin: Chúle jīngjì yīnsù zhīwài, háiyǒu lìng yī ge zhòngyào de shèhuì wèntí xūyào wǒmen guānzhù.
examples.english: Apart from economic factors, there is another important social issue that requires our attention.

examples.chinese: 今年冬天流感疫情比较严重，医院的急诊科每天都挤满了患者。
examples.pinyin: Jīnnián dōngtiān liúgǎn yìqíng bǐjiào yánzhòng, yīyuàn de jízhěnkē měitiān dōu jǐmǎnle huànzhě.
examples.english: The flu outbreak this winter has been quite severe, with the hospital's emergency department packed with patients every day.

examples.chinese: 每天早上我都会在楼道里遇到隔壁的邻居，我们经常在那里闲聊几句。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang wǒ dōu huì zài lóudào lǐ遇到 gébi de línjū, wǒmen jīngcháng zài nàli xiánliáo jǐ jù.
examples.english: Every morning I run into my neighbor from next door in the corridor, and we often chat for a bit there.

english: a building of two or more stories

examples.chinese: 这座老楼房虽然年代久远，但其建筑风格仍然值得保护和研究。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò lǎo lóufáng suīrán niándài jiǔyuǎn, dàn qī jiànzhú fēngggé仍然 zhíde bǎohù hé yánjiū.
examples.english: Although this old building is ancient in age, its architectural style is still worth protecting and studying.

examples.chinese: 员工需要在人力资源部门领取新的工作证件。
examples.pinyin: Yuángōng xūyào zài rénlì zīyuán bùmén lǐngqǔ xīn de gōngzuò zhèngjiàn.
examples.english: Employees need to draw their new work credentials from the human resources department.

examples.chinese: 这次军事演习中，陆军部队展示了他们在复杂地形中的适应能力和战术素养。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì jūnshì yǎnxí zhōng, lùjūn bùduì zhǎnshìle tāmen zài fùzá dìxíng zhōng de shìyìng néngly hé zhànshù sùyǎng.
examples.english: During this military exercise, the army troops demonstrated their adaptability and tactical proficiency in complex terrain.

examples.chinese: 这场音乐会被录像下来，以便那些无法到场的粉丝能够在线观看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng yīnyuè huì bèi lùxiàng xiàlái, yǐbiàn nàxiē wúfǎ dàochǎng de fěnsī néng gòu zàixiàn guānkàn.
examples.english: The concert was videotaped so that fans who couldn't attend in person could watch it online.

examples.chinese: 他不小心露出了真实的想法，让所有人都看出他对这个项目没有信心。
examples.pinyin: Tā búxiǎoxīn lòuchūle zhēnshí de xiǎngfǎ, ràng suǒyǒurén dōu kànchū tā duì zhège xiàngmù méiyǒu xìnxin.
examples.english: He accidentally revealed his true thoughts, letting everyone see that he had no confidence in this project.

examples.chinese: 这家旅店虽然位置偏远，但因为老板娘的热情款待和合理的价格，吸引了很多背包客。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǚdiàn suīrán wèizhì piānyuǎn, dàn yīnwèi lǎobǎsniang de rèqíng kuǎndài hé héalǐ de jiàgé, xīyǐnle hěnduō bēibāo kè.
examples.english: Although this inn is located in a remote area, it attracts many backpackers because of the owner's warm hospitality and reasonable prices.

examples.chinese: 在那个偏远的山区，人们仍然依赖马车来运输生活必需品。
examples.pinyin: Zài nàge piānyuǎn de shānqū, rénmen仍然 yīlài mǎchē lái yùnshū shēnghuó bìxūpǐn.
examples.english: In that remote mountainous area, people still rely on carts to transport daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 我昨天路过你家楼下的时候，看到你在阳台上晒衣服。
