examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān lùguò nǐ jiā lóuxià de shíhou, kàndào nǐ zài yángtái shang shài yīfu.
examples.english: When I passed by your building yesterday, I saw you hanging clothes on the balcony.

examples.chinese: 他把真实的想法埋在心底，从不向任何人倾诉。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhēnshí de xiǎngfǎ máizài xīndǐ, cóngbù xiàng rènhé rén qīngsu.
examples.english: He buried his true thoughts deep in his heart and never confided in anyone.

examples.chinese: 城市绿化不仅能改善环境质量，还能提高居民的生活质量。
examples.pinyin: Chéngshì lǜhuà bújǐn néng gǎish善huánjìng zhìliàng, háinéng tígāo jūmín de shēnghuó zhìliàng.
examples.english: Urban greening not only improves environmental quality but also enhances residents' quality of life.

examples.chinese: 虽然慢车票价便宜，但是需要花费更多的时间才能到达目的地。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán mànchē piàojià piányí, dànshì xūyào huāfèi gèngduō de shíjiān cáinéng dàodá mùdìdì.
examples.english: Although local trains are cheaper, they require much more time to reach the destination.

examples.chinese: 这家早餐店的馒头虽然看似简朴，但用传统工艺制作，每天都有很多顾客排队购买。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zǎocāndiàn de mántou suīrán kànsi jiǎnpò, dàn yòng chuántǒng gōngyì zhìzuò, měi tiān dōu yǒu hěn duō gùkè pái duì gòumǎi.
examples.english: Although the steamed rolls at this breakfast shop appear simple, they are made using traditional craftsmanship, and many customers queue to buy them every day.

examples.chinese: 这位盲人艺术家用音乐传达了他对生活的深刻理解。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi mángrén yìshùjiā yòng yīnyuè chuándále tā duì shēnghuó de shēnkè lǐjiě.
examples.english: This blind artist conveyed his profound understanding of life through music.

english: particle: used to persuade someone to do something; used to emphasize the obvious

examples.chinese: 你都已经准备好了，就去参加面试嘛，没什么好害怕的。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dōu yǐjīng zhǔnbèi hǎo le, jiù qù cānjiā miànshì ma, méi shénme hǎo hàipà de.
examples.english: You're already well prepared, so just go to the interview—there's nothing to be afraid of.

examples.chinese: 随着生活水平的提高，越来越多的人开始关注美容护肤，希望能够保持年轻的外表。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe shēnghuó shuǐpíng de tígāo, yuèláiyuè duō de rén kāishǐ guānzhù měiróng hùshū, xīwàng néng gòu bǎochí niánqīng de wàibiǎo.
examples.english: As living standards have improved, more and more people have started to pay attention to beauty and skincare, hoping to maintain a youthful appearance.

examples.chinese: 他猛地转过身，发现身后站着一个陌生人。
examples.pinyin: Tā měng de zhuǎnguò shēn, fāxiàn shēnhòu zhànzhe yī ge陌生人。
examples.english: He suddenly turned around and discovered a stranger standing behind him.

examples.chinese: 一层厚重的雾蒙住了整个城市，能见度不到十米。
examples.pinyin: Yī céng hòuzhòng de wù ménɡ zhù le zhěnɡɡè chénɡshì, nénɡ jiàndù búdào shí mǐ.
examples.english: A thick layer of fog covered the entire city, with visibility less than ten meters.

examples.chinese: 我们现在就出发，免得堵车迟到。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiànzài jiù chūfā, miǎnde dǔchē chídào.
examples.english: Let's leave right now so as not to get stuck in traffic and arrive late.

english: generic term for cotton or kapok

examples.chinese: 这件衣服采用了高级棉料，穿起来既舒适又透气。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu cǎiyòngle gāojí miánliào, chuānyǐlai既 shūshì yòu tòuqì.
examples.english: This garment uses high-quality cotton material, which is both comfortable and breathable to wear.

examples.chinese: 两位领导人决定面对面地讨论这个敏感的贸易问题，以便找到双方都能接受的解决方案。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng wèi lǐngdǎorén juéding miànduìmiàn de tǎolùn zhège mǐngǎn de màoyì wèntí, yǐbiàn zhǎodào shuāngfāng dōu néng jiēshòu de jiějué fāng'àn.
examples.english: The two leaders decided to discuss this sensitive trade issue face to face in order to find a solution acceptable to both sides.

examples.chinese: 这家公司面向全球市场，致力于开发更加环保的新能源产品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī miànxiàng quánqiú shìchǎng, zhìlì yú kāifā gèngjiā huánbǎo de xīn néngliàng chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: This company, facing the global market, is committed to developing more environmentally friendly new energy products.

examples.chinese: 这位设计师用色彩搭配得非常妙,使得整个空间看起来既现代又温暖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi shèjìshī yòng sècǎi dāpèi de fēicháng miào, shǐ de zhěngge kōngjiān kànqǐlai既 xiàndài yòu nuǎnhuò.
examples.english: This designer's use of color combinations is wonderful, making the entire space look both modern and warm.

examples.chinese: 如果我们不采取行动，这个物种最终会走向灭亡。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒmen bù cǎiqǔ xíngdòng, zhège wùzhǒng zuìzh终 huì zǒuxiàng miè'wáng.
examples.english: If we don't take action, this species will eventually face extinction.

examples.chinese: 这位歌手通过演唱传统民歌，成功地将民族音乐文化传承给了年轻一代。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi gēeshǒu tōngguò yǎnchàng chuántǒng míngē, chénggōng de jiāng mínzú yīnyuè wénhuà chuánchéng gěi le niánqīng yī dài.
examples.english: By performing traditional folk songs, this singer successfully passed down ethnic musical culture to the younger generation.

examples.chinese: 随着城市化进程的加快，越来越多的民工涌入大城市寻求更好的生活机会。
examples.pinyin: Suí着chéngshìhuà jìnchéng de jiākuài, yuèláiyuè duō de míngōng yǒngrù dà chéngshì xúnqiú gèng hǎo de shēnghuó jīhuì.
examples.english: As the pace of urbanization accelerates, more and more migrant workers flood into big cities seeking better life opportunities.

examples.chinese: 那名民警凭借多年的办案经验，很快就破获了这起复杂的诈骗案件。
examples.pinyin: Nà míng mínjǐng píngjiè duō nián de bàn'àn jīngyàn, hěnkuài jiù pòhuò le zhè qǐ fùzá de zhàpiàn ànjiàn.
examples.english: That civil police officer, relying on years of case-handling experience, quickly solved this complex fraud case.

examples.chinese: 要实现真正的民主制度，需要全社会的共同努力和广泛的政治参与。
examples.pinyin: Yào shíxiàn zhēnzhèng de mínzhǔ zhìdù, xūyào quán shèhuì de gòngtóng nǔlì hé guǎngfàn de zhèngzhì cānnyù.
examples.english: To achieve true democratic institutions requires the joint efforts of the entire society and broad political participation.

english: a place famous for its scenery or historical relics

examples.chinese: 这座城市拥有许多历史名胜，每年吸引数百万游客前来参观。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì yōngyǒu xǔduō lìshǐ míngshèng, měi nián xīyǐn shù bǎi wàn yóukè qiánlái cānguān.
examples.english: This city possesses many historical sites and scenic spots, attracting millions of visitors every year.

examples.chinese: 这次招聘会只有五个名额，竞争非常激烈。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zhāopìn huì zhǐyǒu wǔ ge míngé, jìngjìng fēicháng jīliè.
examples.english: This recruitment fair only has five positions available, and the competition is extremely fierce.

examples.chinese: 政府必须重视民意，才能制定出真正符合人民需求的政策。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ bìxū zhòngshì mínyì, cáinéng zhìdìng chū zhēnzhèng符hé rénmín xūqiú de zhèngcè.
examples.english: The government must value public opinion in order to formulate policies that truly meet the people's needs.

examples.chinese: 他为了维护公司的名誉，决定主动承认这个错误。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile wéihù gōngsī de míngyù, juéding zhǔdòng chéngrèn zhège cuòwù.
examples.english: He decided to take the initiative to admit this mistake in order to protect the company's reputation.

examples.chinese: 他以公司董事长的名义签署了这份合同，但实际上决定权掌握在董事会手中。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǐ gōngsī dǒngshìzhǎng de míngyì qiānshǔ le zhè fèn hétonɡ, dàn shíjìshang juédìnɡquán zhǎngwò zài dǒngshìhuì shǒuzhōnɡ.
examples.english: He signed the contract in the name of the company's chairman, but in reality, the decision-making power was held by the board of directors.

examples.chinese: 他一生都在与命运抗争，最终还是改变不了自己的命。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīshēng dōu zài yǔ mìngyùn kànzhēng, zuìzhōng háishi gǎibiàn buliǎo zìjǐ de mìng.
examples.english: He spent his entire life struggling against fate, but in the end he still couldn't change his destiny.

examples.chinese: 明日的会议已经推迟到下周，所以今天我们可以提前结束工作。
examples.pinyin: Míngri de huìyì yǐjīng tuīchíle dào xiàzhōu, suǒyǐ jīntiān wǒmen kěyǐ tíqián jiéshù gōngzuò.
examples.english: Tomorrow's meeting has been postponed to next week, so we can finish work early today.

examples.chinese: 这些年来，他在逆境中不断磨练自己，最终成为了业界的佼佼者。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē niánlái, tā zài nìjìng zhōng búduàn móliàn zìjǐ, zuìzh终 chéngwéile yèjiè de jiǎojiǎozhě.
examples.english: Over the years, he continuously honed himself in adversity and ultimately became a leader in the industry.

examples.chinese: 海关人员在机场没收了他非法携带的象牙制品。
examples.pinyin: Hǎiguān rényuán zài jīchǎng mòshōule tā fēifǎ xiédài de xiàngyá zhìpǐn.
examples.english: Customs officers confiscated the ivory products he was illegally carrying at the airport.

examples.chinese: 这种保护膜能够有效防止手机屏幕被划伤。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bǎohù mó néng gòu yǒuxiào fángzhǐ shǒujī píngmù bèi huáshāng.
examples.english: This type of protective membrane can effectively prevent the phone screen from being scratched.

examples.chinese: 这位书法家用了几十年的时间才找到最适合自己的墨水配方。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi shūfǎ jiā yòngle jǐ shí nián de shíjiān cái zhǎodào zuì shìhéhé zìjǐ de mòshuǐ pèifāng.
examples.english: It took this calligrapher decades to find the ink formula that best suited him.

examples.chinese: 这种文化的母体源于古代的农业文明，经过几千年的演变才形成了今天的样貌。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wénhuà de mǔtǐ yuányú gǔdài de nóngyè wénmíng, jīngguò jǐ qiān nián de yǎnbiàn cái xíngchéngle jīntiān de yàngmào.
examples.english: The mother culture of this civilization originated from ancient agricultural civilization, and only after thousands of years of evolution did it take on its present form.

examples.chinese: 这只母鸡已经下蛋三年了，现在产蛋量明显下降，农民正考虑是否该淘汰它。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī mǔjī yǐjīng xiàzàn sān nián le, xiànzài chǎndànliàng míngxiǎn xiàjiàng, nóngmín zhèng kǎolǜ shìfǒu gāi táotài tā.
examples.english: This hen has been laying eggs for three years now, and its egg production has clearly declined, so the farmer is considering whether to retire it.

examples.chinese: 这部电影讲述了一对母女之间的矛盾与和解，深深触动了观众的心弦。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎngshù le yī duì mǔnǚ zhījiān de máodùn yǔ héjiě, shēnshēn chùdòng le guānzhòng de xīnxián.
examples.english: This film tells the story of conflict and reconciliation between a mother and daughter, which deeply touched the audience's hearts.

examples.chinese: 这座古墓的发现为我们了解古代文明提供了宝贵的线索。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔmù de fāxiàn wèi wǒmen liǎojiě gǔdài wénmíng tígōngle báoguì de xiànsuǒ.
examples.english: The discovery of this ancient tomb provided us with valuable clues for understanding ancient civilization.

examples.chinese: 他趁我不注意的时候拿走了我桌子上的文件。
examples.pinyin: Tā chèn wǒ búzhùyì de shíhou názǒu le wǒ zhuōzi shang de wénjiàn.
examples.english: He took away the documents on my desk while I wasn't paying attention.

examples.chinese: 这幅画生动地描绘了一对母子在田间劳作的温馨场景，充满了人性的光辉。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fú huà shēngdòng de miáohuì le yī duì mǔzǐ zài tiánjiān láozuò de wēnxīn chǎngjǐng, chōngmǎn le rénxìng de guānghuī.
examples.english: This painting vividly depicts a warm scene of a mother and child working in the fields, full of human brilliance.

examples.chinese: 许多父母为了给孩子选择最好的奶粉，不惜花费大量金钱购买进口产品。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō fùmǔ wèile gěi háizi xuǎnzé zuì hǎo de nǎifěn, búzhì huāfèi dàliàng jīnqián gòumǎi jìnkǒu chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: Many parents spare no expense in purchasing imported powdered milk products in order to choose the best option for their children.

examples.chinese: 那次在巴黎的经历让我终身难忘，尤其是在塞纳河畔漫步的那个傍晚。
examples.pinyin: Nà cì zài Bālì de jīnglì ràng wǒ zh终shēn nánwàng, yóuqī shì zài Sāi Nà Hé pàn màn bù de nàge bànyuán.
examples.english: That experience in Paris left an unforgettable impression on me for life, especially that evening strolling along the Seine.

examples.chinese: 这个农场饲养了数百头奶牛，每天生产的牛奶供应整个地区。
examples.pinyin: Zhège nóngchǎng sìyǎngle shùbǎi tóu nǎiniú, měitiān shēngchǎn de niúnǎi gōngyìng zhěngge dìqū.
examples.english: This farm raises hundreds of milk cows, producing milk daily to supply the entire region.

examples.chinese: 这家公司内外都在讨论新的发展战略，员工们对公司的前景既期待又担忧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī nèiwài dōu zài tǎolùn xīn de fāzhǎn zhànlüè, yuángōngmen duì gōngsī de qiánqǐng jì qīdài yòu dānnyōu.
examples.english: Both inside and outside this company, people are discussing the new development strategy, and employees feel both hopeful and worried about the company's prospects.

english: mainland China (PRC excluding Hong Kong and Macau

examples.chinese: 近年来，越来越多的香港年轻人选择到内地发展，寻求更多的商业机遇。
examples.pinyin: Jìnnián lái, yuèláiyuè duō de xiānggǎng niánqīng rén xuǎnzé dào nèidì fāzhǎn, xúnqiú gèngduō de shāngyè jīhuì.
examples.english: In recent years, an increasing number of young people from Hong Kong choose to develop their careers in mainland China, seeking more business opportunities.

examples.chinese: 这家高级百货商店的内衣部门以其精致的设计和优质的面料而闻名。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gāojí báihuò shāngdiàn de nèiyī bùmén yǐ qī jīngzhì de shèjì hé yōuzhì de miànliào ér wénmíng.
examples.english: The lingerie department of this upscale department store is renowned for its exquisite designs and high-quality fabrics.

examples.chinese: 这个项目能否成功取决于我们是否能获得足够的资金支持。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù néngfǒu chénggōng qǔjuéyú wǒmen shìfǒu néng huòqǔ zúgòu de zījīn zhīchí.
examples.english: Whether this project can succeed depends on whether we can obtain sufficient financial support.

examples.chinese: 他扭转了公司的经营困境，让濒临破产的企业重新焕发了生机。
examples.pinyin: Tā niǔzhuǎnle gōngsī de jīngyíng kùnjìng, ràng bīnlín pòchǎn de qǐyè chóngxīn huànfāle le shēngjī.
examples.english: He turned around the company's business difficulties, bringing the near-bankrupt enterprise back to life.

examples.chinese: 在我们家族中，根据年龄排行榜，我排行老三，上面有两个哥哥。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒmen jiāzú zhōng, gēnjù niánlìng páihángbǎng, wǒ páixíng lǎo sān, shàngmiàn yǒu liǎng ge gēge.
examples.english: In our family, according to the age seniority ranking, I am the third child, with two older brothers above me.

examples.chinese: 法官根据证据判定被告人有罪。
examples.pinyin: Fǎguān gēnjù zhèngjù pàndìng bèigàorén yǒuzuì.
examples.english: The judge determined the defendant guilty based on the evidence.

examples.chinese: 公司派出了一支专业团队去处理这个复杂的客户问题。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī pàichūle yī zhī zhuānyè tuánduì qù chǔlǐ zhège fùzá de kèhù wèntí.
examples.english: The company sent out a professional team to handle this complex customer issue.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的努力，她终于实现了自己一直盼望的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì, tā zhōngyú shíxiàn le zìjǐ yìzhí pànwàng de梦想。
examples.english: After years of effort, she finally realized the dream she had long hoped for.

examples.chinese: 这种高级茶叶需要用80度的水泡，才能泡出它独特的香气。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng gāojí cháyè xūyào yòng 80 dù de shuǐ pào, cáinéng pào chū tā dúté de xiāngqì.
examples.english: This premium tea needs to be steeped in 80-degree water to bring out its unique fragrance.

examples.chinese: 董事长决定亲自陪同这位重要客户视察我们的新工厂。
examples.pinyin: Dǒngshìzhǎng juédìng qīnzì péitóng zhèwèi zhòngyào kèh户 shìchá wǒmen de xīn gōngchǎng.
examples.english: The chairman decided to personally accompany this important client to inspect our new factory.

examples.chinese: 孩子们在操场上踢皮球，笑声回荡在整个校园里。
examples.pinyin: Háizi men zài cāochǎng shang tī píqiú, xiàoshēng huídàng zài zhěngge xiàoyuán lǐ.
examples.english: The children were kicking the ball on the playground, and their laughter echoed throughout the entire school campus.

examples.chinese: 这次军事演习中，司令官根据地形特点重新配置了部队的防线。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì jūnshì yǎnxí zhōng, sīlìngguān gēnjù dìxíng tèdiǎn chóngxīn pèizhì le bùduì de fángxiàn.
examples.english: During this military exercise, the commander repositioned the troops' defensive lines based on the characteristics of the terrain.

examples.chinese: 他偏要和公司的意见对着干，最后被迫离职了。
examples.pinyin: Tā piān yào hé gōngsī de yìjiàn duìzháo gàn, zuìhòu bèi pò lízhí le.
examples.english: He stubbornly insisted on going against the company's opinion, and was eventually forced to resign.

examples.chinese: 许多贫困地区的孩子们通过教育改变了自己的人生轨迹。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō pínkùn dìqū de háizi men tōngguò jiàoyù gǎibiàn le zìjǐ de rénshēng guǐjì.
examples.english: Many children from impoverished regions changed the trajectory of their lives through education.

examples.chinese: 公司决定聘请一位资深的市场营销专家来领导新的产品推广项目。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng pìnqǐng yī wèi zīshēn de shìchǎng yíngxiāo zhuānjiā lái lǐngdǎo xīn de chǎnpǐn tuīguǎng xiàngmù.
examples.english: The company has decided to engage a senior marketing expert to lead the new product promotion project.

examples.chinese: 厨师用大火快速炮制这道菜，使得香味更加浓郁。
examples.pinyin: chúshī yòng dàhuǒ kuàisù páozhì zhè dào cài, shǐde xiāngwèi gèngjiā nóngyù.
examples.english: The chef quickly sautéed this dish over high heat, making the aroma even more intense.

examples.chinese: 这个品牌在国际市场上的竞争力逐年下降，主要是因为缺乏创新产品。
examples.pinyin: Zhège pǐnpái zài guójì shìchǎng shang de jìngjìnglì zhúnián xiàjiàng, zhǔyào shì yīnwèi quēfá chuàngxīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: This brand's competitiveness in the international market has been declining year by year, mainly due to a lack of innovative products.

examples.chinese: 她用平凡的语言讲述了自己不平凡的人生经历，让在场的每个人都被深深打动了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng píngfán de yǔyán jiǎngshù le zìjǐ bù píngfán de rénshēng jīnglì, ràng zàichǎng de měi ge rén dōu bèi shēnshēn dǎdòng le.
examples.english: She narrated her extraordinary life experiences in ordinary language, which deeply moved everyone present.

examples.chinese: 在快速发展的社会中，我们需要找到工作和生活的平衡点。
examples.pinyin: Zài kuàisù fāzhǎn de shèhuì zhōng, wǒmen xūyào zhǎodào gōngzuò hé shēnghuó de pínghéng diǎn.
examples.english: In a rapidly developing society, we need to find a balance between work and life.

examples.chinese: 专家们对这部新电影的评价褒贬不一，有人认为它突破了传统，也有人觉得过于实验性。
examples.pinyin: Zhuānjiā men duì zhè bù xīn diànyǐng de píngjià bāobeǐn búyī, yǒurén rènwéi tā túpò le chuántǒng, yě yǒurén juéde guòyú shíyàn xìng.
examples.english: Experts have mixed opinions about this new film, with some believing it breaks traditional conventions while others find it overly experimental.

examples.chinese: 这个新的电商平台为中小企业提供了一个绝佳的销售机会。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīn de diànshāng píngтái wèi zhōngxiǎo qǐyè tígōngle yīgè juéjiā de xiāoshòu jīhuì.
examples.english: This new e-commerce platform has provided small and medium-sized enterprises with an excellent sales opportunity.

examples.chinese: 长时间盯着屏幕会导致眼睛疲劳，所以我们应该定期休息。
examples.pinyin: Cháng shíjiān dīngzhe píngmù huì dǎozhì yǎnjing píláo, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi dìngqī xiūxi.
examples.english: Staring at the screen for long periods of time can cause eye strain, so we should take regular breaks.

english: to select on the basis of a vote or consensus

examples.chinese: 这部电影在国际电影节上被评选为最佳作品，赢得了评委们的一致认可。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng zài guójì diànyǐngjié shang bèi píngxuǎn wéi zuìjiā zuòpǐn, yíngdé le píngwěi men de yīzhì rènkě.
examples.english: This film was selected as the best work at the international film festival and won unanimous recognition from the judges.

examples.chinese: 他扑灭了心中的怒火，用平静的语气回答了这个问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā pūmiè le xīnzhōng de nùhuǒ, yòng pínjìng de yǔqì huídá le zhège wèntí.
examples.english: He extinguished the anger in his heart and answered the question in a calm tone.

examples.chinese: 这套公寓总面积只有五十平方米，但设计得非常紧凑实用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào gōngyù zǒng miànjī zhǐyǒu wǔshí píngfāngmǐ, dàn shèjì de fēicháng jǐn凑 shíyòng.
examples.english: This apartment has a total area of only fifty square meters, but it is designed to be very compact and practical.

examples.chinese: 工人们用石板铺设了一条通往花园的小路。
examples.pinyin: Gōngrénmen yòng shíbǎn pùshè le yī tiáo tōngwǎng huāyuán de xiǎolù.
examples.english: The workers paved a pathway to the garden with stone slabs.

examples.chinese: 这部电影用一种奇妙的方式将现实和梦境交织在一起，让观众沉浸其中。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng yòng yī zhǒng qímiào de fāngshì jiāng xiànshí hé mèngjìng jiāozhī zài yīqǐ, ràng guānzhòng chéngjìn qīzhōng.
examples.english: The film weaves reality and dreams together in a wonderful way, immersing the audience in it.

examples.chinese: 这条山坡上的古道见证了几个世纪的商业往来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo shānpō shang de gǔdào jiànzhèng le jǐ ge shìjì de shāngyè wǎnglái.
examples.english: The ancient path on this hillside has witnessed centuries of commercial trade.

examples.chinese: 他仗着自己力气大就经常欺负班里的同学，最后被老师严厉批评了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhànzhe zìjǐ lìqi dà jiù jīngcháng qīfu bānlǐ de tóngxué, zuìhòu bèi lǎoshī yánlì pípíng le.
examples.english: He often bullied his classmates by relying on his strength, and was eventually criticized harshly by the teacher.

examples.chinese: 他企图通过贿赂官员来逃避法律的制裁，但最终还是被警察逮捕了。
examples.pinyin: Tā qǐtú tōngguò huǐlù guānyuán lái táohuī fǎlǜ de zhìcái, dàn zuìzh终 háishi bèi jǐngchá dàibǔ le.
examples.english: He attempted to evade legal punishment by bribing officials, but was ultimately arrested by the police.

examples.chinese: 虽然聚会的气氛有点尴尬，但大家还是尽力让对话继续下去。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán jùhuì de qìfēn yǒudiǎn gāngà, dàn dàjiā háishi jìnlì ràng duìhuà jìxù xiàqù.
examples.english: Although the atmosphere of the gathering was a bit awkward, everyone still made an effort to keep the conversation going.

examples.chinese: 在这种敏感的情况下，选择恰当的措辞非常重要。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng mǐngǎn de qíngkuàng xià, xuǎnzé qiàdàng de cuòcí fēicháng zhòngyào.
examples.english: In this sensitive situation, choosing appropriate wording is extremely important.

examples.chinese: 我们讨论了很久，恰好找到了解决这个问题的最佳方案。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen tǎolùnle hěnjiǔ, qiàhǎo zhǎodàole jiějué zhège wèntí de zuìjiā fāng'àn.
examples.english: We discussed it for a long time and, as it turns out, found the best solution to this problem.

examples.chinese: 他决定起诉那家公司，因为他们违反了合同条款。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédìng qǐsù nàjiā gōngsī, yīnwèi tāmen wéifǎnle héntóng tiáokuǎn.
examples.english: He decided to sue the company because they breached the contract terms.

examples.chinese: 他恰恰在我最需要帮助的时候出现了。
examples.pinyin: Tā qiàqià zài wǒ zuì xūyào bāngzhù de shíhou chūxiàn le.
examples.english: He appeared at exactly the moment when I needed help the most.

examples.chinese: 他用铅笔勾勒出了建筑物的轮廓，随后才用钢笔描绘细节。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng qiānbǐ gōuləi chūle jiànzhúwù de lúnkuò, suíhòu cái yòng gāngbǐ miáohuì xìjié.
examples.english: He used a pencil to sketch the outline of the building, and only then did he use a pen to depict the details.

examples.chinese: 虽然他在学术领域取得了很大的成就，但他仍然保持着谦虚的态度，经常向其他专家请教。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā zài xuéshù lǐngyù qǔdéle hěn dà de chéngjiù, dànshì tā仍然 bǎochízhe qiānxū de tàidù, jīngcháng xiàng qítā zhuānjiā qǐngjiào.
examples.english: Although he has achieved great accomplishments in academia, he still maintains a modest attitude and frequently seeks advice from other experts.

examples.chinese: 她牵着孩子的手走过了繁忙的街道。
examples.pinyin: Tā qiānzhe háizi de shǒu zǒuguòle繁máng de jiēdào.
examples.english: She led the child by the hand across the busy street.

examples.chinese: 这次失败并不是终点，而是我们成功的新起点。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài bìngbú shì zhōngdiǎn, érshì wǒmen chénggōng de xīn qǐdiǎn.
examples.english: This failure is not the end, but rather a new starting point for our success.

examples.chinese: 我们的目标在前方，无论遇到什么困难都不能放弃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de mùbiāo zài qiánfāng, wúlùn遇到shénme kùnnan dōu búnéng fàngqì.
examples.english: Our goal lies ahead; no matter what difficulties we encounter, we cannot give up.

examples.chinese: 警察在电影中追捕那个臭名昭著的强盗，最后在火车站将他逮捕了。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zài diànyǐng zhōng zhuībǔ nàge chòumíng zhāozhù de qiángdào, zuìhòu zài huǒchēzhàn jiāng tā dàibǔ le.
examples.english: In the movie, the police pursued the notorious hijacker/robber, and finally arrested him at the train station.

examples.chinese: 这位年轻运动员虽然现在成绩平平，但教练们都看好他的潜力，认为他未来会成为世界冠军。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi niánqīng yùndòng yuányuán suīrán xiànzài chéngjì píngpíng, dàn jiàoliàn men dōu kànhǎo tā de qiánlì, rènwéi tā wèilái huì chéngwéi shìjiè chànjūn.
examples.english: Although this young athlete's current performance is mediocre, coaches all recognize his potential and believe he will become a world champion in the future.

examples.chinese: 听说公司要举办年度大会，许多客户都前来参加这次重要的活动。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō gōngsī yào jǔbàn niándù dàhuì, xǔduō kèhù dōu qiánlái cānjiā zhè cì zhòngyào de huódòng.
examples.english: Hearing that the company is holding its annual conference, many clients came to attend this important event.

examples.chinese: 这家科技公司凭借强势的市场地位，垄断了整个行业。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kējì gōngsī píngjiè qiángshì de shìchǎng dìwèi, lǒngduàn le zhěngge hángyè.
examples.english: This tech company monopolized the entire industry by leveraging its powerful market position.

examples.chinese: 那位运动员身体非常强壮，能够承受高强度的训练。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi yùndòng yuán shēntǐ fēicháng qiángzhuàng, nénggoù chéngshòu gāo qiángdù de xùnliàn.
examples.english: That athlete has a very strong physique and can withstand high-intensity training.

examples.chinese: 这位设计师巧妙地将传统文化元素融入了现代建筑中，获得了国际大奖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi shèjìshī qiǎomiào de jiāng chuántǒng wénhuà yuánsù róngrù le xiàndài jiànzhù zhōng, huòdéle guójì dàjiǎng.
examples.english: This designer felicitously incorporated traditional cultural elements into modern architecture and won an international award.

examples.chinese: 教育是连接贫富差距的重要桥梁，它能够改变许多人的人生轨迹。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoyù shì liánjiē píngfù chāajù de zhòngyào qiáoliáng, tā nénggoù gǎibiàn xǔduō rén de rénshēng guǐjī.
examples.english: Education is an important bridge connecting the wealth gap; it can change the life trajectories of many people.

examples.chinese: 为了应对市场竞争，公司决定强化员工的专业培训。
examples.pinyin: Wèile yìngduì shìchǎng jìngjìng, gōngsī juéding qiánghuà yuángōng de zhuānyè péixùn.
examples.english: In order to cope with market competition, the company decided to strengthen professional training for employees.

examples.chinese: 我们需要切实解决这个问题，而不是一味地纸上谈兵。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào qièshí jiějué zhège wèntí, érbúshì yīyì de zhǐshang tánbīng.
examples.english: We need to feasibly solve this problem, rather than just talk about it on paper.

examples.chinese: 这家公司因为侵犯了竞争对手的专利权而被法院判罚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yīnwèi qīnfàn le jìngjìng duìshǒu de zhuānlì quán érbeǐ fǎyuàn pànfá.
examples.english: The company was fined by the court for violating its competitor's patent rights.

examples.chinese: 这道番茄茄子汤融合了意大利和中国烹饪的精妙之处，值得一试。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào fānqié qiézi tāng rónghéle Yìdàlì hé Zhōngguó pēngrén de jīngmiào zhī chù, zhíde yī shì.
examples.english: This tomato and eggplant soup combines the culinary nuances of both Italian and Chinese cooking styles, and is worth trying.

examples.chinese: 在法律问题上，亲属之间的利益冲突有时会导致复杂的纠纷。
examples.pinyin: Zài fǎlǜ wèntí shang, qīnshǔ zhījiān de lìyì chōngtū yǒushíhou huì dǎozhì fùzá de ji纠fēn.
examples.english: In legal matters, conflicts of interest between kin sometimes lead to complex disputes.

examples.chinese: 研究表明，年轻人越来越倾向于通过社交媒体而不是传统方式来获取新闻信息。
examples.pinyin: Yánjiū biǎomíng, niánqīngrén yuèláiyuè qīngxiàng yú tōngguò shèjiāo méitǐ érbúshì chuántǒng fāngshì lái huòqǔ xīnwén xìnxī.
examples.english: Research shows that young people are increasingly inclined to obtain news information through social media rather than traditional means.

examples.chinese: 这位艺术家用清晰的笔触描绘了人物内心的复杂情感。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yìshùjiā yòng qīngxī de bǐchùk miáohuì le rénwù nèixīn de fùzá qíngǎn.
examples.english: This artist depicted the complex emotions in the character's heart with clear brushstrokes.

examples.chinese: 医院必须保持高度的清洁标准，以防止患者感染。
examples.pinyin: Yīyuàn bìxū bǎochí gāodù de qīngjié biāozhǔn, yǐ fángzhǐ huànzhě gǎnrǎn.
examples.english: Hospitals must maintain high standards of cleanliness to prevent patient infections.

examples.chinese: 那位清洁工每天凌晨四点就开始打扫街道，风雨无阻，他的敬业精神值得我们尊敬。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi qīngjié gōng měitiān língchén sì diǎn jiù kāishǐ dǎsǎo jiēdào, fēngyǔ wúzǔ, tā de jìngyè jīngshén zhídé wǒmen zūnjìng.
examples.english: That cleaner starts sweeping the streets at four o'clock every morning, rain or shine; his dedication to his work deserves our respect.

examples.chinese: 我亲眼目睹了那场激烈的辩论赛，选手们的表现令我印象深刻。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qīnyǎn mùdǔ le nà chǎng jīliè de biànlùn sài, xuǎnshǒu men de biǎoxiàn lìng wǒ yìnxiàng shēnkè.
examples.english: I witnessed that intense debate competition with my own eyes, and the contestants' performance left a deep impression on me.

english: Qingming or Pure Brightness Festival or Tomb Sweeping Day

examples.chinese: 每年清明节，许多人都会回到故乡扫墓，缅怀已逝的亲人。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián Qīngmíngjié, xǔduō rén dōu huì huídào gùxiāng sǎomù, miǎnhuái yǐshì de qīnrén.
examples.english: Every Qingming Festival, many people return to their hometown to sweep tombs and remember their deceased relatives.

examples.chinese: 他最近的情绪波动很大，我们都很担心他的身体状况。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn de qíngxù bōdòng hěn dà, wǒmen dōu hěn dānxīn tā de shēntǐ zhuàngkuàng.
examples.english: His mood has been fluctuating greatly recently, and we are all worried about his physical condition.

examples.chinese: 他花了几千块钱买了一把专业的网球球拍，希望能够提高自己的比赛成绩。
examples.pinyin: Tā huāle jǐ qiān kuài qián mǎile yī bǎ zhuānyè de wǎngqiú qiúpāi, xīwàng néng gòu tíhuà zìjǐ de bǐsài chéngjì.
examples.english: He spent several thousand yuan to buy a professional tennis racket, hoping to improve his competition performance.

examples.chinese: 考古学家们小心翼翼地清洗了这些古代陶器，生怕损坏它们宝贵的表面。
examples.pinyin: Kǎogǔ xuéjiā men xiǎoxīn yìyì de qīngxǐ le zhèxiē gǔdài táoqì, shēngpà sǔnhuài tāmen báoguì de biǎomiàn.
examples.english: The archaeologists carefully washed the ancient pottery, afraid of damaging their precious surfaces.

examples.chinese: 那位球星因为伤病问题已经退出了职业联赛，但他的影响力依然不减。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi qiúxīng yīnwèi shāngbìng wèntí yǐjīng tuìchūle zhíyè liánhuì, dànshì tā de yǐngxiǎnglì yīránjiù bújiǎn.
examples.english: That sports star has already retired from professional leagues due to injury issues, but his influence remains undiminished.

examples.chinese: 随着经济形势的变化，许多应届毕业生在求职时面临着前所未有的压力和挑战。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì xíngshì de biànhuà, xǔduō yìngj届bìyèshēng zài qiúzhí shí miànlín zhe qiánsuǒwèiyǒu de yālì hé tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: With the changes in economic circumstances, many recent graduates face unprecedented pressure and challenges when seeking employment.

examples.chinese: 这位球员虽然年纪轻轻，但他的比赛意识和职业素养已经超过了许多资深运动员。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi qiúyuán suīrán niánjì qīngqīng, dàn tā de bǐsài yìshi hé zhíyè sùyǎng yǐjīng chāoguòle xǔduō zīshēn yùndòngyuán.
examples.english: Although this ballplayer is still young, his game sense and professional qualities have already surpassed those of many veteran athletes.

examples.chinese: 农民们定期清理灌溉渠道，确保水能顺利流向田地。
examples.pinyin: Nóngmín men dìngqī qīnglǐ guàngài qúdào, quèbǎo shuǐ néng shùnlì liúxiàng tiántǐ.
examples.english: The farmers regularly clean the irrigation ditches to ensure water flows smoothly to the fields.

english: to withdraw money from a bank

examples.chinese: 由于ATM机故障，我只能到银行柜台取款，这让我浪费了不少时间。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú ATM jī gùzhàng, wǒ zhǐnéng dào yínháng guìtái qǔkuǎn, zhè ràng wǒ làngfèile búshǎo shíjiān.
examples.english: Because the ATM machine was broken, I had no choice but to withdraw money at the bank counter, which wasted quite a bit of my time.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的预算太高了，我们需要去掉一些不必要的开支。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de yùsuàn tài gāo le, wǒmen xūyào qùdiào yīxiē búbìyào de kāishī.
examples.english: The budget for this project is too high; we need to cut out some unnecessary expenses.

examples.chinese: 在这个复杂的案件中，侦探需要仔细区分哪些证据是相关的，哪些是无关的。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège fùzá de ànjiàn zhōng, zhēntàn xūyào zǐxì qūfēn nǎxiē zhèngjù shì xiāngguān de, nǎxiē shì wúguān de.
examples.english: In this complex case, the detective needs to carefully distinguish which evidence is relevant and which is irrelevant.

examples.chinese: 这家银行的取款机经常故障，我已经向客服投诉过多次，但问题一直没有得到解决。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yínháng de qǔkuǎnjī jīngcháng gùzhàng, wǒ yǐjīng xiàng kèfú tóusu guò duō cì, dàn wèntí yīzhí méiyǒu dé到 jiějué.
examples.english: The ATM at this bank frequently malfunctions. I've complained to customer service multiple times, but the problem has never been resolved.

examples.chinese: 权教授在这个领域的研究成果享誉国际。
examples.pinyin: Quán jiàoshòu zài zhège lǐngyù de yánjiū chéngguǒ xiǎngyù guójì.
examples.english: Professor Quan's research achievements in this field are renowned internationally.

examples.chinese: 为了赢得这场比赛，我们的运动员们全力以赴，最终取得了胜利。
examples.pinyin: Wèile yíngde zhè chǎng bǐsài, wǒmen de yùndòngyuán men quánlì yǐ fù, zuìzhōng qǔdéle shènglì.
examples.english: In order to win this competition, our athletes gave it their all and ultimately achieved victory.

examples.chinese: 在这个组织中，他的权力逐渐扩大，最终成为了实际的决策者。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège zǔzhī zhōng, tā de quánlì逐渐 kuòdà, zuìzh终 chéngwéile shíjì de juécèzhě.
examples.english: Within this organization, his influence gradually expanded, and he eventually became the actual decision-maker.

examples.chinese: 这家公司推出了全新的产品线，试图在竞争激烈的市场中占据一席之地。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī tuīchūle quánxīn de chǎnpǐn xiàn, shìtú zài jìngjìng jīliè de shìchǎng zhōng zhànnjù yī xí zhī dì.
examples.english: This company launched an entirely new product line in an attempt to gain a foothold in the highly competitive market.

examples.chinese: 他投资的那只基金券表现一直很稳定，每年都能获得不错的回报。
examples.pinyin: Tā tóuzī de nàzhī jījīn quàn biǎoxiàn yìzhí hěn wěndìng, měi nián dōu néng huòdé búcuò de huíhuò.
examples.english: The fund bonds he invested in have been performing steadily, and he gets decent returns every year.

examples.chinese: 这个产品虽然功能强大，但仍然存在一些设计缺陷需要改进。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chǎnpǐn suīrán gōngnéng qiángdà, dàn仍然 cúnzài yīxiē shèjì quēxiàn xūyào gǎijìn.
examples.english: Although this product is powerful in functionality, there are still some design flaws that need improvement.

english: to give up one's seat for sb

examples.chinese: 在公交车上，我看到一位老奶奶上车，我立刻站起来让座，这是我们应该做的。
examples.pinyin: Zài gōngjiāochē shang, wǒ kàndào yī wèi lǎo nǎinai shàngchē, wǒ lìkè zhàn qǐlai ràng zuò, zhè shì wǒmen yīnggāi zuò de.
examples.english: On the bus, I noticed an elderly grandmother getting on, so I immediately stood up to give her my seat, which is what we should do.

examples.chinese: 社交媒体上的这个话题已经成为了本周的热点，引发了大量的讨论和争议。
examples.pinyin: Shèjiāo méitǐ shàng de zhège huàtí yǐjīng chéngwéi le běn zhōu de rèdiǎn, yǐnfāle dàliàng de tǎolùn hé zhēngyì.
examples.english: This topic on social media has become the hot spot of the week, sparking a lot of discussion and controversy.

examples.chinese: 长期喝热水虽然对身体有益，但过烫的水可能会增加食道癌的风险。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī hē rèshuǐ suīrán duì shēntǐ yǒuyì, dàn guòtàng de shuǐ kěnéng huì zēngjiā shídào'ái de fēngxiǎn.
examples.english: Although drinking hot water regularly is beneficial for the body, excessively hot water may increase the risk of esophageal cancer.

examples.chinese: 这款智能热水器不仅能节能省电，而且还可以通过手机APP远程控制温度。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn zhìnéng rèshuǐqì bújǐn néng jiéy能省diàn, érqiě háishi kěyǐ tōngguò shǒujī APP yuǎnchéng kòngzhì wēndù.
examples.english: This smart water heater not only saves energy and electricity, but can also remotely control the temperature through a mobile phone app.

examples.chinese: 公司建立了一条客服热线，方便消费者随时反映问题。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jiànlìle yī tiáo kèfú rèxiàn, fāngbiàn xiāofèizhě suíshí fǎnyìng wèntí.
examples.english: The company established a customer service hotline to make it convenient for consumers to report issues at any time.

examples.chinese: 许多国际组织致力于在全球范围内推动和保护人权。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō guójì zǔzhī zhìlì yú zài quánqiú fànwéi nèi tuīdòng hé bǎohù rénquán.
examples.english: Many international organizations are committed to promoting and protecting human rights on a global scale.

examples.chinese: 他日夜不懈地工作，只为了完成这个重要的项目。
examples.pinyin: Tā rìyè búxié de gōngzuò, zhǐ wèile wánchéng zhège zhòngyào de xiàngmù.
examples.english: He worked day and night without rest, solely to complete this important project.

examples.chinese: 这个项目看起来很有前景，但实际执行起来却是困难重重。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù kàn qǐlái hěn yǒu qiánjǐng, dàn shí際zhíxíng qǐlái quèshì kùnnan chóngchóng.
examples.english: This project looked very promising, but in actual execution, it turned out to be full of difficulties.

examples.chinese: 虽然我们在政治立场上有分歧，但我们都认同教育改革的重要性。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán wǒmen zài zhèngzhì lìchǎng shang yǒu fēnqī, dàn wǒmen dōu rèntóng jiàoyù gǎigé de zhòngyàoxìng.
examples.english: Although we disagree on political stance, we both agree on the importance of educational reform.

examples.chinese: 这部电影成功地融合了传统文化和现代审美，获得了广泛的认可。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng chénggōng de rónghé le chuántǒng wénhuà hé xiàndài shěnměi, huòdé le guǎngfàn de rènkě.
examples.english: This film successfully blended traditional culture with modern aesthetics and gained widespread recognition.

examples.chinese: 随着时间的推移，他逐渐融入了这个新的文化环境。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe shíjiān de tuīyí, tā zhújiàn róngrù le zhège xīn de wénhuà huánjìng.
examples.english: As time passed, he gradually melted into and adapted to this new cultural environment.

examples.chinese: 随着中日文化交流的深入，越来越多的年轻人开始学习日语，希望能更好地理解日本的文学和艺术。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe zhōng-rì wénhuà jiāoliú de shēnrù, yuèláiyuè duō de niánqīngrén kāishǐ xuéxí rìyǔ, xīwàng néng gèng hǎo de lǐjiě rìběn de wénxué hé yìshù.
examples.english: With the deepening of Sino-Japanese cultural exchanges, more and more young people have begun learning Japanese, hoping to better understand Japanese literature and art.

examples.chinese: 如果我们按照计划进行改革，公司的业绩应该会有显著的提高。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ wǒmen ānzhào jìhuà jìnxíng gǎigé, gōngsī de yèjī yīnggāi huì yǒu xiǎnzhù de tígāo.
examples.english: If we carry out reforms according to the plan, the company's performance should show significant improvement.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的合作，两个公司的目标已经如一，都致力于开发可持续的能源技术。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de héuzuò, liǎng ge gōngsī de mùbiāo yǐjīng rúyī, dōu zhìlì yú kāifā kěchíxù de néngliàng jìshù.
examples.english: After years of cooperation, the two companies' goals have become as one, both dedicated to developing sustainable energy technology.

examples.chinese: 长期过量摄入高脂肪的乳制品会增加患心血管疾病的风险。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī guòliàng摄入 gāo zhīf肪 de rǔzhìpǐn huì zēngjiā huànyàn xīnxiěguǎn jíbìng de fēngxiǎn.
examples.english: Consuming excessive amounts of high-fat dairy products over a long period increases the risk of cardiovascular disease.

examples.chinese: 我对这个计划的看法与大多数人不入，但我相信时间会证明我的观点。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhège jìhuà de kànfǎ yǔ dàduōshù rén bù rù, dàn wǒ xiāngxìn shíjiān huì zhèngmíng wǒ de guāndiǎn.
examples.english: My views on this plan don't agree with most people's, but I believe time will prove my perspective.

examples.chinese: 随着教育改革的深入推进，越来越多的学生能够顺利入学到理想的大学。
examples.pinyin: Suí着jiàoyù gǎigé de shēnrù tuījìn, yuèláiyuè duō de xuésheng nénggoù shùnlì rùxué dào lǐxiǎng de dàxué.
examples.english: With the continuous advancement of educational reform, more and more students are able to successfully enter their ideal universities.

examples.chinese: 若要在这个行业取得成功，你必须具备强大的适应能力和创新思维。
examples.pinyin: Ruò yào zài zhège hángyè qǔdé chénggōng, nǐ bìxū jùbèi qiángdà de shìyìng néng力 hé chuàngxīn sīwéi.
examples.english: If you want to achieve success in this industry, you must possess strong adaptability and innovative thinking.

examples.chinese: 他用棉花塞住了瓶子的口子，防止灰尘进入。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng miánhuā sāi zhù le píngzi de kǒuzi, fángzhǐ huīchén jìnrù.
examples.english: He filled the bottle's opening with cotton to prevent dust from getting in.

examples.chinese: 这次国际象棋比赛吸引了来自世界各地的顶级棋手参赛。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì guójì xiàngqī bǐsài xīyǐnle lái zìyú shìjiè gèdì de dǐngjí qíshǒu cāngsài.
examples.english: This international chess competition attracted top players from all over the world to participate.

examples.chinese: 运动员们在赛场上的表现往往能够反映出他们多年来的训练成果。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòngyuányánmen zài sàichǎng shang de biǎoxiàn wǎngwǎng néng gòu fǎnyìng chūlái tāmen duō nián lái de xùnliàn chéngguǒ.
examples.english: The performance of athletes on the racetrack often reflects the results of their years of training.

examples.chinese: 这家咖啡店的三明治虽然价格不菲，但用料讲究，深受上班族的欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kāfēi diàn de sānmíngzhì suīrán jiàgé búfēi, dàn yònɡliào jiǎnɡjiu, shēnshòu shànɡbānzú de huānyínɡ.
examples.english: Although the sandwiches at this café are expensive, they are made with quality ingredients and are very popular with office workers.

examples.chinese: 登山者们克服了重重困难，终于站在了这座山峰的顶端，俯瞰着脚下壮阔的景色。
examples.pinyin: Dēngshānzhě men kèfúle zhòngzhòng kùnnan, zh终于 zhàn zài le zhè zuò shānfēng de dǐngduān, fǔkàn zhe jiǎoxià zhuàngkuò de jǐngsè.
examples.english: The mountaineers overcame tremendous difficulties and finally stood at the peak of this mountain, overlooking the magnificent scenery below their feet.

examples.chinese: 这条古老的商业路线穿过一个深深的山谷，连接了两个重要的城镇。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gǔlǎo de shāngyè lùxiàn chuānguò yī ge shēnshēn de shāngǔ, liánjiē le liǎng ge zhòngyào de chéngzhèn.
examples.english: This ancient trade route passes through a deep mountain valley, connecting two important towns.

examples.chinese: 由于管理不善,公司丧失了大量的市场份额,最终不得不宣布破产。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú guǎnlǐ búshàn, gōngsī sàngshī le dàliàng de shìchǎng fèn'é, zuìzh終búdé búyao xuānbù pòchǎn.
examples.english: Due to poor management, the company lost a significant market share and ultimately had to declare bankruptcy.

examples.chinese: 医生仔细地清理了伤口，以防止感染的风险。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng zǎixì de qīnglǐ le shāngkǒu, yǐ fángzhǐ gǎnrǎn de fēngxiǎn.
examples.english: The doctor carefully cleaned the wound to prevent the risk of infection.

examples.chinese: 这场地震造成了数千人的伤亡，救援工作仍在继续进行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dìzhèn zàochéngle shǔ qiān rén de shāngwáng, jiùyuán gōngzuò réng zài jìxù jìnxíng.
examples.english: This earthquake caused thousands of casualties, and rescue operations are still ongoing.

examples.chinese: 这片山坡上的野花每年春天都会盛开，吸引了许多摄影师来此创作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn shānpō shang de yě huā měi nián chūntiān dōu huì shèngkāi, xīyǐnle le xǔduō shè yǐng shī lái cǐ chuàngzuò.
examples.english: The wildflowers on this hillside bloom profusely every spring, attracting many photographers to create their works here.

examples.chinese: 医疗队迅速赶到现场，开始救治伤员，确保每一个伤员都能得到及时的医疗援助。
examples.pinyin: Yīliào duì xùnsù gǎndào xiànchǎng, kāishǐ jiùzhì shāngyuán, quèbǎo měi yī ge shāngyuán dōu néng huòdào jíshí de yīliào yuánzhù.
examples.english: The medical team quickly arrived at the scene and began treating the wounded, ensuring that every injured person received timely medical assistance.

english: see 商城縣|商城县[Shang1 cheng2 xian4]

examples.chinese: 这个新建的商城汇集了国内外知名品牌，吸引了大量消费者前来购物。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīnjiàn de shāngchéng huìjíle guónèiwài zhīmíng pǐnpái, xīyǐnle dàliàng xiāofèizhě qiánlái gòuwù.
examples.english: This newly built shopping mall brings together renowned domestic and international brands, attracting a large number of consumers to shop.

examples.chinese: 这家初创公司计划在明年上市，筹集资金用于扩展国际市场。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chūshǐ gōngsī jìhuà zài míng nián shàng shì, chóují zījīn yòngyú kuòzhǎn guójì shìchǎng.
examples.english: This startup company plans to go public next year to raise capital for expanding into international markets.

examples.chinese: 他被那个骗子的甜言蜜语骗得上当了，损失了一大笔钱。
examples.pinyin: Tā bèi nàge piànzi de tiányánmìyǔ piàn de shàngdàng le, sunshī le yī dà bǐ qián.
examples.english: He was duped by the scammer's sweet talk and lost a large sum of money.

examples.chinese: 这部新剧即将在中央电视台上演，预计会引起广泛的社会讨论。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xīn jù jí将zài zhōngyāng diànshìtái shàngyǎn, yùjì huì yǐnqǐ guǎngfàn de shèhuì tǎolùn.
examples.english: This new drama is about to be produced on CCTV, and it is expected to spark widespread social discussion.

examples.chinese: 许多人相信上帝创造了这个世界，但科学家们用进化论来解释生命的起源。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō rén xiāngxìn shàngdì chuàngzàole zhège shìjiè, dàn kēxuéjiāmen yòng jìnhuàlùn lái jiěshì shēngmìng de qǐyuán.
examples.english: Many people believe that the Creator made this world, but scientists use evolution to explain the origin of life.

examples.chinese: 新任总裁在股东大会上上台发表了他的愿景演讲。
examples.pinyin: Xīnrèn zǒngcái zài gǔdōng dàhuì shàng shàngtái fābiǎole tāde yuànjǐng yǎnjiǎng.
examples.english: The newly appointed CEO took the stage at the shareholders' meeting to deliver his vision speech.

examples.chinese: 厨师用一把银质的勺子轻轻地舀起汤汁，倒在精心装盘的菜肴上。
examples.pinyin: chúshī yòng yī bǎ yínzhì de sháozi qīngqīng de yáo qǐ tāngjī, dào zài jīngxīn zhuāngpán de càiyao shang.
examples.english: The chef gently scooped up the broth with a silver spoon and poured it over the carefully plated dish.

examples.chinese: 这道菜的味道复杂得让人舌头都有点麻木了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài de wèidào fùzá de ràng rén shétou dōu yǒudiǎn máamù le.
examples.english: The flavors of this dish are so complex that it even made my tongue go a bit numb.

examples.chinese: 这部少儿动画片虽然面向儿童，但其深刻的哲学思想也能引发成年人的思考。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù shàoér dònghuà piàn suīrán miànxiàng ér tóng, dàn qī shēnkè de zhéxué sīxiǎng yě néng yǐnfā chéngnián rén de sīkǎo.
examples.english: Although this children's animated film is aimed at kids, its profound philosophical ideas can also provoke adults' reflections.

examples.chinese: 这位获奖设计师凭借其创新的理念彻底改变了现代建筑的审美标准。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi huòjiǎng shèjìshī píngjiè qī chuàngxīn de lǐniàn chèdǐ gǎibiàn le xiàndài jiànzhù de shěnměi biāozhǔn.
examples.english: This award-winning architect completely transformed the aesthetic standards of modern architecture through his innovative concepts.

examples.chinese: 为了推动经济发展，政府决定深化改革开放政策。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tuīdòng jīngjì fāzhǎn, zhèngfǔ juédìng shēnhuà gǎigé kāifàng zhèngcè.
examples.english: In order to promote economic development, the government decided to deepen the reform and opening-up policies.

examples.chinese: 这个项目涉及多个部门的合作，需要我们密切沟通。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù shèjí duō ge bùmén de hézuò, xūyào wǒmen mìqiè gōutōng.
examples.english: This project involves cooperation among multiple departments, requiring close communication from us.

examples.chinese: 这次失败让他深深地反思了自己的人生选择。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài ràng tā shēnshēn de fǎnsī le zìjǐ de rénshēng xuǎnzé.
examples.english: This failure caused him to deeply reflect on his life choices.

examples.chinese: 这份合同需要法律部门审查后才能签署。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn héntóng xūyào fǎlǜ bùmén shěnchá hòu cái néng qiānshǔ.
examples.english: This contract needs to be examined by the legal department before it can be signed.

examples.chinese: 公司决定升级我们的系统，以便更好地应对市场竞争。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng shēngjí wǒmen de xìtǒng, yǐbiàn gèng hǎo de yìngduì shìchǎng jìngjìng.
examples.english: The company decided to upgrade our system in order to better cope with market competition.

examples.chinese: 随着教育改革的深入，越来越多的学生通过多元化的途径实现升学梦想。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe jiàoyù gǎigé de shēnrù, yuèláiyuè duō de xuésheng tōngguò duōyuánhuà de tújìng shíxiàn shēngxué梦xiǎng.
examples.english: With the deepening of educational reform, more and more students are realizing their dreams of entering higher education through diversified pathways.

examples.chinese: 随着物价上涨，大学生的生活费越来越难以维持日常开支。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe wùjià shànngzhǎng, dàxuéshēng de shēnghuófèi yuèláiyuè nányǐ wéichí rìcháng kāizhī.
examples.english: As prices rise, students' cost of living becomes increasingly insufficient to cover daily expenses.

examples.chinese: 与其盲目消费，不如学会理性购物来省钱，这样才能为未来的投资做好准备。
examples.pinyin: Yǔqī mángmù xiāofèi, búrú xuéhuì lǐxìng gòuwù lái shěngqián, zhèyàng cáinéng wèi wèilái de tóuzī zuòhǎo zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: Rather than spending blindly, it's better to learn rational shopping to save money, so you can prepare well for future investments.

examples.chinese: 由于经济形势好转，这些房产在过去几年里升值了不少。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú jīngjì xíngshì hǎozhuǎn, zhèxiē fángchǎn zài guòqù jǐ nián lǐ shēngzhí le búshǎo.
examples.english: Due to the improvement in economic conditions, these properties have appreciated considerably over the past few years.

examples.chinese: 每年圣诞节，这家商场都会举办盛大的促销活动，吸引了大量的消费者。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián Shèngdàn Jié, zhè jiā shāngchǎng dōu huì jǔbàn shèngdà de cùxiāo huódòng, xīyǐnle dàliàng de xiāofèizhě.
examples.english: Every Christmas, this shopping mall holds grand promotional activities that attract a large number of consumers.

examples.chinese: 这位武术师父用了三十年的时间才完全掌握了传统功夫的精髓。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi wǔshù shīfu yòngle sānshí nián de shíjiān cái wánquán zhǎngwòle chuántǒng gōngfu de jīngsuǐ.
examples.english: This martial arts master took thirty years to fully master the essence of traditional kung fu.

examples.chinese: 在社交媒体时代，各种消费理念在年轻人中盛行，这也改变了他们的生活方式。
examples.pinyin: Zài shèjiāo méitǐ shídài, gèzhǒng xiāofèi lǐniàn zài niánqīngrén zhōng shèngxíng, zhè yě gǎibiàn le tāmen de shēnghuó fāngshì.
examples.english: In the era of social media, various consumer concepts are prevalent among young people, which has also changed their lifestyle.

examples.chinese: 每到春天这个时节，南方的茶农就开始采摘新茶，这是一年中最忙碌的时候。
examples.pinyin: Měi dào chūntiān zhège shíjié, nánfāng de chánóng jiù kāishǐ cǎizhāi xīnchá, zhè shì yī nián zhōng zuì mánglu de shíhou.
examples.english: Every spring season, tea farmers in the south begin to harvest new tea, which is the busiest time of the year.

examples.chinese: 这次学术研讨会加强了师生之间的沟通，让大家对专业有了更深入的理解。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì xuéshù yántǎohuì jiāqiáng le shīshēng zhījiān de gōutōng, ràng dàjiā duì zhuānyè yǒu le gèng shēnrù de lǐjiě.
examples.english: This academic seminar strengthened communication between teachers and students, allowing everyone to gain a deeper understanding of their field of study.

examples.chinese: 在这个竞争激烈的时代，我们需要时时保持警惕，不能有丝毫的懈怠。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège jìngjìng jīliè de shídài, wǒmen xūyào shíshí bǎochí jǐngtì, búnéng yǒu sīháo de xièdài.
examples.english: In this fiercely competitive era, we need to always remain vigilant and cannot afford any slackness.

examples.chinese: 改革开放初期，中国经济增长的速度令世界瞩目。
examples.pinyin: Gǎigé kāifàng chūqī, Zhōngguó jīngjì zēngzhǎng de sùdù lìng shìjiè zhǔmù.
examples.english: During the initial period of reform and opening up, the speed of China's economic growth captured the world's attention.

examples.chinese: 这位设计师的时装系列在巴黎时装周上获得了评论家的广泛认可。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi shèjìshī de shízhuāng xìliè zài Bālì shízhuāng zhōu shang huòdéle píngluènjiā de guǎng泛 rènkě.
examples.english: This designer's fashion collection received widespread recognition from critics at Paris Fashion Week.

examples.chinese: 在这个城市生活了十年，我时而会想起故乡的那条老街。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège chéngshì shēnghuó le shí nián, wǒ shíér huì xiǎngqǐ gùxiāng de nà tiáo lǎo jiē.
examples.english: After living in this city for ten years, I occasionally think back to that old street in my hometown.

examples.chinese: 他凭借丰富的人生阅历，能够识别出许多人看不出的细微差别。
examples.pinyin: Tā píngjiè fēngfù de rénshēng yuèlì, néng gòu shíbié chū xǔduō rén kàn bu chūlái de xìwēi chābié.
examples.english: Based on his rich life experience, he was able to identify subtle differences that many people couldn't perceive.

examples.chinese: 只有通过长期的实践，我们才能真正掌握这项技能。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu tōngguò chángqī de shíjiàn, wǒmen cáinéng zhēnzhèng zhǎng握 zhè xiàng jìnéng.
examples.english: Only through long-term practice can we truly master this skill.

examples.chinese: 长期的工作压力严重影响了他的食欲，医生建议他休息几周来调理身体。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī de gōngzuò yālì yánzhòng yǐngxiǎngle tā de shíyù, yīshēng jiànyì tā xiūxi jǐ zhōu lái tiáolǐ shēntǐ.
examples.english: Prolonged work stress seriously affected his appetite, and the doctor advised him to rest for a few weeks to recuperate.

examples.chinese: 随着城市发展,越来越多的市民开始关注环保问题。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe chéngshì fāzhǎn, yuèláiyuè duō de shìmín kāishǐ guānzhù huánbǎo wèntí.
examples.english: As the city develops, more and more citizens are beginning to pay attention to environmental protection issues.

examples.chinese: 政府决定在几个城市建立试点项目，以便评估这项新政策的可行性。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ juédìng zài jǐ ge chéngshì jiànlì shìdiǎn xiàngmù, yǐbiàn pínggu zhè xiàng xīn zhèngcè de kěxíngxìng.
examples.english: The government decided to establish pilot projects in several cities in order to assess the feasibility of this new policy.

examples.chinese: 在处理这个敏感问题时，我们需要采取适当的措施来平衡各方的利益。
examples.pinyin: Zài chǔlǐ zhège mǐngǎn wèntí shí, wǒmen xūyào cǎiqǔ shìdàng de cuòshī lái pínghuà gè fāng de lìyì.
examples.english: When dealing with this sensitive issue, we need to take appropriate measures to balance the interests of all parties.

examples.chinese: 他事后才意识到自己的决定有多么愚蠢，但已经太晚了。
examples.pinyin: Tā shìhòu cái yìshí dào zìjǐ de juéding yǒu duōme yúchǔn, dàn yǐjīng tài wǎn le.
examples.english: Only after the fact did he realize how foolish his decision was, but it was already too late.

examples.chinese: 他花了二十年的时间收藏了数千件古董，这个收藏已经成为了他人生中最重要的财富。
examples.pinyin: Tā huāle èrshí nián de shíjiān shōucáng le shù qiān jiàn gǔdǒng, zhège shōucáng yǐjīng chéngwéile tā rénshēng zhōng zuì zhòngyào de cáifù.
examples.english: He spent twenty years collecting thousands of antiques, and this collection has become the most important wealth in his life.

examples.chinese: 在那个物资匮乏的年代，能够识字已经是一种奢侈，许多人因此失去了改变命运的机会。
examples.pinyin: Zài nàge wùzī kuìfá de niándài, nénggoù shí zì yǐjīng shì yī zhǒng shēchǐ, xǔduō rén yīncǐ shīqù le gǎibiàn mìngyùn de jīhuì.
examples.english: In that era of material scarcity, being able to read and write was already a luxury, and many people consequently lost the opportunity to change their fate.

english: to take in and care for (an elderly person

examples.chinese: 这对退休夫妇决定收养一位孤独的老人，让他在晚年不再感到孤独。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì tuìxiū fūfù juédìng shōuyǎng yī wèi gūdú de lǎorén, ràng tā zài wǎnnián búzài gǎndào gūdú.
examples.english: This retired couple decided to take in and care for a lonely elderly man, so he wouldn't feel so isolated in his later years.

examples.chinese: 银行转账时收取的手续费虽然不多，但如果频繁操作的话，长期累积起来也是一笔不小的开支。
examples.pinyin: Yínháng zhuǎnzhàng shí shōuqǔ de shǒuxùfèi suīrán búduō, dàn rúguǒ pí繁 cāozuò dehuà, chángqī lěijī qǐlai yěshi yībǐ búxiǎo de kāizhī.
examples.english: Although the service charge collected by banks during transfers is not much, if you operate frequently, the long-term accumulation can still be a considerable expense.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅对外卖订单收取了一笔配送费，引起了不少顾客的不满。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng duì wàimài dìngdān shōuqǔ le yī bǐ pèisòngfèi, yǐnqǐ le búshǎo gùkè de búmǎn.
examples.english: This restaurant charges a delivery fee for takeout orders, which has caused dissatisfaction among many customers.

examples.chinese: 这首诗歌深深触动了我的心灵。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu shīgē shēnshēn chùdòng le wǒ de xīnlíng.
examples.english: This poem touched my heart deeply.

examples.chinese: 两国首脑就贸易协议进行了深入的谈判。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng guó shǒunǎo jiù màoyì xiéyì jìnxíng le shēnrù de tánpàn.
examples.english: The heads of state of the two countries conducted in-depth negotiations on the trade agreement.

examples.chinese: 这位首席设计师凭借其创新理念为公司赢得了多项国际大奖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi shǒuxí shèjìshī píngjiè qī chuàngxīn lǐniàn wèi gōngsī yíngdéle duō xiàng guójì dàjiǎng.
examples.english: This chief designer won multiple international awards for the company through his innovative ideas.

examples.chinese: 这是我们公司首次参加国际贸易博览会，希望能开拓更多的海外市场。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒmen gōngsī shǒucì cānjiā guójì màoyì博lǎnhuì, xīwàng néng kāituò gèngduō de hǎiwài shìchǎng.
examples.english: This is the first time our company has participated in an international trade expo, and we hope to expand more overseas markets.

examples.chinese: 他在书房里埋头工作了整个下午，只为了在截止日期前完成这个重要项目。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài shūfáng lǐ máitóu gōngzuò le zhěngge xiàwǔ, zhǐ wèile zài ji截zhǐ rìq期 qián wánchéng zhège zhòngyào xiàngmù.
examples.english: He buried himself in work in his study all afternoon, just to complete this important project before the deadline.

english: prime minister (of Japan or UK etc)

examples.chinese: 英国新任首相宣布了一系列经济改革政策，希望能够刺激国内消费。
examples.pinyin: Yīngguó xīnrèn shǒuxiàng xuānbùle yīxìliè jīngjì gǎigé zhèngcè, xīwàng nénggoù cìjī guónèi xiāofèi.
examples.english: The newly appointed British Prime Minister announced a series of economic reform policies, hoping to stimulate domestic consumption.

examples.chinese: 他们决定参加今年的网球双打比赛，希望能够赢得冠军。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen juédìng cānjiā jīnnián de wǎngqiú shuāngdǎ bǐsài, xīwàng nénggoù yíngdé guànjūn.
examples.english: They decided to participate in this year's tennis doubles match, hoping to win the championship.

examples.chinese: 这个夏天在海边游泳真爽，咸咸的海风吹在身上特别舒服。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàtiān zài hǎibiān yóuyǒng zhēn shuǎng, xiányányán de hǎifēng chuī zài shēnshang tèbié shūfu.
examples.english: Swimming by the sea this summer is really refreshing; the salty sea breeze blowing on my body feels especially comfortable.

examples.chinese: 这座桥的主体结构采用了最新的水泥技术，预计能够使用一百年以上。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiào de zhǔtǐ jiégòu cǎiyòngle zuìxīn de shuǐní jìshù, yùjì néng gòu shǐyòng yībǎi nián yǐshàng.
examples.english: The main structure of this bridge adopts the latest cement technology and is expected to last for over a hundred years.

examples.chinese: 政府决定提高进口商品的税率，以保护国内产业的发展。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ juédìng tígāo jìnkǒu shāngpǐn de shuìlǜ, yǐ bǎohù guónèi chǎnyè de fāzhǎn.
examples.english: The government decided to raise the tax rate on imported goods in order to protect the development of domestic industries.

examples.chinese: 她决定顺从父母的意愿，放弃了出国深造的计划。
examples.pinyin: Tā juédìng shùncóng fùmǔ de yìyuàn, fàngqì le chūguó shēnzào de jìhuà.
examples.english: She decided to obey her parents' wishes and gave up her plan to study abroad.

examples.chinese: 这家快餐店的薯条虽然便宜，但是质量参差不齐，有时候炸得太焦，有时候又不够脆。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kuàicān diàn de shǔtiáo suīrán piányi, búshì zhìliàng cānchā búqī, yǒushíhou zhá de tài jiāo, yǒushíhou yòu búgòu cuì.
examples.english: Although the french fries at this fast food restaurant are cheap, the quality is inconsistent; sometimes they're fried too dark, and sometimes they're not crispy enough.

examples.chinese: 这台机器的说明书写得不太清楚，我花了半天才弄明白怎么使用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì de shuōmíngshū xiě de búduō qīngchu, wǒ huāle bàn tiān cái nòngmingbai zěnyàng shǐyòng.
examples.english: The manual for this machine is not very clear, and it took me half a day to figure out how to use it.

examples.chinese: 这位司长在会议上强调了改革创新的重要性。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi sīzhǎng zài huìyì shang qiánghuà le gǎigé chuàngxīn de zhòngyàoxìng.
examples.english: The bureau chief emphasized the importance of reform and innovation at the meeting.

examples.chinese: 说实话，这个项目的前景并不如我们最初想象的那么乐观。
examples.pinyin: Shuō shíhuà, zhège xiàngmù de qiánjǐng bìngbù rúguǒ wǒmen zuìchū xiǎngxiàng de nàme lèguān.
examples.english: To be honest, the prospects of this project are not as optimistic as we initially imagined.

examples.chinese: 这场车祸造成了五人死亡，另有十几人受伤。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng chēhuò zàochéngle wǔ rén sǐwáng, lìngyǒu shíjǐ rén shòushāng.
examples.english: This car accident resulted in five deaths, with dozens more injured.

examples.chinese: 他在公司里四处碰壁，最后决定辞职去创业。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gōngsī lǐ sìchù pèngbì, zuìhòu juédìng辞职 qù chuàngyè.
examples.english: He kept running into obstacles everywhere in the company, and finally decided to resign and start his own business.

examples.chinese: 这座古寺的建筑风格融合了唐宋时期的特色，吸引了许多建筑学家前来研究。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔ sì de jiànzhù fēnggé rónghé le Tángsòng shíqī de tèsè, xīyǐnle xǔduō jiànzhùxuéjiā qiánlái yánjiū.
examples.english: This ancient temple's architectural style combines the characteristics of the Tang and Song dynasties, attracting many architects to come and study it.

examples.chinese: 在中国，送礼讲究很多礼仪，送什么、怎么送都能反映出你对对方的尊重。
examples.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó, sòng lǐ jiǎngjiù hěn duō lǐyí, sòng shénme, zěnyàng sòng dōu néng fǎnyìng chū nǐ duì duìfang de zūnjìng.
examples.english: In China, giving gifts involves many etiquettes; what you give and how you give it can all reflect your respect for the other person.

examples.chinese: 他们在机场为即将出国留学的女儿送行，眼泪止不住地流了下来。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài jīchǎng wéi jíjiāng chūguó liúxué de nǚ'ér sòng xíng, yǎnlèi zhǐ buzhù de liúle xiàlái.
examples.english: They saw off their daughter at the airport as she was about to study abroad, and tears streamed down their faces uncontrollably.

examples.chinese: 作为领导者，你的个人素质直接影响团队的整体表现。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi lǐngdǎozhě, nǐ de gèrén sùzhì zhíji接yǐngxiǎng tuánduì de zhěngtǐ biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: As a leader, your personal calibre directly affects the overall performance of the team.

examples.chinese: 虽然他只有高中文凭，但凭着多年的工作经验，在这个领域算是专家了。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā zhǐyǒu gāozhōng wénpíng, dàn píngzhe duōnián de gōngzuò jīngyàn, zài zhège lǐngyù suànshì zhuānjiā le.
examples.english: Although he only has a high school diploma, with years of work experience, he can be regarded as an expert in this field.

examples.chinese: 虽然他的家庭背景不如别人，但他通过自己的努力最终考上了名牌大学。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā de jiātíng bèijǐng búrú biérén, dàn tā tōngguò zìjǐ de nǔlì zuìzhōng kǎoshàngle míngpái dàxué.
examples.english: Although his family background was not as privileged as others, he eventually got into a prestigious university through his own effort.

examples.chinese: 我们已经争论了半天，算了，就按你的方案去做吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yǐjīng zhēnglùnle bàn tiān, suànle, jiù àn nǐ de fāng'àn qù zuò ba.
examples.english: We've been arguing for ages. Forget about it, let's just go with your plan.

examples.chinese: 他虽然没有高学历，但做事很踏实，客户都很信任他。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán méiyǒu gāo xuéhuà, dàn zuòshì hěn tāshi, kèhù dōu hěn xìnrèn tā.
examples.english: Although he doesn't have a high education background, he is very dependable in his work, and all his clients trust him.

examples.chinese: 他虽然岁数不小了，但仍然坚持每天锻炼身体。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán suìshu búxiǎo le, dàn仍rán jiānchí měitiān duànliàn shēntǐ.
examples.english: Although he's quite old in age, he still insists on exercising every day.

examples.chinese: 这座古塔经历了几个世纪的风雨，依然屹立在山顶上，见证了无数历史的沧桑。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔ tǎ jīnglìle jǐ ge shìjì de fēngyǔ, yīránán yìlì zài shāndǐng shang, jiànzhèng le wúshù lìshǐ de cāngsāng.
examples.english: This ancient pagoda has weathered centuries of wind and rain, still standing majestically on the mountaintop, witnessing the vicissitudes of countless historical periods.

examples.chinese: 他踏入这个陌生的城市，开始了全新的人生篇章。
examples.pinyin: Tā tàrù zhège mòshēng de chéngshì, kāishǐle quánxīn de rénshēng piānzhāng.
examples.english: He stepped into this unfamiliar city and began a completely new chapter of his life.

examples.chinese: 他所做的一切都是为了保护自己所爱的人。
examples.pinyin: Tā suǒ zuòde yīqiè dōu shì wèile bǎohù zìjǐ suǒ ài de rén.
examples.english: Everything that he did was to protect the people whom he loved.

examples.chinese: 这盏台灯的设计相当简洁，既能节省电力，又不会显得太单调。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǎn táidēng de shèjì xiāngdāng jiǎnjiē, jì néng jiéshěng diànlì, yòu búhuì xiǎnde tài dāndiào.
examples.english: This desk lamp has a fairly minimalist design that both saves electricity and doesn't look too monotonous.

examples.chinese: 听到这个消息后，他不禁叹气，觉得自己多年的努力都白费了。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxī hòu, tā búnjìn tànqì, juéde zìjǐ duō nián de nǔlì dōu báifèi le.
examples.english: After hearing this news, he couldn't help but sigh, feeling that his years of effort had been wasted.

examples.chinese: 科学家们正在探索宇宙的奥秘，希望能找到地球外生命存在的证据。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā men zhèngzài tànsuǒ yǔzhòu de àomì, xīwàng néng zhǎodào dìqiú wài shēngmìng cunzài de zhèngjù.
examples.english: Scientists are exploring the mysteries of the universe, hoping to find evidence of extraterrestrial life.

examples.chinese: 随着环保意识的提高，越来越多的家庭开始安装太阳能电池板来降低能源成本。
examples.pinyin: suízhe huànbǎo yìshí de tíhuà, yuèláiyuè duō de jiātíng kāishǐ ānzhuāng tàiyángnéng diànchíbǎn lái jiàngdī nényuán chéngběn.
examples.english: As environmental awareness increases, more and more households are beginning to install solar panels to reduce energy costs.

examples.chinese: 在这次学术会议上，专家们深入探讨了人工智能对就业市场的长期影响。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè cì xuéshù huìyì shàng, zhuānjiā men shēnrù tàntǎole le réngōng zhìnéng duì jiùyè shìchǎng de chángqī yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: At this academic conference, experts thoroughly inquired into the long-term impact of artificial intelligence on the employment market.

examples.chinese: 这次出差我跑了三趟北京，每趟都要处理不同的项目。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chūchāi wǒ pǎole sān tàng Běijīng, měi tàng dōu yào chǔlǐ búhuàn de xiàngmù.
examples.english: On this business trip, I made three trips to Beijing, and each trip involved handling different projects.

examples.chinese: 他急忙掏出手机查看那条重要的信息。
examples.pinyin: Tā jímáng tāochū shǒujī chákankan nà tiáo zhòngyào de xìnxī.
examples.english: He hurriedly fished out his phone to check the important message.

examples.chinese: 这次洪水造成了特大灾难，整个地区都需要重建。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì hónghuǐ zàochéngle tèdà zāinàn, zhěngge dìqū dōu xūyào chóngjiàn.
examples.english: This flood caused an extraordinary disaster, and the entire region needs to be rebuilt.

examples.chinese: 她特地从北京飞过来参加我的婚礼，这让我感到特别感动。
examples.pinyin: Tā tèdì cóng běi jīng fēi guòlái cānjiā wǒ de hunyǐ, zhè ràng wǒ gǎndào tèbié gǎndòng.
examples.english: She flew all the way from Beijing on purpose to attend my wedding, which made me feel particularly moved.

examples.chinese: 这个设计师的作品特别注重细节，每一个元素都经过精心打磨。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shèjìshī de zuòpǐn tèbié zhùzhòng x细jié, měi yīgè yuánsù dōu jīngguò jīngxīn dǎmó.
examples.english: This designer's works are particularly focused on details, with every element carefully refined.

examples.chinese: 这班特快列车从北京到上海只需要十个小时。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bān tèkuài lièchē cóng Běijīng dào Shànghǎi zhǐ xūyào shí ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: This express train only takes ten hours from Beijing to Shanghai.

examples.chinese: 经过几个小时的手术后，患者反映腰部的疼痛逐渐减轻了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò jǐ ge xiǎoshíshi de shǒushù hòu, huànzhě fǎnyìng yāobù de téngtòng zhújiàn jiǎnqīng le.
examples.english: After several hours of surgery, the patient reported that the pain in the lower back gradually diminished.

examples.chinese: 她特意为了这次聚会买了一套新衣服，想要给大家留下深刻印象。
examples.pinyin: Tā tèyì wèile zhè cì jùhuì mǎile yī tào xīn yīfu, xiǎngyào gěi dàjiā liúxià shēnkè yìnxiàng.
examples.english: She specially bought a new outfit for this gathering because she wanted to make a deep impression on everyone.

examples.chinese: 他不小心踢到了桌子的腿，疼得直跳。
examples.pinyin: Tā búxiǎoxin tīdào le zhuōzi de tuǐ, ténɡ de zhí tiào.
examples.english: He accidentally kicked the table leg and jumped in pain.

examples.chinese: 这份项目报告必须在周五之前提交给董事会审核。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn xiàngmù bàogào bìxū zài zhōuwǔ zhīqián tíjiāo gěi dǒngshìhuì shěnhé.
examples.english: This project report must be submitted to the board of directors for review before Friday.

examples.chinese: 公司决定投入更多资源来提升员工的专业技能和工作效率。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng tóurù gèngduō zīyuán lái tíshēng yuángōng de zhuānyè jìnéng hé gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
examples.english: The company decided to invest more resources to enhance employees' professional skills and work efficiency.

examples.chinese: 这种天然矿物具有独特的物理性质，在工业生产中有广泛的应用前景。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng tiānrán kuàngwù jùyǒu dúté de wùlǐ xìngzhì, zài gōngyè shēngchǎn zhōng yǒu guǎngfàn de yìngyòng qiánjǐng.
examples.english: This kind of natural mineral possesses unique physical properties and has broad application prospects in industrial production.

examples.chinese: 对许多人来说，与家人共度时光就是人间天堂。
examples.pinyin: Duì xǔduō rén lái shuō, yǔ jiārén gòngdù shíguang jiùshì rénjiān tiāntáng.
examples.english: For many people, spending time with family is paradise on earth.

examples.chinese: 他决定离开城市，回到故乡的田地里务农，过上自给自足的生活。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéding líkāi chéngshì, huídào gùxiāng de tiándi lǐ wùnóng, guòshang zìgěi zìzú de shēnghuó.
examples.english: He decided to leave the city and return to the farmland in his hometown to farm, living a self-sufficient life.

examples.chinese: 历代君主都梦想着统一天下，但真正能够长久统治的人寥寥无几。
examples.pinyin: Lìkè jūnzhǔ dōu mengxiǎngzhe tǒngyī tiānxià, dàn zhēnzhèng néngggòu chángjiǔ tǒngzhì de rén liáoliáo wújǐ.
examples.english: Throughout history, every ruler dreamed of unifying all under heaven, but very few could actually maintain lasting rule.

examples.chinese: 这些新的功能为软件添加了更多的实用价值。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē xīn de gōngnéng wéi ruǎnjiàn tiānjiāle gèngduō de shíyòng jiàzhí.
examples.english: These new features add more practical value to the software.

examples.chinese: 作为一名田径运动员，她在国际比赛中为国家赢得了多枚金牌。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi yī míng tiánjìng yùndòngyuán, tā zài guójì bǐsài zhōng wèi guójiā yíngdéle duō méi jīnpái.
examples.english: As a track and field athlete, she won multiple gold medals for her country in international competitions.

examples.chinese: 奥运会上，中国跳水运动员以完美的技术赢得了金牌。
examples.pinyin: Àoyùnhuì shang, zhōngguó tiàoshuǐ yùndòngyuán yǐ wánměi de jìshù yíngdéle jīnpái.
examples.english: At the Olympics, Chinese divers won gold medals with perfect technique.

examples.chinese: 公司决定通报所有员工关于这次重组的最新进展。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng tōngbào suǒyǒu yuángōng guānyú zhè cì chóngzǔ de zuìxīn jìnzhǎn.
examples.english: The company decided to inform all employees about the latest developments regarding this reorganization.

examples.chinese: 经理在会议上听取了各部门关于第四季度业绩的汇报。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zài huìyì shang tīngqǔ le gè bùmén guānyú dì sì jìdù yèjī de huìbào.
examples.english: The manager heard reports from each department about their fourth quarter performance at the meeting.

examples.chinese: 这条地下通道连接了两个地铁站，大大缩短了乘客的出行时间。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo dìxià tōngdào liánjiē le liǎng ge dìtiězhàn, dàdà suōduǎn le chéngkè de chūxíng shíjiān.
examples.english: This underground passage connects two subway stations, significantly reducing the travel time for passengers.

examples.chinese: 夕阳西下，整片天空都被染成了通红的颜色，美得令人窒息。
examples.pinyin: Xīyáng xīxià, zhěngpiàn tiānkōng dōu bèi rǎnchéng le tōnghóng de yánsè, měi de lìngrén zhìxī.
examples.english: As the sun set in the west, the entire sky was dyed a fiery red, so beautiful it was breathtaking.

examples.chinese: 由于信号不好，我们的通话经常会断线，很难进行深入的沟通。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú xìnhào búhǎo, wǒmen de tōnghuà jīngcháng huì duànxiàn, hěnnan jìnxíng shēnrù de沟通。
examples.english: Due to poor signal, our calls often drop, making it difficult to have in-depth communication.

examples.chinese: 这两个问题的根源是同一个：缺乏有效的沟通机制。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge wèntí de gēnyuán shì tóng yī ge: quēfá yǒuxiào de gōutōng jīzhì.
examples.english: The root cause of these two problems is the same: a lack of effective communication mechanisms.

examples.chinese: 作为华侨，我们要为祖国的发展做出贡献，帮助海外的同胞解决实际困难。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi huáqiào, wǒmen yào wèi zǔguó de fāzhǎn zuòchū gòngxiàn, bāngzhù hǎiwài de tóngbāo jiějué shíjì kùnnan.
examples.english: As overseas Chinese, we should contribute to our motherland's development and help fellow compatriots abroad solve practical difficulties.

english: the corresponding time period (in a different year etc)

examples.chinese: 与去年同期相比，今年第一季度的销售额增长了百分之十五。
examples.pinyin: Yǔ qùnián tóngqī xiāngbǐ, jīnnián dì yī jìdù de xiāoshòu'é zēngzhǎngle bǎifēnzhī shíwǔ.
examples.english: Compared with the corresponding period last year, sales in the first quarter of this year increased by fifteen percent.

examples.chinese: 随着互联网的发展，远程通讯已经成为现代工作中不可或缺的一部分。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe hùliánwǎng de fāzhǎn, yuǎnchéng tōngxùn yǐjīng chéngwéi xiàndài gōngzuò zhōng búkěhuò quēshǎo de yībùfen.
examples.english: With the development of the internet, remote communication has become an indispensable part of modern work.

examples.chinese: 这位设计师在业界享有很高的声誉，连很多同行都对他的作品赞不绝口。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi shèjìshī zài yèji界 xiǎngyǒu hěn gāo de shēngyù, lián hěnduō tóngháng dōu duì tā de zuòpǐn zànbujuékǒu.
examples.english: This designer enjoys a high reputation in the industry, and even many of his peers speak highly of his works.

examples.chinese: 虽然只获得了铜牌，但这位运动员的表现已经超出了所有人的预期。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán zhǐ huòdéle le tóngpái, dàn zhè wèi yùndòngyuán de biǎoxiàn yǐjīng chāochūle le suǒyǒu rén de yùqī.
examples.english: Although he only won the bronze medal, this athlete's performance has already exceeded everyone's expectations.

examples.chinese: 这两个案件虽然表面上看起来不同，但实际上是同一个犯罪集团策划的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge ànjian suīrán biǎomiàn shang kàn qǐlai búzǎo, dàn shíjìshang shì tóngyī ge fànzuì jítuán cèhuà de.
examples.english: Although these two cases appear different on the surface, they were actually planned by the same criminal organization.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的复杂性让我头疼，但我们必须在截止日期前完成。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de fùzáxìng ràng wǒ tóuténg, dàn wǒmen bìxū zài ji截zhǐ rìqī qián wánchéng.
examples.english: The complexity of this project gives me a headache, but we must complete it before the deadline.

examples.chinese: 这次选举中，每个公民都有权利投票决定国家的未来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì xuǎnjǔ zhōng, měi ge gōngmín dōu yǒu quánlì tóupiào juéding guójiā de wèilái.
examples.english: In this election, every citizen has the right to vote to determine the future of the country.

examples.chinese: 这家图书馆的古籍图书收藏令许多学者慕名而来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā túshūguǎn de gǔjí túshū shōucáng lìng xǔduō xuézhě mùmíng érláI.
examples.english: The rare book collection at this library attracts many scholars from far and wide.

examples.chinese: 这位高管在采访中不小心透露了公司即将推出的新产品信息。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi gāoguǎn zài càifǎng zhōng búxiǎoxin tòulùle gōngsī jíjiāng tuīchū de xīn chǎnpǐn xìnxī.
examples.english: The executive accidentally exposed information about the company's upcoming new product during an interview.

examples.chinese: 要想解决这个问题，我们必须找到一条新的途径，而不是一味地重复过去的做法。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng jiějué zhège wèntí, wǒmen bìxū zhǎodào yī tiáo xīn de tújìng, érbúshì yīyìde chóngfù guòqù de zuòfǎ.
examples.english: To solve this problem, we must find a new track/approach, rather than simply repeating what we did in the past.

examples.chinese: 这位老师傅已经收了三个徒弟，他们都在认真学习传统手工艺。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo shīfu yǐjīng shōule sān ge túdi, tāmen dōu zài rènzhēn xuéxí chuántǒng shǒugōng yìyi.
examples.english: This master craftsman has already taken on three apprentices, and they are all diligently learning traditional craftsmanship.

examples.chinese: 这片贫瘠的土地经过几代农民的耕耘，如今已经变成了肥沃的土壤。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn pínjì de tǔdì jīngguò jǐ dài nóngmín de gēngyún, rújīn yǐjīng biànchéngle féiwò de tǔrǎng.
examples.english: After generations of farmers' cultivation, this once barren land has now become fertile soil.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的成功离不开整个团队的共同努力和默契配合。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de chénggōng líbukāi zhěngge tuánduì de gòngtóng nǔlì hé mòqì pèihé.
examples.english: The success of this project is inseparable from the joint efforts and tacit cooperation of the entire team.

examples.chinese: 由于账户余额不足，他的支票被银行退票了，这让他在业务合作中失去了信誉。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú zhànghuò yúée búzú, tā de zhīpiào bèi yínháng tuìpiàole, zhè ràng tā zài yèwù hézuò zhōng shīqùle xìnyù.
examples.english: Because of insufficient account balance, his check bounced at the bank, which caused him to lose credibility in business dealings.

examples.chinese: 他听到这个消息后，难以接受，只能把所有的委屈都吞了下去。
examples.pinyin: Tā tīngdào zhège xiāoxī hòu, nányǐ jiēshòu, zhǐnéng bǎ suǒyǒu de wěiqu dōu tūn le xiàqu.
examples.english: After hearing this news, he found it hard to accept and could only swallow all his grievances.

examples.chinese: 这家科技公司最近推出了一款革命性的智能手机，预计将改变整个行业的格局。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kējì gōngsī zuìjìn tuīchūle yī ku��ǎn gémìngxìng de zhìnéng shǒujī, yùjì jiāng gǎibiàn zhěngge hángyè de géjú.
examples.english: This tech company recently launched a revolutionary smartphone, which is expected to reshape the landscape of the entire industry.

examples.chinese: 他托着下巴，陷入了沉思。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuōzhe xiàba, xiànrù le chéngsī.
examples.english: He held his chin in his palm, lost in deep thought.

examples.chinese: 他拖延了几个月才提交报告，这让团队的进度严重受阻。
examples.pinyin: Tā tuōyán le jǐ ge yuè cái tíjiāo bàogào, zhè ràng tuánduì de jìnzhào yánzhòng shòuzǔ.
examples.english: He dragged out the submission of the report for several months, which seriously hindered the team's progress.

examples.chinese: 他穿着拖鞋在客厅里踱步，思考着如何解决这个棘手的问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā穿着tuōxié在客厅里踱步，思考着如何解决这个棘手的问题。
examples.english: He paced around the living room in slippers, pondering how to solve this thorny problem.

examples.chinese: 考古学家们在这片遗址上挖掘了许多珍贵的文物，为了解古代文明提供了重要的线索。
examples.pinyin: Kǎogǔ xuéjiā men zài zhè piàn yízhǐ shang wājiué le xǔduō zhēnguì de wénwù, wèile liǎojiě gǔdài wénmíng tígōngle zhòngyào de xiànsuǒ.
examples.english: Archaeologists excavated many precious artifacts at this site, providing important clues for understanding ancient civilization.

examples.chinese: 这个古老的布娃娃虽然褪色了，但对我来说仍然有着不可替代的感情价值。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǔlǎo de bù wáwa suīrán tuìsè le, dàn duì wǒ lái shuō réngránhuà yǒuzhe búkě tìdàidài de gǎnqíng jiàzhí.
examples.english: Although this old cloth doll has faded, it still holds irreplaceable sentimental value for me.

examples.chinese: 由于汇率波动频繁，许多跨国公司都会采取措施来规避外币风险。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú huìlǜ bōdòng pínp繁，xǔduō kuàguó gōngsī dōu huì cǎiqǔ cuòshī lái guīhuì wàibì fēngxiǎn。
examples.english: Due to frequent exchange rate fluctuations, many multinational corporations take measures to hedge against foreign currency risks.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的外部压力很大，我们需要找到内部解决方案。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de wàibù yālì hěn dà, wǒmen xūyào zhǎodào nèibù jiějué fāng'àn.
examples.english: This project faces great external pressure, so we need to find internal solutions.

examples.chinese: 由于疫情的影响，许多人选择减少外出，以保护自己和他人的健康。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yìqíng de yǐngxiǎng, xǔduō rén xuǎnzé jiǎnshǎo wàichū, yǐ bǎohù zìjǐ hé tārén de jiànkāng.
examples.english: Due to the impact of the pandemic, many people chose to reduce going out in order to protect their own and others' health.

examples.chinese: 看到这幅古代书法作品，我不禁哇地叫了一声，那笔触的精妙之处真是令人叹为观止。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào zhè fú gǔdài shūfǎ zuòpǐn, wǒ bújìn wa de jiàole yī shēng, nà bǐchù de jīngmiào zhī chù zhēnshi lìngrén tànwéi guānzhǐ.
examples.english: Upon seeing this ancient calligraphy work, I couldn't help but exclaim 'Wah!', the subtlety of every brushstroke is truly astounding.

examples.chinese: 他在医院的外科做了三十年的手术，积累了丰富的临床经验。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yīyuàn de wàikē zuòle sānshí nián de shǒushù, jīlěile fēngfù de línchúang jīngyàn.
examples.english: He performed surgeries in the hospital's surgery department for thirty years and accumulated rich clinical experience.

examples.chinese: 这款新产品的外观设计虽然简洁，但却赢得了许多消费者的青睐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xīn chǎnpǐn de wàiguān shèjì suīrán jiǎnjiē, dàn却 yíngdéle xǔduō xiāofèizhě de qīngài.
examples.english: Although the appearance design of this new product is simple, it has won the favor of many consumers.

examples.chinese: 这个政治运动的真实目的被一层民族主义的外衣所掩盖。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhèngzhì yùndòng de zhēnshí mùdì bèi yī céng mínzúzhǔyì de wàiyī suǒ yǎngài.
examples.english: The true purpose of this political movement was concealed by a veneer of nationalism.

examples.chinese: 这个城市吸引了大量外来务工人员，他们为当地经济发展做出了重要贡献。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì xīyǐnle dàliàng wàilái wùgōng rényuán, tāmen wèi dāngdì jīngjì fāzhǎn zuòchūle zhòngyào gòngxiàn.
examples.english: This city has attracted a large number of migrant workers, who have made important contributions to local economic development.

examples.chinese: 随着改革开放，越来越多的外资企业选择在中国建立生产基地。
examples.pinyin: Suí着gǎigé kāifàng, yuèláiyuè duō de wàizī qǐyè xuǎnzé zài Zhōngguó jiànlì shēngchǎn jīdì.
examples.english: With the reform and opening-up policy, more and more foreign capital enterprises choose to establish production bases in China.

examples.chinese: 外头的天气这么糟糕，我们还是待在家里看电影吧。
examples.pinyin: Wàitou de tiānqì zhème zāogāo, wǒmen háishi dāi zài jiāli kàn diànyǐng ba.
examples.english: The weather outside is so terrible, we might as well stay home and watch a movie.

examples.chinese: 长期的压力会弯曲一个人的价值观和判断力。
examples.pinyin: Cháng期 de yālì huì wānqū yīgè rénren de jiàzhíguān hé pànduànlì.
examples.english: Prolonged stress can distort a person's values and judgment.

examples.chinese: 那个顽皮的男孩总是惹麻烦，但他其实是个聪慧的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wánpí de nánháizi zǒngshi rě máfan, dàn tā qīshí shì ge聪慧 de háizi.
examples.english: That naughty boy is always getting into trouble, but he's actually quite a clever child.

examples.chinese: 尽管面临重重困难，这支队伍仍然展现出了顽强的意志，最终赢得了比赛的胜利。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn miànlín zhòngzhòng kùnnan, zhè zhī duìwu仍然 zhǎnxiàn chūle le顽强 de yìzhì, zuìzh终 赢de le bǐsài de shènglì.
examples.english: Despite facing numerous difficulties, the team still demonstrated tenacious willpower and ultimately won the victory in the competition.

examples.chinese: 这位王后因其智慧和慈悲心而被历史铭记，她用政治手腕维持了王国的稳定。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi wánghòu yīnqī zhìhuì hé císbēi xīn ér bèi lìshǐ mínggjì, tā yòng zhèngzhì shǒuwan wéichíle wángguó de wěndìng.
