examples.english: This queen was remembered by history for her wisdom and compassion; she used political skill to maintain the kingdom's stability.

examples.chinese: 这位王子虽然身份高贵，但他对政治事务的理解仍然显得相当幼稚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi wángzǐ suīrán shēnfèn gāoguì, dàn tā duì zhèngzhì shìwù de lǐjiě仍然 xiǎnde xiāngdāng yòuzhì.
examples.english: Although this prince had a noble status, his understanding of political affairs still seemed quite naive.

examples.chinese: 往后的日子里，我们要更加珍惜彼此的友谊，不要让误会再次伤害我们。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnghòu de rìzi lǐ, wǒmen yào gèngjiā zhēnxī彼此 de yǒuyì, búyào ràng wùhuì zàicì shānghài wǒmen.
examples.english: From now on in the days to come, we should cherish our friendship more and not let misunderstandings hurt us again.

examples.chinese: 随着智能手机的普及，越来越多的年轻人不再像从前那样频繁地去网吧了。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe zhìnéng shǒujī de pǔjí, yuèláiyuè duō de niánqīngrén búzài xiàng cóngqián nàyàng pí繁fán de qù wǎngbā le.
examples.english: With the popularization of smartphones, more and more young people no longer frequent internet cafés as often as they used to.

examples.chinese: 这个网页的加载速度太慢了，我怀疑是服务器出现了问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǎngyè de jiāzài sùdù tài màn le, wǒ huáiyí shì fúwùqì chūxiàn le wèntí.
examples.english: This web page loads too slowly; I suspect there's a problem with the server.

examples.chinese: 往年的经济危机给许多企业留下了深刻的教训，如今大家都更加谨慎地管理资金。
examples.pinyin: Wǎngnián de jīngjì wēijī gěi xǔduō qǐyè liúxià le shēnkè de jiàoxun, rújīn dàjiā dōu gèngjiā jǐnshèn de guǎnlǐ zījīn.
examples.english: The economic crises in former years left profound lessons for many enterprises, and nowadays everyone manages their funds more cautiously.

examples.chinese: 站在山顶上，我们终于望见了远处的城市灯光。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài shānding shang, wǒmen zhōngyú wàngjìanle yuǎnchù de chéngshì děngguāng.
examples.english: Standing on the mountaintop, we finally espied the city lights in the distance.

examples.chinese: 公司面临严重的财务危机，必须立即采取措施以避免破产。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī miànlín yánzhòng de cáiwù wēijī, bìxū lìjíe cǎiqǔ cuòshī yǐ bìmiǎn pòchǎn.
examples.english: The company is facing a serious financial crisis and must take immediate measures to avoid bankruptcy.

examples.chinese: 气候变化对人类的生存构成了严重的威胁，各国必须采取行动来应对这一挑战。
examples.pinyin: Qìhòu biànhuà duì rénlèi de shēngcún gòuchéngle yánzhòng de wēixié, gèguó bìxū cǎiqǔ xíngdòng lái yìngduì zhè yī tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: Climate change poses a serious threat to human survival, and all countries must take action to address this challenge.

examples.chinese: 多年来我们与这家公司保持着密切的商业往来。
examples.pinyin: Duō nián lái wǒmen yǔ zhè jiā gōngsī bǎochízhe mìqiè de shāngyè wǎnglái.
examples.english: Over the years, we have maintained close business contact with this company.

examples.chinese: 这款新型微波炉不仅加热速度快，而且能够智能调节火力，深受消费者欢迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xīnxíng wēibōlú bújǐn jiārè sùdù kuài, érqiě nénggoù zhìnéng tiáojié huǒlì, shēnshòu xiāofèizhě huānyíng.
examples.english: This new type of microwave oven not only heats quickly but can also intelligently adjust the power level, making it very popular with consumers.

examples.chinese: 长期缺乏维生素D会导致骨质疏松，特别是对于那些很少接受阳光照射的人群。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī quēfá wéishēngsù D huì dǎozhì gǔzhì shūsōng, tèbié shì duìyú nàxiē hěnshǎo jiēshòu yángguāng zhàoshè de rénqún.
examples.english: Long-term vitamin D deficiency can lead to osteoporosis, especially in people who rarely get sun exposure.

examples.chinese: 公司销售额连续下滑，为此管理层决定实施一系列改革措施。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiāoshòu'é liánxù xiàhuá, wèicǐ guǎnlǐcéng juédìng shíshī yī xìliè gǎigé cuòshī.
examples.english: The company's sales have been declining continuously, and for this reason, the management decided to implement a series of reform measures.

examples.chinese: 他们为何要隐瞒这个重要的信息，我至今仍然感到困惑。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen wèihé yào yǐncán zhège zhòngyào de xìnxī, wǒ zhìjīn réngránhuà gǎndào kùnhuò.
examples.english: I remain confused as to why they would conceal such important information.

examples.chinese: 长途火车上的卧铺虽然拥挤，但对于那些经常出差的人来说已经习以为常了。
examples.pinyin: Chángtú huǒchē shang de wòpù suīrán yōngjǐ, dàn duìyú nàxiē jīngcháng chūchāi de rén lái shuō yǐjīng xí yǐ wéi cháng le.
examples.english: Although the beds on long-distance trains are cramped, they have become routine for people who travel frequently for business.

examples.chinese: 随着生活水平的提高，人们越来越重视文娱生活的质量。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe shēnghuó shuǐpíng de tíigāo, rénmen yuèláiyuè zhòngshì wényú shēnghuó de zhìliàng.
examples.english: As living standards improve, people increasingly value the quality of their cultural and recreational life.

examples.chinese: 在无边的沙漠中迷失了方向，他开始后悔自己的冒险决定。
examples.pinyin: Zài wúbiān de shāmò zhōng mìshīle fāngxiàng, tā kāishǐ hòuhuǐ zìjǐ de màoxiǎn juédìng.
examples.english: Lost in the boundless desert, he began to regret his reckless decision to adventure.

examples.chinese: 天空中乌云密布，看起来暴风雨即将来临。
examples.pinyin: Tiānkōng zhōng wūyún mìbù, kàn qǐlái baofēngyǔ jíjiāng láimín.
examples.english: Dark clouds gathered densely in the sky, and it looked like a storm was about to arrive.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的成功与他的个人背景无关，关键是团队的执行力。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de chénggōng yǔ tā de gèrén bèijǐng wúguān, guānjiàn shì tuánduì de zhíxíng lì.
examples.english: The success of this project has nothing to do with his personal background; what matters is the team's execution ability.

examples.chinese: 这次出国旅行，我需要仔细检查行李箱里的物品，确保没有遗漏任何重要的东西。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chūguó lǚxíng, wǒ xūyào zǐxì jiǎnchá xínglixiāng lǐ de wùpǐn, quèbǎo méiyǒu yílòu rènhé zhòngyào de dōngxi.
examples.english: For this international trip, I need to carefully check the items in my suitcase to make sure I haven't missed anything important.

examples.chinese: 尽管他们进行了多次谈判，但所有的努力都被证明是无效的。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tāmen jìnxíngle duō cì tánpàn, dàn suǒyǒu de nǔlì dōu bèi zhèngmíng shì wúxiào de.
examples.english: Despite conducting multiple rounds of negotiations, all their efforts proved to be of no avail.

examples.chinese: 这次谈判的失败主要是由于双方对合同条款的理解有误。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì tánpàn de shībài zhǔyào shìyóuyú shuāngfāng duì hétonɡ tiáokuǎn de lǐjiě yǒu wù.
examples.english: The failure of this negotiation was mainly due to the two parties' misunderstanding of the contract terms.

examples.chinese: 她多年来一直致力于传统舞蹈的传承和创新，希望能让更多年轻人了解这门艺术。
examples.pinyin: Tā duō nián lái yīzhí zhìlì yú chuántǒng wǔdǎo de chuánchéng hé chuàngxīn, xīwàng néng ràng gèng duō niánqīng rén liǎojiě zhè mén yìshù.
examples.english: For many years, she has been dedicated to the inheritance and innovation of traditional dancing, hoping to help more young people appreciate this art form.

examples.chinese: 她在大学里主修西班牙语，希望将来能成为一名翻译。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài dàxué lǐ zhǔxiū xībānyáyǔ, xīwàng jiānglái néng chéngwéi yī míng fānyìyuán.
examples.english: She majored in Spanish at university, hoping to become a translator in the future.

examples.chinese: 越来越多的年轻人因为吸毒而毁掉了自己的前途，这是一个令人担忧的社会问题。
examples.pinyin: Yuèláiyuè duō de niánqīngrén yīnwèi xī dú érhuài le zìjǐ de qiántú, zhè shì yīgè lìngréndānhuō de shèhuì wèntí.
examples.english: More and more young people are ruining their futures because of taking drugs, which is a worrying social problem.

examples.chinese: 许多革命烈士为了国家的独立和自由而牺牲了自己的生命。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō gémìng lièshì wèile guójiā de dúlì hé zìyóu érqǐ xīshēngle zìjǐ de shēngmìng.
examples.english: Many revolutionary martyrs sacrificed their own lives for the independence and freedom of the nation.

examples.chinese: 科学家们通过显微镜观察癌细胞的分裂过程，希望找到更有效的治疗方法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā men tōngguò xiǎnwēijìng guānchá ái xìbāo de fēnliè guòchéng, xīwàng zhǎodào gèng yǒuxiàoxiào de zhìliáo fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists observed the division process of cancer cells under a microscope, hoping to find more effective treatment methods.

examples.chinese: 中国的戏曲艺术源远流长，京剧、昆曲等传统剧种至今仍然吸引着大量观众。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó de xìqǔ yìshù yuányuǎn liúcháng, jīngjù, kūnqǔ děng chuántǒng jùzhǒng zhìjīn仍然 xīyǐnzhāo zhe dàliàng guānzhòng.
examples.english: Chinese traditional opera has a long and rich history, and classical opera forms such as Peking Opera and Kunqu Opera continue to attract large audiences today.

examples.chinese: 科学家们发现了一种能够分解塑料的细菌，这可能会为解决环境污染问题带来新的希望。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā men fāxiànle yī zhǒng nénggoù fēnjiě sùliào de xìjūn, zhè kěnéng huì wèi jiějué huánjìng wūrǎn wèntí dàilái xīn de xīwàng.
examples.english: Scientists discovered a type of bacteria capable of decomposing plastic, which may bring new hope to solving environmental pollution problems.

examples.chinese: 这家科技公司一直走在行业的先锋，推动了整个领域的创新发展。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kējì gōngsī yīzhí zǒu zài hángyè de xiānfēng, tuīdòng le zhěnggè lǐngyù de chuàngxīn fāzhǎn.
examples.english: This tech company has always been at the vanguard of the industry, driving innovation and development across the entire field.

examples.chinese: 他嫌公司的工作太枯燥，决定辞职去追求自己真正喜欢的事业。
examples.pinyin: Tā xián gōngsī de gōngzuò tài枯燥，juéding辞职 qù zhuīqiú zìjǐ zhēnzhèng xǐhuān de shìyè。
examples.english: He dislikes the monotonous work at the company, so he decided to resign and pursue a career he truly enjoys.

examples.chinese: 在这次危机中，他显出了真正的领导力和担当精神。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè cì wēijī zhōng, tā xiǎnchūle zhēnzhèng de lǐngdǎolì hé dāndāng jīngshén.
examples.english: In this crisis, he demonstrated true leadership and a sense of responsibility.

examples.chinese: 这次投资风险很大，但如果成功的话利润也会很可观。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì tóuziī fēngxiǎn hěn dà, dàn rúguǒ chénggōng de huà lìrùn yě huì hěn kěguān.
examples.english: This investment is very risky, but if it succeeds, the profit will also be quite substantial.

examples.chinese: 由于缺乏充分的市场调研，这家公司陷入了严重的财务危机。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú quēfá chōngfèn de shìchǎng diàoyán, zhè jiā gōngsī xiànrù le yánzhòng de cáiwù wēijī.
examples.english: Due to insufficient market research, the company plunged into a serious financial crisis.

examples.chinese: 深夜里传来的敲门响声把我从睡梦中惊醒了。
examples.pinyin: Shēnyè lǐ chuánlái de qiāomén xiǎngshēng bǎ wǒ cóng shuìmèng zhōng jīngxǐng le.
examples.english: The knocking sound that came in the middle of the night startled me awake from my sleep.

examples.chinese: 这座老楼的电气线路已经严重老化，必须进行全面的改造和升级。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò lǎo lóu de diànqì xiànlù yǐjīng yánzhòng lǎohuà, bìxū jìnxíng quánmiàn de gǎizào hé shēngjí.
examples.english: The electrical wiring in this old building has become severely outdated and must be completely renovated and upgraded.

examples.chinese: 我想不到他竟然会为了这点小事就辞职了，真是让人失望。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngbudào tā jìngrán huì wèile zhè diǎn xiǎoshì jiù cízhí le, zhēnshi ràng rén shīwàng.
examples.english: I couldn't anticipate that he would actually resign over such a trivial matter; it's really disappointing.

examples.chinese: 长期的工作压力会大量消耗我们的精力和时间。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī de gōngzuò yālì huì dàliàng xiāohào wǒmen de jīnglì hé shíjiān.
examples.english: Long-term work stress will consume a lot of our energy and time.

examples.chinese: 科学家们正在努力消灭这种传染病，以便保护全球人类的健康。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiāmen zhèngzài nǔlì xiāomiè zhè zhǒng chuánrǎnbìng, yǐbiàn bǎohù quánqiú rénlèi de jiànkāng.
examples.english: Scientists are making efforts to eradicate this infectious disease in order to protect the health of humanity worldwide.

examples.chinese: 在美国餐厅吃饭，如果服务员的服务态度好，通常要给百分之十五到二十的小费。
examples.pinyin: Zài Měiguó cāntīng chīfàn, rúguǒ fúwùyuán de fúwù tàidù hǎo, tōngcháng yào gěi bǎifēnzhī shíwǔ dào èrshí de xiǎofèi.
examples.english: When eating at a restaurant in the United States, if the waiter's service attitude is good, you usually need to give a tip of fifteen to twenty percent.

examples.chinese: 由于气候变化，今年小麦的产量下降了百分之二十。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú qìhòu biànhuà, jīnnián xiǎomài de chǎnyliàng xiàjiàng le bǎifēnzhī èrshí.
examples.english: Due to climate change, this year's wheat yield has decreased by twenty percent.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的成本小于我们最初的预算，这让所有投资者都感到惊喜。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de chéngběn xiǎoyú wǒmen zuìchū de yùsuàn, zhè ràng suǒyǒu tóuzizhě dōu gǎndào jīngxǐ.
examples.english: The cost of this project is less than our initial budget, which pleasantly surprised all the investors.

examples.chinese: 尽管经历了许多挫折，她依然保持着灿烂的笑脸面对每一个新的挑战。
examples.pinyin: Jìnguǎn jīng历le xǔduō cuòzhé, tā yīránbǎochízhe càànlan de xiàoliǎn miànduì měi yī ge xīn de tiǎozhàn.
examples.english: Despite experiencing many setbacks, she still maintains a brilliant smiling face to face every new challenge.

examples.chinese: 我得好好晓得他的真实想法，才能决定是否继续这个合作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děi hǎohāo xiǎode tā de zhēnshí xiǎngfǎ, cáinéng juédìng shìfǒu jìxù zhège hézuò.
examples.english: I need to really understand his true thoughts before I can decide whether to continue this cooperation.

examples.chinese: 她脸上的笑容消散了，眼神也变得空洞起来。
examples.pinyin: Tā liǎnshang de xiàoróng xiāosàn le, yǎnshén yě biànde kōngdòng qǐlai.
examples.english: The smile on her face faded away, and her eyes became vacant.

examples.chinese: 听着孩子们欢快的笑声，她终于放下了心中的忧虑。
examples.pinyin: Tīngzhe háizimen huānkuài de xiàoshēng, tā zhōngyú fàngxiàle xīnzhōng de yōulǜ.
examples.english: Listening to the children's cheerful laughter, she finally let go of the worries in her heart.

examples.chinese: 这位艺术家被推选为美术协会的主席，获得了业界的广泛认可。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yìshùjiā bèi tuīxuǎn wéi měishù xiéhuì de zhǔxí, huòdéle yèjiè de guǎngfàn rènkě.
examples.english: The artist was elected as the chairman of the art association and received widespread recognition from the industry.

examples.chinese: 双方领导人就贸易争端问题进行了深入协商，希望能够找到互利共赢的解决方案。
examples.pinyin: Shuāngfāng lǐngdǎo rén jiù màoyì zhēngduàn wèntí jìnxíng le shēnrù xiéshāng, xīwàng nénggòu zhǎodào hùlì gòngyíng de jiějué fāng'àn.
examples.english: The leaders of both sides held in-depth consultations on the trade dispute issue, hoping to find mutually beneficial solutions.

examples.chinese: 各个部门需要更好地协调合作，才能提高工作效率。
examples.pinyin: Gège bùmén xūyào gèng hǎo de xiétiáo hézuò, cáinéng tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
examples.english: Each department needs to coordinate and cooperate better in order to improve work efficiency.

examples.chinese: 这栋写字楼坐落在市中心，吸引了许多跨国公司入驻。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng xiězìlóu zuòluò zài shì zhōngxīn, xīyǐnle xǔduō kuàguó gōngsī rùzhù.
examples.english: This office building is located in the city center and has attracted many multinational companies to set up operations here.

examples.chinese: 为了完成这个复杂的项目，我们需要协助彼此，分享各自的专业知识。
examples.pinyin: Wèile wánchéng zhège fùzá de xiàngmù, wǒmen xūyào xiézhù bǐcǐ, fēnxiǎng gèzì de zhuānyè zhīshi.
examples.english: In order to complete this complex project, we need to assist each other and share our respective professional knowledge.

examples.chinese: 他在写字台上铺开了一张古老的地图，仔细研究那些标注的路线。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xiězìtái shàng pūkāi le yī zhāng gǔlǎo de dìtú, zǐxì yánjiū nàxiē biāozhù de lùxiàn.
examples.english: He spread out an old map on the writing desk and carefully studied the marked routes.

examples.chinese: 她一直以来的心愿就是能够成为一名优秀的医生，为患者解除痛苦。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīzhí yǐlái de xīnyuàn jiùshì néng gòu chéngwéi yī míng yōuxiù de yīshēng, wèi huànzhě jiěchú téngtòng.
examples.english: Her lifelong wish has always been to become an excellent doctor and relieve patients' suffering.

examples.chinese: 长期的压力和焦虑会对心脏造成严重的损害，所以保持心理健康同样重要。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī de yālì hé jiāolǜ huì duì xīnzàng zàochéng yánzhòu de sǔnhài, suǒyǐ bǎochí xīnlǐ jiànkāng tóngyàng zhòngyào.
examples.english: Prolonged stress and anxiety can cause serious damage to the heart, so maintaining mental health is equally important.

examples.chinese: 这部电影深深触动了我的心灵，让我重新思考人生的意义。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shēnshēn chùdòngle wǒ de xīnlíng, ràng wǒ chóngxīn sīkǎo rénshēng de yìyì.
examples.english: This film deeply touched my soul, making me reconsider the meaning of life.

examples.chinese: 他的父亲因为长期吸烟而患上了心脏病，这让全家人都感到很担忧。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fùqīn yīnwèi chángqī xīyān ér huànshàngle xīnzàngbìng, zhè ràng quánjiātǐ rén dōu gǎndào hěn dānnyōu.
examples.english: His father contracted heart disease due to long-term smoking, which made the whole family feel very worried.

examples.chinese: 婚礼上新人互相交换了誓言，现场所有的宾客都被他们深情的表白所感动。
examples.pinyin: Hūnlǐ shang xīnrén hùxiāng jiāohuàn le shìyán, xiànchǎng suǒyǒu de bīnkè dōu bèi tāmen shēnqíng de biǎobái suǒ gǎndòng.
examples.english: At the wedding ceremony, the newlyweds exchanged vows with each other, and all the guests at the scene were moved by their heartfelt declarations.

examples.chinese: 随着互联网的发展，许多新兴产业正在改变我们的生活方式。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe húliánwǎng de fāzhǎn, xǔduō xīnxīng chǎnyè zhèngzài gǎibiàn wǒmen de shēnghuó fāngshì.
examples.english: With the development of the internet, many burgeoning industries are changing our way of life.

examples.chinese: 虽然这份工作很有挑战性，但薪水相对较低，我正在考虑是否要跳槽。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán zhè fèn gōngzuò hěn yǒu tiǎozhàn xìng, dàn xīnshui xiāngduì jiào dī, wǒ zhèngzài kǎolǜ shìfǒu yào tiàocáo.
examples.english: Although this job is quite challenging, the salary is relatively low, and I'm considering whether to switch jobs.

examples.chinese: 在这个多元化的社会里,每个人都有权利坚守自己的信仰,无论它是宗教信仰还是人生哲学。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège duōyuánnhuà de shèhuì lǐ, měi ge rén dōu yǒu quánlì jiānshǒu zìjǐ de xìnyǎng, wúlùn tā shì zōngjiào xìnyǎng háishi rénshēng zhéxué.
examples.english: In this pluralistic society, everyone has the right to uphold their own beliefs, whether they are religious beliefs or life philosophies.

examples.chinese: 他多年来凭借诚实和信用赢得了客户的信任，生意越做越大。
examples.pinyin: Tā duō nián lái píngjiè chéngshí hé xìnyòng yíngdéle kèhù de xìnrèn, shēngyì yuè zuò yuè dà.
examples.english: Over the years, he has earned his clients' trust through honesty and integrity, and his business has grown increasingly larger.

examples.chinese: 由于天气恶劣，我们不得不改变了原定的行程。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú tiānqì èliè, wǒmen búdébuzhī gǎibiàn le yuándìng de xíngchéng.
examples.english: Due to severe weather, we had no choice but to change our original itinerary.

examples.chinese: 这家公司经过几年的发展，业务已经越来越兴旺，成为了行业中的佼佼者。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī jīngguò jǐ nián de fāzhǎn, yèwù yǐjīng yuèláiyuè xīngwàng, chéngwéi le hángyè zhōng de jiǎojiǎozhě.
examples.english: After several years of development, this company's business has become increasingly prosperous, making it one of the industry leaders.

examples.chinese: 这种新的商业模式逐渐形成了一个独特的市场竞争优势。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xīn de shāngyè móshì zhújiàn xíngchéngle yī ge dúté de shìchǎng jìngjìng yōushì.
examples.english: This new business model gradually formed a unique competitive advantage in the market.

examples.chinese: 警察经过三个月的调查，终于抓住了这起连环谋杀案的凶手。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá jīngguò sān ge yuè de diàochá, zh终于 zhuāzhù le zhè qǐ liánhuán móushā àn de xiōngshǒu.
examples.english: After three months of investigation, the police finally caught the murderer behind this serial murder case.

examples.chinese: 这款袖珍相机虽然体积小，但拍出来的照片质量却不逊于专业设备。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn xiùzhēn xiāngjī suīrán tǐjī xiǎo, dàn pāichūlái de zhàopiàn zhìliàng què búxùnyú zhuānyè shèbèi.
examples.english: Although this pocket-sized camera is small in size, the quality of photos it produces is no less than professional equipment.

examples.chinese: 这家修车店的技术员经验丰富，无论多复杂的问题都能迅速解决。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā xiūchē diàn de jìshùyuán jīngyàn fēngfù, wúlùn duō fùzá de wèntí dōu néng xùnsù jiějué.
examples.english: The technicians at this repair shop are experienced and can quickly solve any complicated problem, no matter how complex.

examples.chinese: 那只狗看起来很凶，但实际上它很温顺，不会伤害任何人。
examples.pinyin: Nà zhī gǒu kàn qǐlai hěn xiōng, dàn shíj际shang tā hěn wēnshùn, búhuì shānghài rènhé rén.
examples.english: That dog looks vicious, but in reality it's very gentle and won't harm anyone.

examples.chinese: 这个问题一直悬而未决，影响了整个项目的进展。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí yīzhí xuán ér wèi jué, yǐngxiǎngle zhěngge xiàngmù de jìnzhǎn.
examples.english: This problem has remained unresolved all along, which has affected the progress of the entire project.

examples.chinese: 地球每天绕太阳旋转一周，这个过程决定了我们的日夜交替。
examples.pinyin: Dìqiú měi tiān ràotài yáng xuánzhuǎn yī zhōu, zhège guòchéng juédìngle wǒmen de rìyè jiāotì.
examples.english: The Earth revolves around the Sun every day, and this process determines our alternation of day and night.

examples.chinese: 这家公司通过严格的面试流程来选拔最优秀的人才。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī tōngguò yánggé de miànshì liúchéng lái xuǎnbá zuì yōuxiù de réncái.
examples.english: This company selects the most outstanding talents through a rigorous interview process.

examples.chinese: 他作为中国美术学会的会员，经常参加学术研讨会来交流创作经验。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòwéi zhōngguó měishù xuéhuì de huìyuán, jīngcháng参加 xuéshù yántǎohuì lái jiāoliú chuàngzuò jīngyàn.
examples.english: As a member of the Chinese Art Association, he frequently attends academic seminars to exchange creative experience.

examples.chinese: 这次总统选举吸引了全国各地的选民积极参与。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zǒngtǒng xuǎnjǔ xīyǐnle quánguó gèdì de xuǎnmín jījí cānyù.
examples.english: This presidential election attracted voters from all over the country to participate actively.

examples.chinese: 这个培训项目的学员来自世界各地，他们在这里学到了许多实用的技能。
examples.pinyin: Zhège péixùn xiàngmù de xuéyuán lái zì shìjiè gèdì, tāmen zài zhèlǐ xuédàole xǔduō shíyòng de jìnéng.
examples.english: The trainees in this training program come from all over the world, and they have learned many practical skills here.

examples.chinese: 医生通过血液检查发现了这种罕见的遗传疾病。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng tōngguò xuèyè jiǎnchá fāxiànle zhè zhǒng hánjiàn de yíchuán jíbìng.
examples.english: The doctor discovered this rare genetic disease through a blood test.

examples.chinese: 长期高血压会导致血管硬化，增加心脏病的风险。
examples.pinyin: Chángqī gāo xuèyā huì dǎozhì xuèguǎn yìnghuà, zēngjiā xīnzàngbìng de fēngxiǎn.
examples.english: Prolonged high blood pressure can cause blood vessel hardening, increasing the risk of heart disease.

examples.chinese: 这个独裁政权长期压迫少数民族，引发了国际社会的广泛谴责。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dúcái zhèngquán chángqī yāpò shǎoshù mínzú, yǐnfā le guójì shèhuì de guǎngfàn qiǎnzé.
examples.english: The authoritarian regime has long oppressed ethnic minorities, which has provoked widespread condemnation from the international community.

examples.chinese: 这个经济循环系统的问题在于资源分配不均，导致贫富差距越来越大。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jīngjì xúnhuán xìtǒng de wèntí zàiyú zīyuán fēnpèi búyún, dǎozhì píngfù chājù yuèláiyuè dà.
examples.english: The problem with this economic circulation system is uneven resource distribution, which has led to an increasingly large wealth gap.

examples.chinese: 每年春节，人们都会在夜空中放烟花来庆祝新年的到来。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián chūnjié, rénmen dōu huì zài yè kōng zhōng fàng yānhuā lái qìngzhù xīn nián de dàolái.
examples.english: Every Spring Festival, people set off fireworks in the night sky to celebrate the arrival of the new year.

examples.chinese: 随着经济的发展，沿海城市逐渐成为了国家的经济中心。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe jīngjì de fāzhǎn, yánhǎi chéngshì zhújiàn chéngwéile guójiā de jīngjì zhōngxīn.
examples.english: With economic development, coastal cities have gradually become the economic centers of the country.

examples.chinese: 沿着这条古老的丝绸之路，我们可以看到历代商人留下的足迹。
examples.pinyin: Yánzhe zhè tiáo gǔlǎo de sīchóu zhī lù, wǒmen kěyǐ kàndào lìdài shāngrén liúxià de zújī.
examples.english: Along this ancient Silk Road, we can see the footprints left by merchants throughout the ages.

examples.chinese: 沿着这条古老的丝绸之路，我们可以看到许多历史遗迹和文化遗产。
examples.pinyin: Yánzhe zhè tiáo gǔlǎo de sīchóu zhī lù, wǒmen kěyǐ kàndào xǔduō lìshǐ yíjī hé wénhuà遗产。
examples.english: Along this ancient Silk Road, we can see many historical ruins and cultural heritage.

examples.chinese: 这家科技公司投入了大量资金用于新产品的研发，希望能在市场上占据领先地位。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kējì gōngsī tóuruòle dàliàng zījīn yòngyú xīn chǎnpǐn de yánfā, xīwàng néng zài shìchǎng shang zhànjù lǐngxiān dìwèi.
examples.english: This tech company has invested a large amount of capital in the research and development of new products, hoping to occupy a leading position in the market.

examples.chinese: 眼看着公司的业绩每况愈下，老板却始终没有采取任何措施。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnkànzhe gōngsī de yèjī měi kuàng yù xià, lǎobǎn却 shǐzhōng méiyǒu cǎiqǔ rènhé cuòshī.
examples.english: Watching helplessly as the company's performance deteriorated, the boss still took no measures to address it.

examples.chinese: 这位钢琴家在国际音乐节上演奏了肖邦的夜曲，赢得了观众的热烈掌声。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi gāngqin jiā zài guójì yīnyuè jié shang yǎnzòule Xiāobāng de yèqū, yíngdéle guānzhòng de règuò zhǎngsheng.
examples.english: The pianist performed Chopin's Nocturne at the international music festival and won warm applause from the audience.

examples.chinese: 这次国宴会在人民大会堂举行，邀请了许多国际政要出席。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì guó yànhuì zài Rénmín Dàhuìtáng jǔxíng, yāoqǐngle xǔduō guójì zhènggyào chūxí.
examples.english: This state banquet was held at the Great Hall of the People, inviting many international political figures to attend.

examples.chinese: 仰教授在学术界享有很高的声誉，他的研究成果对整个领域产生了深远的影响。
examples.pinyin: Yǎng jiàoshòu zài xuéshùji界 xiǎngyǒu hěn gāo de shēngyù, tāde yánjiū chéngguǒ duì zhěngge lǐngyù chǎnshēngle shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Professor Yang enjoys a high reputation in academic circles, and his research achievements have had a profound impact on the entire field.

examples.chinese: 这位设计师融合了东西方的审美，创造出了一种既传统又洋气的风格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi shèjìshī rónghéle dōngxīfāng de shěnměi, chuàngzào chūle yī zhǒng j既 chuántǒng yòu yángqi de fēnggé.
examples.english: This designer blended Eastern and Western aesthetics, creating a style that is both traditional and modern/sophisticated.

english: to provide for the elderly (family members)

examples.chinese: 随着人口老龄化问题日益严重，许多年轻人开始思考如何更好地养老自己的父母。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe rénkǒu lǎolínghuà wèntí rìyì yánzhòng, xǔduō niánqīng rén kāishǐ sīkǎo rúhé gèng hǎo de yǎnglǎo zìjǐ de fùmǔ.
examples.english: As the aging population problem becomes increasingly serious, many young people have started to think about how to better provide for their elderly parents.

examples.chinese: 这样的工作环境让员工们感到既有挑战性又有成就感。
examples.pinyin: zhèyàng de gōngzuò huánjìng ràng yuángōngmen gǎndào既 yǒu tiǎozhànxìng yòu yǒu chéngjiùugǎn.
examples.english: This kind of work environment makes employees feel both challenged and accomplished.

examples.chinese: 深海生物能够在极低的氧气浓度下存活，这一发现让科学家们重新思考生命的适应能力。
examples.pinyin: Shēnhǎi shēngwù néng gòu zài jí dī de yǎngqì nóngdù xià cunhuó, zhè yī fāxiàn ràng kēxuéjiā men chóngxīn sīkǎo shēngmìng de shìyìng néng力.
examples.english: Deep-sea organisms can survive at extremely low oxygen concentrations, a discovery that has prompted scientists to reconsider the adaptability of life.

examples.chinese: 医院最近加强了对过期药品的管理，以防止患者误用。
examples.pinyin: Yīyuàn zuìjìn jiāqiáng le duì guòqī yàopǐn de guǎnlǐ, yǐ fángzhǐ huànzhě wùyòng.
examples.english: The hospital has recently strengthened its management of expired pharmaceuticals to prevent patients from using them by mistake.

examples.chinese: 你现在必须认真学习，要不然等到考试的时候就会后悔。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiànzài bìxū rènzhēn xuéxí, yàoburán děngdào kǎoshì de shíhou jiù huì hòuhuǐ.
examples.english: You must study seriously now; otherwise, you'll regret it when the exam comes around.

examples.chinese: 虽然他们来自不同的背景，但这些年来一直要好得很，像亲兄弟一样。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tāmen láizì búdòng de bèijǐng, dàn zhèxiē niánlái yìzhí yàohǎo de hěn, xiàng qīn xiōngdi yíyàng.
examples.english: Although they come from different backgrounds, they have been on very good terms over the years, like real brothers.

examples.chinese: 你要么现在就决定去留学，要么就放弃这个念头，别再纠结了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yàome xiànzài jiù juédìng qù liúxué, yàome jiù fàngqì zhège niàntou, bié zài jiūjié le.
examples.english: You either decide right now to study abroad or give up on the idea; stop being indecisive about it.

examples.chinese: 成功的要素不仅包括努力和天赋，更重要的是持之以恒的决心。
examples.pinyin: Chénggōng de yàosù bújǐn bāokuò nǔlì hé tiānfù, gèng zhòngyào de shì chízhī yǐ héng de juéxīn.
examples.english: The elements of success not only include hard work and talent, but more importantly, the determination to persevere.

examples.chinese: 这片野生林区因为缺乏有效的保护措施，生物多样性正在急剧下降。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn yěshēng línqū yīnwèi quēfá yǒuxiàoDE bǎohù cuòshī, shēngwù duōyànghuà xìng zhèngzài jíjù xiàjiàng.
examples.english: This wild forest area is experiencing a sharp decline in biodiversity due to the lack of effective protection measures.

examples.chinese: 这片野生林区因为长期缺乏管理，已经成为了许多濒危物种的最后避难所。
examples.pinyin: Zhè piàn yěshēng línqū yīnwèi chángqī quēfá guǎnlǐ, yǐjīng chéngwéi le許duō bīnwēi wùzhǒng de zuìhòu bìnàn suǒ.
examples.english: This wild forest area, due to long-term lack of management, has become the last refuge for many endangered species.

examples.chinese: 随着科技的发展，医药行业在治疗癌症方面取得了重大突破。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe kējì de fāzhǎn, yīyào hángyè zài zhìliáo áizhèng fāngmiàn qǔdéle zhòngdà突破。
examples.english: With the advancement of technology, the pharmaceutical industry has made significant breakthroughs in cancer treatment.

examples.chinese: 会议上，与会者依次发表了各自的观点和建议。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì shang, yǔhuì zhě yīcì fābiǎole gèzì de guāndiǎn hé jiànyì.
examples.english: At the conference, the participants presented their respective viewpoints and suggestions in order.

examples.chinese: 现代社会对互联网的依赖程度越来越高，这也带来了许多新的安全隐患。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài shèhuì duì hùliánwǎng de yīlài chéngdù yuèláiyuè gāo, zhè yě dàiláile xǔduō xīn de ānquán yǐnhuàn.
examples.english: Modern society's reliance on the internet is increasing, which also brings many new security risks.

examples.chinese: 公司决定提供一次性的补偿方案，以解决这个长期存在的劳资纠纷。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juéding tígōng yīcìxìng de bǔcháng fāng'àn, yǐ jiějué zhège chángqī cunzài de láozī jiūn纷.
examples.english: The company decided to offer a one-off compensation package to resolve this long-standing labor dispute.

examples.chinese: 我们一道去看那个新展览，听说评价很高。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīdào qù kàn nàge xīn zhǎnlǎn, tīngshuō pínghuà hěn gāo.
examples.english: Let's go together to see that new exhibition; I heard it has very high reviews.

examples.chinese: 这一代年轻人面临着前所未有的机遇和挑战，他们的选择将会影响整个社会的未来。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yīdài niánqīng rén miànlín zhe qiánsuǒwèiyǒu de jīyù hé tiǎozhàn, tāmen de xuǎnzé jiānghuì yǐngxiǎng zhěnggè shèhuì de wèilái.
examples.english: This generation of young people faces unprecedented opportunities and challenges, and their choices will impact the future of society as a whole.

examples.chinese: 他一贯的作风就是认真负责，从不迟到早退。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīguàn de zuòfēng jiùshì rènzhēn fùzé, cóngbù chídào zǎotuì.
examples.english: His consistent style has always been to be conscientious and responsible, never arriving late or leaving early.

examples.chinese: 一路上我们经历了许多困难，但正是这些挑战让我们的友谊变得更加坚固。
examples.pinyin: Yīlùshang wǒmen jīnglìle xǔduō kùnnan, dàn zhèngshì zhèxiē tiǎozhàn ràng wǒmen de yǒuyì biàn de gèngjiā jiānggù.
examples.english: Throughout the journey, we experienced many difficulties, but it was precisely these challenges that made our friendship even stronger.

examples.chinese: 这个实验室的仪器设备都是最新进口的，为我们的研究提供了很大的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shíyàn shì de yíqì shèbèi dōu shì zuì xīn jìnkǒu de, wèi wǒmen de yánjiū tígōngle hěn dà de bāngzhù.
examples.english: All the instrumentation and equipment in this laboratory are the latest imports, which have provided great assistance to our research.

examples.chinese: 这场婚礼仪式融合了传统文化和现代元素,给所有宾客留下了深刻的印象。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng hunyǐ yíshì rónghé le chuántǒng wénhuà hé xiàndài yuánsù, gěi suǒyǒu bīnkè liúxià le shēnkè de yìnxiàng.
examples.english: This wedding ceremony blended traditional culture with modern elements, leaving a deep impression on all the guests.

examples.chinese: 经过一番激烈的讨论，委员会最终达成了共识。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò yì fān jīliè de tǎolùn, wěiyuánhuì zuìzh终 dádéchéngle gòngshí.
examples.english: After some heated discussion, the committee finally reached a consensus.

examples.chinese: 我最遗憾的是没有好好珍惜那段青春岁月。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì yíhàn de shì méiyǒu hǎohāo zhēnxī nà duàn qīngchūn suìyuè.
examples.english: What I regret most is not cherishing that period of youth properly.

examples.chinese: 这两个孪生姐妹长得一模一样，连她们的父母有时候都分不清。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge luánshuāng jiěmei zhǎng de yīmú-yīyàng, lián tāmen de fùmǔ yǒushíhou dōu fēn bu qīng.
examples.english: These two twin sisters look exactly the same; even their parents sometimes can't tell them apart.

examples.chinese: 这部电影一时成为了全国热议的话题，但很快就被遗忘了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng yīshí chéngwéile quánguó règìyì de huàtí, dàn hěnkuài jiù bèi yíwàng le.
examples.english: This movie became a hot topic of discussion across the country for a while, but was quickly forgotten.

examples.chinese: 这次项目失败后，几位主要负责人一同承担了责任。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì xiàngmù shībài hòu, jǐ wèi zhǔyào fùzérén yītóng chéngdānle zérèn.
examples.english: After this project failed, several key persons in charge took responsibility together.

examples.chinese: 当老师宣布比赛开始时，所有的运动员一齐冲出了起跑线。
examples.pinyin: Dāng lǎoshī xuānbù bǐsài kāishǐ shí, suǒyǒu de yùndòngyuán yīqí chōngchūle le qǐpǎoxiàn.
examples.english: When the teacher announced the start of the competition, all the athletes rushed out from the starting line simultaneously.

examples.chinese: 我们一行人去年夏天曾经在云南旅游，那次经历给我留下了深刻的印象。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīxíng rén qùnián xiàtiān céngjīng zài Yúnnán lǚyóu, nà cì jīnglì gěi wǒ liúxiàle shēnkè de yìnxiàng.
examples.english: Our party of people traveled in Yunnan last summer, and that experience left a deep impression on me.

examples.chinese: 这位艺人凭借其卓越的表演才能赢得了国际电影节的最高奖项。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yìrén píngjiè qī zhuóyuè de biǎoyǎn cáinéng yíngdéle guójì diànyǐngjié de zuìgāo jiǎngxiàng.
examples.english: This creative artist won the highest award at the international film festival thanks to his outstanding performance talent.

examples.chinese: 这次会议的主要议题是如何应对日益激烈的市场竞争。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔyào yìtí shì rúhé yìngduì rìyì jīliè de shìchǎng jìngjìng.
examples.english: The main agenda item of this meeting is how to address the increasingly fierce market competition.

examples.chinese: 这个季节的天气异常炎热，已经打破了历史最高温度的纪录。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìjié de tiānqì yìcháng yánrè, yǐjīng dǎpòle lìshǐ zuìgāo wēndù de jìlù.
examples.english: The weather this season is unusually hot, having already broken the historical high temperature record.

examples.chinese: 这次项目的成功完全意想不到，原本我们以为肯定会失败。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì xiàngmù de chénggōng wánquán yìxiǎngbùdào, yuánběn wǒmen yǐwéi kěndìng huì shībài.
examples.english: The success of this project was completely unexpected; we originally thought it would definitely fail.

examples.chinese: 虽然公司提出了很有吸引力的条件，但他仍然缺乏加入的意愿。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán gōngsī tíchūle hěn yǒu xīyǐnlì de tiáojiàn, dàn tā réngránquē fá jiārù de yìyuàn.
examples.english: Although the company presented very attractive conditions, he still lacked the willingness to join.

examples.chinese: 经济因素虽然重要，但不是决定企业成功的唯一条件。
examples.pinyin: Jīngjì yīnsù suīrán zhòngyào, dàn búshì juéding qǐyè chénggōng de wéiyī tiáojiàn.
examples.english: Although economic factors are important, they are not the only condition that determines a company's success.

examples.chinese: 因为公司的战略调整，许多员工不得不面对裁员的风险。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngsī de zhàn略tiáozhěng, xǔduō yuángōng búdébù miànduì cáiyuán de fēngxiǎn.
examples.english: Because of the company's strategic restructuring, many employees had to face the risk of layoffs.

examples.chinese: 这部电影揭露了一个跨越几十年的政治阴谋，情节复杂得令人难以置信。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiēlù le yīgè kuàyuè jǐ shí nián de zhèngzhì yīnmóu, qíng节 fùzá de lìngrén nányǐ zhìxìn.
examples.english: This movie exposed a political plot spanning several decades, with a plot so complex that it's hard to believe.

examples.chinese: 在这个嘈杂的环境中，我不得不提高音量才能让别人听清我的话。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège cháozáo de huánjìng zhōng, wǒ búdéyǐ tíngāo yīnliàng cái néng ràng biérén tīngqīng wǒ de huà.
examples.english: In this noisy environment, I had to increase the volume in order for others to hear what I was saying clearly.

examples.chinese: 那段痛苦的经历在他心中留下了深深的阴影，多年后仍然影响着他的决定。
examples.pinyin: Nà duàn ténɡkǔ de jīnɡlì zài tā xīnzhōnɡ liúxiàle shēnshēn de yīnyǐnɡ, duō nián hòu réɡrán yǐnɡxiǎnɡzhe tā de juédinɡ.
examples.english: That painful experience left a deep shadow in his heart, still affecting his decisions years later.

examples.chinese: 这家音像店的黑胶唱片收藏在整个城市都很有名。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīnxiàng diàn de hēi jiāo chànɡpiàn shōucánɡ zài zhěnɡɡe chénɡshì dōu hěn yǒu míɡ.
examples.english: This audio and video store's vinyl record collection is famous throughout the entire city.

examples.chinese: 在数字时代，保护个人隐私变得越来越重要，许多人都担心自己的信息被泄露。
examples.pinyin: Zài shùzì shídài, bǎohù gèrén yǐnsī biàn de yuè lái yuè zhòngyào, xǔduō rén dōu dānxīn zìjǐ de xìnxī bèi xuēlòu.
examples.english: In the digital age, protecting personal privacy has become increasingly important, and many people worry about their information being leaked.

examples.chinese: 这个古老的秘密被隐藏在深山里已经有几百年了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège gǔlǎo de mìmì bèi yǐncáng zài shēnshān lǐ yǐjīng yǒu jǐ bǎi nián le.
examples.english: This ancient secret has been hidden deep in the mountains for hundreds of years.

examples.chinese: 这份合同需要董事长的印章才能生效。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétongg xūyào dǒngshìzhǎng de yìnzhāng cái néng shēngxiào.
examples.english: This contract needs the chairman's official seal/stamp to become effective.

examples.chinese: 随着改革开放政策的实施，中国迎来了经济发展的黄金时代。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe gǎigé kāifàng zhèngcè de shíshī, Zhōngguó yínglái le jīngjì fāzhǎn de huángjīn shídài.
examples.english: With the implementation of the reform and opening-up policy, China ushered in a golden age of economic development.

examples.chinese: 在那个动荡的年代，无数英雄为了国家的独立而献出了生命。
examples.pinyin: Zài nàge dòngtàng de niándài, wúshù yīngxióng wèile guójiā de dúlì érhuà xiànchūle shēngmìng.
examples.english: In that turbulent era, countless heroes sacrificed their lives for the independence of the nation.

examples.chinese: 作为一个资深影迷，他对电影的理解远超普通观众。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi yīgè zīshēn yǐngmí, tā duì diànyǐng de lǐjiě yuǎn chāo pǔtōng guānzhòng.
examples.english: As a devoted film enthusiast, his understanding of cinema far exceeds that of ordinary viewers.

examples.chinese: 那位影星因为绯闻缠身，不得不暂时淡出娱乐圈。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi yǐngxīng yīnwèi fēiwén chánshēn, búdébuò zàntīshí dàn chūy娱lèquān.
examples.english: That film star had to temporarily withdraw from the entertainment industry due to persistent rumors and scandals.

examples.chinese: 这些古老的手工技艺虽然在现代社会里用处不大，但它们承载着我们的文化记忆。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē gǔlǎo de shǒugōng jìyì suīrán zài xiàndài shèhuì lǐ yòngchu búdà, dàn tāmen chéngzàizhe wǒmen de wénhuà jìyì.
examples.english: Although these ancient handicraft techniques have limited practical use in modern society, they carry our cultural memories.

examples.chinese: 公司已经制定了详细的应急预案，以便在发生突发事件时能够迅速做出反应。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yǐjīng zhìdìngle xiáng細de yìngjí yùàn, yǐbiàn zài fāshēng túfā shìjiàn shí nénggoù xùnsù zuòchū fǎnyìng.
examples.english: The company has already formulated a detailed emergency response plan so that it can react quickly when unexpected incidents occur.

examples.chinese: 这个词汇的用法在现代汉语中已经逐渐消失了，只有在古籍中才能找到。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cíhuì de yòngfǎ zài xiàndài hànyǔ zhōng yǐjīng zhújiàn xiāoshīle, zhǐyǒu zài gǔjí zhōng cái néng zhǎodào.
examples.english: The usage of this word has gradually disappeared in modern Chinese and can only be found in ancient texts.

examples.chinese: 在这个项目中，你的编程经验肯定用得着，我们需要你的帮助。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège xiàngmù zhōng, nǐ de biānchéng jīngyàn kěndìng yòngdezháo, wǒmen xūyào nǐ de bāngzhù.
examples.english: In this project, your programming experience will definitely be useful; we need your help.

examples.chinese: 面对这些突然的市场变化，公司需要制定一套完整的战略来应对。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì zhèxiē túrán de shìchǎng biànhuà, gōngsī xūyào zhìdìng yī tào wánzhěng de zhànlüè lái yìngduì.
examples.english: Faced with these sudden market changes, the company needs to develop a comprehensive strategy to respond to them.

examples.chinese: 老师用心教学多年，她的学生在各种竞赛中都取得了优异的成绩。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yòngxīn jiàoxué duō nián, tā de xuésheng zài gèzhǒng jìngsài zhōng dōu qǔdéle yōuyì de chéngjī.
examples.english: The teacher has been diligent in her teaching for many years, and her students have achieved excellent results in various competitions.

examples.chinese: 这家公司之所以能在市场上脱颖而出，主要得益于其对优质产品的执着追求。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhī suǒyǐ néng zài shìchǎng shang tuōyǐngérchū, zhǔyào déyìyú qì duì yōuzhì chǎnpǐn de zhízháo zhuīqiú.
examples.english: The reason this company stands out in the market is mainly due to its relentless pursuit of excellent quality products.

examples.chinese: 这家超市的日用品质量很好，价格也比较便宜，所以吸引了很多顾客。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì de rìyòngpǐn zhìliàng hěn hǎo, jiàgé yě bǐjiào piányi, suǒyǐ xīyǐnle hěnduō gùkè.
examples.english: This supermarket has good quality daily necessities at relatively affordable prices, which attracts many customers.

examples.chinese: 周末我和朋友们计划去郊外游玩，希望能远离城市的喧嚣，放松一下紧张的工作压力。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ hé péngyoumen jìhuà qù jiāowài yóuwán, xīwàng néng yuǎnlí chéngshì de xuānxiao, fàngsōng yīxià jǐnzhāng de gōngzuò yālì.
examples.english: This weekend, my friends and I plan to go play in the countryside, hoping to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and relieve the stress from work.

examples.chinese: 夏日里，西湖边聚集了来自世界各地的游人，他们在湖畔漫步，享受着江南的宁静美景。
examples.pinyin: Xiàrì lǐ, Xīhú biān jùjíle lái zì shìjiè gè dì de yóurén, tāmen zài húpàn mànbù, xiǎngshòuze jiāngnán de níng jìng měijǐng.
examples.english: On summer days, tourists from all over the world gather by West Lake, strolling along the lakeside and enjoying the quiet beauty of the Jiangnan region.

examples.chinese: 他沉迷于游戏机已经影响了他的学业和社交生活，家人们都很担心。
examples.pinyin: Tā chénmí yú yóuxìjī yǐjīng yǐngxiǎngle tā de xuéyè hé shèjiāo shēnghuó, jiārénmen dōu hěn dānxīn.
examples.english: He has become so addicted to video games that it has already affected his studies and social life, and his family members are all very worried.

examples.chinese: 数千名示威者走上街头进行和平游行，要求政府采取行动应对气候变化。
examples.pinyin: Shǔ qiān míng shìwēi zhě zǒu shàng jiē tou jìnxíng hépíng yóuxíng, yāoqiú zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔ xíngdòng yìngduì qìhòu biànhuà.
examples.english: Thousands of protesters took to the streets to hold a peaceful march, demanding that the government take action to address climate change.

examples.chinese: 这份报告有关于公司未来的发展战略，值得我们认真研究。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào yǒuguān yú gōngsī wèilái de fāzhǎn zhànlüè, zhíde wǒmen rènzhēn yánjiū.
examples.english: This report is related to the company's future development strategy and deserves our careful study.

examples.chinese: 你有没有考虑过辞职去追求自己真正想做的事情？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒuméiyǒu kǎolǜguò cízhí qù zhuīqiú zìjǐ zhēnzhèng xiǎng zuò de shìqing?
examples.english: Have you ever considered quitting your job to pursue what you really want to do?

examples.chinese: 他最近有事，无法按时参加会议，只能让助手代替他出席。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn yǒushì, wúfǎ ànshí cānjiā huìyì, zhǐnéng ràng zhùshǒu dàitì tā chūxí.
examples.english: He has been occupied recently and cannot attend the meeting on time, so he can only have his assistant attend on his behalf.

examples.chinese: 这项重要的决定终于在经过多次讨论后于昨天正式公布。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng zhònyào de juéding zhōngyú zài jīngguò duō cì tǎolùn hòu yú zuótiān zhèngshì gōngbù.
examples.english: This important decision was finally officially announced yesterday after multiple discussions.

examples.chinese: 随着社会发展，人们对娱乐的需求变得越来越多样化。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe shèhuì fāzhǎn, rénmen duì yúlè de xūqiú biànde yuèláiyuè duōyànghuà.
examples.english: As society develops, people's demand for entertainment becomes increasingly diverse.

examples.chinese: 这次出国旅行让我度过了一个非常愉快的假期，我甚至不想回家。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chūguó lǚxíng ràng wǒ dùguò le yī ge fēicháng yúkuài de jiàqī, wǒ shènzhì búxiǎng huíjiā.
examples.english: This trip abroad allowed me to spend a very pleasant vacation, and I even didn't want to go home.

examples.chinese: 这项改革与经济发展密切相关，需要政府与企业的共同努力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé yǔ jīngjì fāzhǎn mìqiè xiāngguān, xūyào zhèngfǔ yǔ qǐyè de gòngtóng nǔlì.
examples.english: This reform is closely related to economic development and requires joint efforts from both the government and enterprises.

examples.chinese: 那位宇航员在太空中进行了为期六个月的科学实验，为人类探索宇宙做出了重大贡献。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi yǔhángyuán zài tàikōng zhōng jìnxíngले le wèiqī liù ge yuè de kēxué shíyàn, wèi rénlèi tànsuǒ yǔzhòu zuòchūle le zhòngdà gòngxiàn.
examples.english: That astronaut conducted scientific experiments in space for six months, making significant contributions to humanity's exploration of the universe.

examples.chinese: 由于医生的日程很紧张，患者需要提前几周预约才能挂上号。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yīshēng de rìchéng hěn jǐnzhāng, huànzhě xūyào tíqián jǐ zhōu yùyuē cái néng guàshang hào.
examples.english: Because the doctor's schedule is very tight, patients need to make an appointment several weeks in advance to get a consultation slot.

examples.chinese: 这部电影成功的关键元素是它对人物心理的深刻描写。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng chénggōng de guānjiàn yuánsù shì tā duì rénwù xīnlǐ de shēnkè miáoxiě.
examples.english: The key element to this film's success is its profound portrayal of the characters' psychology.

examples.chinese: 园教授在这所大学任教已经有二十年了，他的研究成果在国际学术界享有很高的声誉。
examples.pinyin: Yuán jiàoshòu zài zhè suǒ dàxué rènjiāo yǐjīng yǒu èrshí nián le, tā de yánjiū chéngguǒ zài guójì xuéshù ji界 xiǎngyǒu hěn gāo de shēngyù.
examples.english: Professor Yuan has been teaching at this university for twenty years, and his research achievements enjoy high reputation in the international academic circle.

examples.chinese: 这份杂志的文学园地为许多年轻作家提供了发表作品的机会。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn zázhì de wénxué yuándì wéi xǔduō niánqīng zuòjiā tígōngle fābiǎo zuòpǐn de jīhuì.
examples.english: The literary section of this magazine has provided opportunities for many young writers to publish their works.

examples.chinese: 这个项目原本计划在去年完成，但由于资金不足而被迫延期。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yuánběn jìhuà zài qùnián wánchéng, dàn yóuyú zījīn búzú érbeì tuīyíng yánqī.
examples.english: This project was originally planned to be completed last year, but was forced to be postponed due to insufficient funding.

examples.chinese: 法院最终判决原告胜诉，被告需要赔偿所有的医疗费用。
examples.pinyin: Fǎyuàn zuìzhōng pànjué yuángào shèngsù, bèigào xūyào péicháng suǒyǒu de yīliào fèiyòng.
examples.english: The court ultimately ruled in favor of the complainant, and the defendant must compensate all medical expenses.

examples.chinese: 我知道自己犯了错误，希望你能原谅我这次的冒失行为。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào zìjǐ犯了cuòwù, xīwàng nǐ néng yuánliàng wǒ zhè cì de màoshī xíngwéi.
examples.english: I know I made a mistake, and I hope you can forgive me for my reckless behavior this time.

examples.chinese: 这支圆珠笔的笔芯已经用完了，我需要去文具店买一支新的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī yuánzhūbǐ de bǐxīn yǐjīng yòngwán le, wǒ xūyào qù wénnjù diàn mǎi yī zhī xīn de.
examples.english: The refill of this ballpoint pen has run out, and I need to go to the stationery store to buy a new one.

examples.chinese: 正是因为这个缘故，他才决定离开这家公司去寻找新的机会。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngshì yīnwèi zhège yuángù, tā cái juédìng líkāi zhè jiā gōngsī qù xúnzhǎo xīn de jīhuì.
examples.english: It was precisely for this reason that he decided to leave the company to seek new opportunities.

examples.chinese: 国际组织向灾区提供了大量的援助，帮助当地人民渡过难关。
examples.pinyin: Guójì zǔzhī xiàng zāiqū tígōngle dàliàng de yuánzhù, bāngzhù dāngdì rénmín dùguò nánguān.
examples.english: International organizations provided substantial support to the disaster-stricken area, helping local people overcome the crisis.

examples.chinese: 这个城市的发展速度远远超过了我们的预期。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de fāzhǎn sùdù yuǎnyuǎn chāoguòle wǒmen de yùqī.
examples.english: The development speed of this city far exceeded our expectations.

examples.chinese: 为了保护孩子的身心健康，父母应该帮助他们远离不良的网络环境。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù háizi de shēnxīn jiànkāng, fùmǔ yīnggāi bāngzhù tāmen yuǎnlí búliáng de wǎngluò huanjìng.
examples.english: In order to protect children's physical and mental health, parents should help them stay far away from unhealthy online environments.

examples.chinese: 他辞掉了工作，决定去远方追寻自己真正想要的生活。
examples.pinyin: Tā cídiào le gōngzuò, juédìng qù yuǎnfāng zhuīxún zìjǐ zhēnzhèng xiǎngyào de shēnghuó.
examples.english: He quit his job and decided to go to distant places to pursue the life he truly wanted.

examples.chinese: 经理听了这个复杂的财务报告后，有点晕了，需要休息一会儿才能理解。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ tīngle zhège fùzá de càiwù bàogào hòu, yǒudiǎn yūnle, xūyào xiūxi yīhuǐr cái néng lǐjiě.
examples.english: After listening to this complicated financial report, the manager felt confused and needed to rest for a while before understanding it.

examples.chinese: 我们早就约定好了，如果有一方违反这个承诺，就要承担相应的法律责任。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zǎo jiù yuēdìng hǎo le, rúguǒ yǒu yī fāng wéifǎn zhège chéngnuò, jiù yào chéngdān xiāngyìng de fǎlǜ zérèn.
examples.english: We agreed upon this long ago, and if either party violates this commitment, they must assume the corresponding legal responsibility.

examples.chinese: 这个新的管理系统运作了三个月后，公司的效率明显提高了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīn de guǎnlǐ xìtǒng yùnzuò le sān ge yuè hòu, gōngsī de xiàolǜ míngxiǎn tígāo le.
examples.english: After the new management system had been operating for three months, the company's efficiency improved noticeably.

examples.chinese: 这位作曲家创作的乐曲融合了传统民族音乐和现代交响乐的元素，获得了国际音乐奖的认可。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòqǔjiā chuàngzuò de yuèqǔ rónghé le chuántǒng mínzú yīnyuè hé xiàndài jiāoxiǎng yuèqǔ de yuánsù, huòdé le guójì yīnyuè jiǎng de rènkě.
examples.english: The musical compositions created by this composer blend elements of traditional folk music and modern symphonic music, earning recognition from international music awards.

examples.chinese: 公司允许员工在家远程工作，但需要提前获得部门主管的批准。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yǔnxǔ yuángōng zài jiā yuǎnchéng gōngzuò, dàn xūyào tíqián huòdé bùmén zhǔguǎn de pízhǔn.
examples.english: The company permits employees to work remotely from home, but they need to obtain approval from their department supervisor in advance.

examples.chinese: 长途旅行中，他因为晕车而无法专注工作，只好闭眼休息了几个小时。
examples.pinyin: Chánggtú lǚxíng zhōng, tā yīnwèi yùnchē ér wúfǎ zhuānzhù gōngzuò, zhǐhǎo bìyǎn xiūxi le jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: During the long journey, he was unable to focus on work because of carsickness, so he had no choice but to rest with his eyes closed for a few hours.

examples.chinese: 这个城市的文化非常杂，融合了东西方的各种元素。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de wénhuà fēicháng zá, rónghéle dōngxīfāng de gèzhǒng yuánsù.
examples.english: The culture of this city is very mixed, blending various elements from both the East and West.

examples.chinese: 经过这次失败的打击，他决定放下过去，重新开始，就像凤凰涅槃一样再生。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì shībài de dǎjī, tā juédìng fàngxià guòqù, chóngxīn kāishǐ, jiùxiàng fènghuáng nièpán yīyàng zàishēng.
examples.english: After the blow of this failure, he decided to let go of the past and start anew, being reborn like a phoenix rising from the ashes.

examples.chinese: 这个项目现在还没有足够的资金支持，再说我们也没有相关的技术经验，所以暂时不能开始。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù xiànzài háishi méiyǒu zúgòu de zījīn zhīchí, zàishuō wǒmen yě méiyǒu xiāngguān de jìshù jīngyàn, suǒyǐ zànshíjiān búnéng kāishǐ.
examples.english: This project currently lacks sufficient funding support; furthermore, we don't have relevant technical experience either, so we can't start it for now.

examples.chinese: 这家公司因为产品质量问题遭到了消费者的强烈投诉和批评。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yīnwèi chǎnpǐn zhìliàng wèntí zāodào le xiāofèizhě de qiángliè tóusu hé pípíng.
examples.english: This company faced strong complaints and criticism from consumers due to product quality issues.

examples.chinese: 这个地区在过去几十年里遭受了严重的环境污染，导致许多居民患上了呼吸道疾病。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū zài guòqù jǐ shí nián lǐ zāoshòule yánzhòng de huanjìng wūrǎn, dǎozhì xǔduō jūmín huànshàngle hūxīdào jíbìng.
examples.english: This region has suffered severe environmental pollution over the past few decades, resulting in many residents developing respiratory diseases.

examples.chinese: 在创业的过程中，他遭遇了许多意想不到的困难，但最终还是成功地实现了自己的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Zài chuàngyè de guòchéng zhōng, tā zāoyù le xǔduō yìxiǎng búdào de kùnnan, dàn zuìzhōng háishi chénggōngle de shíxiàn le zìjǐ de梦想。
examples.english: During the process of starting a business, he encountered many unexpected difficulties, but ultimately still successfully realized his dream.

examples.chinese: 他早晚都要面对这个现实，与其逃避不如主动接受。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǎowǎn dōu yào miànduì zhège xiànshí, yǔqī táohuì búrú zhǔdòng jiēshòu.
examples.english: He will have to face this reality sooner or later, so it's better to accept it proactively rather than escape from it.

examples.chinese: 这次文化交流活动有助于增进两国人民之间的相互了解。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì wénhuà jiāoliú huódòng yǒuzhù yú zēngjìn liǎng guó rénmín zhījiān de xiānghu liǎojiě.
examples.english: This cultural exchange activity helps enhance mutual understanding between the people of the two countries.

examples.chinese: 他用绳子扎紧了行李箱，确保在运输过程中不会散开。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng shéngzi zhājǐnle xínglǐ xiāng, quèbǎo zài yùnshū guòchéng zhōng búhuì sǎnkāi.
examples.english: He tied the luggage tightly with a rope to ensure it wouldn't come apart during transportation.

examples.chinese: 随着城市发展，这片房产的增值潜力非常巨大。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe chéngshì fāzhǎn, zhè piàn fángchǎn de zēngzhí qiánlì fēicháng jùdà.
examples.english: As the city develops, the appreciation potential of this real estate is enormous.

examples.chinese: 恐怖分子被指控在地铁站放置了炸弹，幸好被及时发现并拆除了。
examples.pinyin: kǒngbù fènzǐ bèi zhǐkòng zài dìtiězhàn fàngzhì le zhàdàn, xìnghǎo bèi jíshí fāxiàn bìng chāichúle.
examples.english: The terrorist was accused of planting a bomb at the subway station, but fortunately it was discovered and dismantled in time.

examples.chinese: 他在这个领域有扎实的理论基础，所以他的研究成果得到了业界的认可。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zhège lǐngyù yǒu zhāshi de lǐlùn jīchǔ, suǒyǐ tā de yánjiū chéngguǒ dé到le yèjiè de rènkě.
examples.english: He has a strong theoretical foundation in this field, so his research results have been recognized by the industry.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的炸鱼做得很地道，吸引了很多食客前来品尝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de zhá yú zuò de hěn dìdào, xīyǐnle hěnduō shíkè qiánlái pǐncháng.
examples.english: The fried fish at this restaurant is very authentic, attracting many diners to come and taste it.

examples.chinese: 公司为了扩展业务而积累了大量债务，现在需要制定一个详细的还债计划。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī wèile kuòzhǎn yèwù ér jīlěile dàliàng zhàiwù, xiànzài xūyào zhìdìng yīge xiáng細de háizhài jìhuà.
examples.english: The company accumulated a large amount of debt in order to expand its business, and now needs to formulate a detailed debt repayment plan.

examples.chinese: 警方在废弃的地下室里发现了大量炸药，随后立即疏散了周围的居民。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zài fèiqì de dìxiàshì lǐ fāxiànle dàliàng zhàyào, suíhòu lìjí shūsǎnle zhōu围de jūmín.
examples.english: The police discovered a large amount of explosives in an abandoned basement and immediately evacuated the nearby residents.

examples.chinese: 随着城市的快速发展，高楼大厦占据了越来越多的农田。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe chéngshì de kuàisù fāzhǎn, gāolóu dàshà zhànjù le yuèláiyuè duō de nóngtián.
examples.english: With the rapid development of the city, skyscrapers have occupied more and more farmland.

examples.chinese: 历史上许多伟大的战役都改变了战场的格局，最终决定了国家的命运。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ shang xǔduō wěidà de zhànyì dōu gǎibiàn le zhànchǎng de géjú, zuìzh终 juéding le guójiā de mìngyùn.
examples.english: Throughout history, many great battles have changed the dynamics of the battlefield, ultimately determining the fate of nations.

examples.chinese: 教练在中场休息时调整了球队的防守战术，这个改变最终帮助我们赢得了比赛。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoliàn zài zhōngchǎng xiūxi shí tiáozhěngle qiúduì de fángshǒu zhànshù, zhège gǎibiàn zuìzhōng bāngzhù wǒmen yíngdéle bǐsài.
examples.english: The coach adjusted the team's defensive tactics during halftime, and this change ultimately helped us win the match.

examples.chinese: 公司需要制定一个长期的战略来应对市场的激烈竞争。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xūyào zhìdìng yīgè chángqī de zhànlüè lái yìngduì shìchǎng de jīliè jìngjìng.
examples.english: The company needs to formulate a long-term strategy to cope with fierce market competition.

examples.chinese: 那些曾经并肩作战的战友们,如今已经散落在世界各地,但我们之间的友谊却从未淡去。
examples.pinyin: Nàxiē cénjīng bìngjiān zuòzhàn de zhànyǒu men, rújīn yǐjīng sǎnluò zài shìjiè gèdì, dàn wǒmen zhījiān de yǒuyì què cóngwèi dànqù.
examples.english: Those comrades-in-arms who once fought side by side have now scattered across the world, but the friendship between us has never faded.

examples.chinese: 这部小说分为十章，每章都讲述了主人公不同时期的经历。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō fēnwéi shí zhāng, měi zhāng dōu jiǎngshù le zhǔrénggōng bùtóng shíqī de jīnglì.
examples.english: This novel is divided into ten chapters, with each chapter narrating the protagonist's experiences in different periods of time.

examples.chinese: 由于列车晚点，乘客们在站台上焦急地等待了将近一个小时。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú lièchē wǎndiǎn, chéngkè men zài zhàntái shang jiāojí de děngdài le jiāng jìn yī ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Due to the train's delay, passengers waited anxiously on the platform for nearly an hour.

examples.chinese: 当演员谢幕时，观众席中爆发出雷鸣般的掌声，这是对他精彩表演最好的认可。
examples.pinyin: Dāng yǎnyuán xièmù shí, guānzhòng xí zhōng bàofā chū léimíng bān de zhǎngshēng, zhè shì duì tā jīngcǎi biǎoyǎn zuì hǎo de rènkě.
examples.english: When the actor took his curtain call, thunderous applause erupted from the audience, which was the best acknowledgment of his brilliant performance.

examples.chinese: 这条河流的历史源远流长，见证了整个文明的发展过程。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo héliú de lìshǐ yuányuǎn liúcháng, jiànzhèng le zhěngge wénmíng de fāzhǎn guòchéng.
examples.english: This river has a long history stretching back to ancient times, witnessing the entire development of civilization.

examples.chinese: 公司财务部门每个月都要仔细核对账目，确保没有任何错误或漏洞。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī cáiwù bùmén měi ge yuè dōu yào zǐxì héduì zhànglùn, quèbǎo méiyǒu rènhé cuòwù huò lòudòng.
examples.english: The company's finance department has to carefully verify the accounts every month to ensure there are no errors or discrepancies.

examples.chinese: 由于安全考虑，我决定将大部分资金转移到一个新的账户中。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú ānquán kǎolǜ, wǒ juédìng jiāng dàbùfen zījīn zhuǎnyí dào yīgè xīn de zhànghù zhōng.
examples.english: For security reasons, I decided to transfer most of my funds to a new bank account.

examples.chinese: 由于原油价格上涨，许多航空公司不得不提高机票价格。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yuányóu jiàgé shàngzhǎng, xǔduō hángkōng gōngsī búdébu tígāo jīpiào jiàgé.
examples.english: Due to the rise in crude oil prices, many airlines had to increase ticket fares.

examples.chinese: 这家餐厅的新菜式很受欢迎，招来了很多顾客。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cānting de xīn càishì hěn shòu huānyíng, zhāo lái le hěn duō gùkè.
examples.english: The new dishes at this restaurant are very popular and have attracted many customers.

examples.chinese: 尽管遇到了许多障碍，他仍然坚定地追求自己的梦想，从未感到过真正的挫折和沮丧。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yùdàole xǔduō zhàngài, tā réngránjiǔdìng de zhuīqiú zìjǐ de mengxǐang, cóngwèi gǎndàoguò zhēnzhèng de cuòzhé hé jǔsàng.
examples.english: Despite encountering many obstacles, he still pursued his dreams with determination and never felt true discouragement or dejection.

examples.chinese: 尽管公司经历了经济危机，员工们照样坚守岗位，继续为公司的发展贡献力量。
examples.pinyin: Jìnguǎn gōngsī jīnglìle jīngjì wēijī, yuángōngmen zhàoyàng jiānshǒu gǎngwèi, jìxù wèi gōngsī de fāzhǎn gòngxiàn lìliàng.
examples.english: Despite the company experiencing an economic crisis, the employees still stuck to their posts and continued to contribute to the company's development.

examples.chinese: 晨曦照耀着整个城市，人们开始了新一天的工作。
examples.pinyin: chénxī zhàoyào zhe zhěngge chéngshì, rénmen kāishǐ le xīn yī tiān de gōngzuò.
examples.english: The morning light shines upon the entire city, and people begin their work for a new day.

english: to invite applications for a job

examples.chinese: 这家科技公司最近在全国范围内招聘高级工程师，薪资待遇相当优厚。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kējì gōngsī zuìjìn zài quánguó fànwéi nèi zhāopìn gāojí gōngchéngshī, xīnzī dàiyù xiāngdāng yōuhòu.
examples.english: This technology company has recently been recruiting senior engineers nationwide, with quite attractive salary and benefits.

examples.chinese: 这位思想家的哲学思想对现代社会产生了深远的影响。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi sīxiǎngjiā de zhéxué sīxiǎng duì xiàndài shèhuì chǎnshēngle shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: This thinker's philosophical ideas have had a profound impact on modern society.

examples.chinese: 他虽然表面上同意了这个计划，但他的沉默态度这就是说他内心仍然有顾虑。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán biǎomiàn shang同意le zhège jìhuà, dàn tāde chénmò tàidù zhèjiùshìshuō tā nèixīn réngránnyǒu gùlǜ.
examples.english: Although he agreed to the plan on the surface, his silent attitude this means that he still has reservations in his heart.

examples.chinese: 这个小镇虽然偏远，但保留了很多传统的建筑风格，吸引了不少游客前来参观。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎozhèn suīrán piānyuǎn, dàn bǎoliúle hěnduō chuántǒng de jiànzhù fēngggé, xīyǐnle búshǎo yóukè qiánlái cānguān.
examples.english: Although this small town is remote, it has preserved many traditional architectural styles, attracting quite a few tourists to visit.

examples.chinese: 几家大公司正在争夺这个市场的主导权，竞争变得越来越激烈。
examples.pinyin: Jǐ jiā dà gōngsī zhèngzài zhēngduó zhège shìchǎng de zhǔdǎoquán, jìngjìng biàn de yuèláiyuè jīliè.
examples.english: Several large companies are fighting over dominance in this market, and the competition is becoming increasingly fierce.

examples.chinese: 公司决定对销售部门进行全面整顿，以改善工作效率和员工士气。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng duì xiāoshòu bùmén jìnxíng quánmiàn zhěngdùn, yǐ gǎish善 gōngzuò xiàolǜ hé yuángōng shìqì.
examples.english: The company decided to comprehensively rectify the sales department in order to improve work efficiency and employee morale.

examples.chinese: 在这种情况下，员工要求加薪是完全正当的。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng xià, yuángōng yāoqiú jiāxīn shì wánquán zhèngdāng de.
examples.english: In this situation, it is completely proper for employees to request a salary increase.

examples.chinese: 政府投入了大量资金来整治这条污染严重的河流。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ tóuruò le dàliàng zījīn lái zhěngzhì zhè tiáo wūrǎn yánzhòng de héliú.
examples.english: The government invested substantial funds to renovate this heavily polluted river.

examples.chinese: 政府最近出台的新政策引发了社会各界的广泛讨论。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuìjìn chūtái de xīn zhèngcè yǐnfāle shèhuì gèjiè de guǎngfàn tǎolùn.
examples.english: The new policy recently introduced by the government has sparked widespread discussion across all sectors of society.

examples.chinese: 这个国家的政权经历了多次更替，每一次都伴随着社会的巨大变革。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā de zhèngquán jīng历le duō cì gēngtì, měi yī cì dōu bànyùzhe shèhuì de jùdà biànggé.
examples.english: The political power of this country has undergone multiple transitions, each accompanied by major social changes.

examples.chinese: 患者最近出现了一些奇怪的症状，医生建议进行进一步的检查。
examples.pinyin: Huànzhě zuìjìn chūxiànle yīxiē qíguài de zhèngzhuàng, yīshēng jiànyì jìnxíng jìnyībù de jiǎnchá.
examples.english: The patient has recently developed some unusual symptoms, and the doctor recommends further examination.

examples.chinese: 这个国家的两个主要政党在经济政策上存在着根本分歧。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā de liǎng ge zhǔyào zhèngdǎng zài jīngjì zhèngcè shang cúnzàizhe gēnběn fēnqī.
examples.english: The two major political parties in this country have fundamental disagreements on economic policy.

examples.chinese: 他对艺术、文学、音乐之类的东西都很感兴趣，经常去美术馆和音乐会。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì yìshù, wénxué, yīnyuè zhīlèi de dōngxi dōu hěn gǎnxìngqù, jīngcháng qù měishùguǎn hé yīnyuèhuì.
examples.english: He is interested in things like art, literature, and music, and often goes to art galleries and concerts.

examples.chinese: 政府承诺为灾区提供长期的经济支援，帮助当地重建家园。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ chéngnuò wèi zāiqū tígōng cháng期de jīngjì zhīyuán, bāngzhù dāngdì chóngjiàn jiāyuán.
examples.english: The government promised to provide long-term financial support to the disaster area to help locals rebuild their homes.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的成功主要是由几位资深专家的专业知识支撑起来的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de chénggōng zhǔyào shì yóu jǐ wèi zīshēn zhuānjiā de zhuānyè zhīshi zhīchēng qǐlái de.
examples.english: The success of this project is mainly supported by the professional knowledge of several senior experts.

examples.chinese: 这位知名的建筑师设计了许多获得国际奖项的作品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhīmíng de jiànzhúshī shèjìle xǔduō huòdé guójì jiǎngxiàng de zuòpǐn.
examples.english: This renowned architect has designed many works that have won international awards.

examples.chinese: 这位手工艺人用传统技艺织出了精美的丝绸图案。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi shǒugōngyìrén yòng chuántǒng jìyì zhī chūle jīngměi de sīchóu túàn.
examples.english: This craftsperson wove exquisite silk patterns using traditional techniques.

examples.chinese: 这棵老树的每一枝都承载着几代人的回忆。
examples.pinyin: Zhè k棵 lǎo shù de měi yī zhī dōu chéngzài zhe jǐ dàirén de huíyì.
examples.english: Every branch of this old tree carries the memories of several generations.

examples.chinese: 救援队派出了几架直升机来搜救被困在山区的登山者。
examples.pinyin: Jiùyuán duì pāichūle jǐ jià zhíshēngjī lái sōujiù bèi kùnzài shānqū de dēngshānzhě.
examples.english: The rescue team dispatched several helicopters to search for and rescue the climbers stranded in the mountainous area.

examples.chinese: 作为经理，他必须明确自己的职责，并确保团队成员也了解各自的职责范围。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi jīnglǐ, tā bìxū míngquè zìjǐ de zhízé, bìng quèbǎo tuánduì chéngyuán yě liǎojiě gèzì de zhízé fànwéi.
examples.english: As a manager, he must clarify his own duties and ensure that team members also understand their respective areas of responsibility.

examples.chinese: 他虽然身处困境，但始终保持着沉着的止，让人敬佩。
examples.pinyin: Tā suīrán shēnchǔ kùnjìng, dàn shǐzhōng bǎochízhe chénzháo de zhǐ, ràng rén jìngpèi.
examples.english: Although he was in a difficult situation, he always maintained a calm and composed demeanor, which was admirable.

examples.chinese: 由于航班被取消了，我们只得改变了旅行计划，决定自驾去目的地。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú hángbān bèi qǔxiāo le, wǒmen zhǐdé gǎibiàn le lǚxíng jìhuà, juédìng zìjià qù mùdìdì.
examples.english: Since the flight was cancelled, we had to change our travel plans and decided to drive ourselves to the destination.

examples.chinese: 他只顾着工作，完全忽视了家人的感受。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐgù zhe gōngzuò, wánquán hūshìle jiārén de gǎnshòu.
examples.english: He was solely preoccupied with work and completely neglected his family's feelings.

examples.chinese: 他只管埋头工作，对周围的事情一概不知。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐguǎn máitóu gōngzuò, duì zhōuweí de shìqing yībài búzhī.
examples.english: He was solely engrossed in his work and was completely unaware of what was happening around him.

examples.chinese: 随着疫情的控制，消费者信心指数逐月上升，经济复苏的迹象越来越明显。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe yìqíng de kòngzhì, xiāofèizhě xìnxin zhǐshù zhúyuè shàngshēng, jīngjì fùsuī de jìxiàng yuèláiyuè míngxiǎn.
examples.english: As the epidemic came under control, the consumer confidence index rose month by month, with increasingly clear signs of economic recovery.

examples.chinese: 公司指定了三名员工负责这个重要项目的后期维护工作。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī zhǐdìngle sān míng yuángōng fùzé zhège zhònyào xiàngmù de hòuqī wéihù gōngzuò.
examples.english: The company earmarked three employees to be responsible for the post-maintenance work of this important project.

examples.chinese: 他用指头指了指远处的那座山，说那就是他童年的记忆所在。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng zhǐtou zhǐle zhǐ yuǎnchù de nàzuò shān, shuō nàjiùshì tā tóngniánde jìyì suǒzài.
examples.english: He pointed with his finger at the distant mountain and said that was where his childhood memories lay.

examples.chinese: 他指着窗外的那栋建筑，解释说那就是他们公司的新总部。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǐzhe chuāngwài de nà duò jiànzhù, jiěshì shuō nà jiùshì tāmen gōngsī de xīn zǒngbù.
examples.english: He pointed at the building outside the window and explained that it was their company's new headquarters.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的进展情况还不错，至于预算超支的问题，我们可以在下次会议上详细讨论。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de jìnzhǎn qíngkuàng háishi búcuò, zhìyú yùsuàn chāozhī de wèntí, wǒmen kěyǐ zài xiàcì huìyì shang xiáng细 tǎolùn.
examples.english: The progress of this project is quite good; as for the issue of budget overrun, we can discuss it in detail at the next meeting.

examples.chinese: 这位老教授用他多年积累的智慧，为年轻学者指点了一条研究的新方向。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo jiàoshòu yòng tā duō nián jīlěi de zhìhuì, wèi niánqīng xuézhě zhǐdiǎnle yī tiáo yánjiū de xīn fāngxiàng.
examples.english: This elderly professor used the wisdom accumulated over many years to point young scholars in a new research direction.

examples.chinese: 中医强调预防重于治病，通过调理身体来避免疾病的发生。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngyī qiángdiào yùfáng zhòngyú zhìbìng, tōngguò tiáolǐ shēntǐ lái bìmiǎn jíbìng de fāshēng.
examples.english: Chinese medicine emphasizes that prevention is more important than treating illness, and that diseases can be avoided by regulating the body.

examples.chinese: 作为中华民族的一份子，我们有责任传承优秀的文化传统。
examples.pinyin: Zuòwéi Zhōnghuá mínzú de yī fèn zi, wǒmen yǒu zérèn chuánchéng yōuxiù de wénhuà chuántǒng.
examples.english: As members of the Chinese nation, we have the responsibility to inherit and pass down excellent cultural traditions.

examples.chinese: 这所大学虽然不是顶尖学府，但在中等水平的大学里算是相当不错的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué suīrán búshì dǐngjiān xuéfǔ, dàn zài zhōngděng shuǐpíng de dàxué lǐ suànshi xiāngdāng búcuò de.
examples.english: Although this university is not a top-tier institution, it is considered quite excellent among medium-level universities.

examples.chinese: 这部电影在中外都获得了广泛的认可和好评。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng zài zhōngwài dōu huòdéle guǎngfàn de rènkě hé hǎopíng.
examples.english: This film has received widespread recognition and praise both in China and abroad.

examples.chinese: 这个项目在中期遇到了一些资金困难，但团队坚持了下来。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù zài zhōngqī yùdàole yīxiē zījīn kùnnan, dàn tuánduì jiānchíle xiàlái.
examples.english: The project encountered some funding difficulties in the middle stage, but the team persevered.

examples.chinese: 他多年来始终以忠心和责任感对待这份工作，赢得了所有同事的尊重。
examples.pinyin: Tā duō nián lái shǐzhōng yǐ zhōngxīn hé zérèn感duì dài zhè fèn gōngzuò, yíngdé le suǒyǒu tóngshì de zūnjìng.
examples.english: He has always treated this job with good faith and a sense of responsibility over the years, earning the respect of all his colleagues.

examples.chinese: 他的脚踝肿得很厉害，医生建议他休息几天。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jiǎo huái zhǒng de hěn lìhai, yīshēng jiànyì tā xiūxi jǐ tiān.
examples.english: His ankle swelled up quite badly, and the doctor recommended he rest for a few days.

examples.chinese: 这个项目已经延期了三个钟头，我们必须尽快找到解决方案。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù yǐjīng yánqī le sān ge zhōngtóu, wǒmen bìxū jǐnkuài zhǎodào jiějué fāng'àn.
examples.english: This project has already been delayed for three hours, and we must find a solution as soon as possible.

examples.chinese: 面对种种困难和挑战，我们必须保持坚定的信念和清醒的头脑。
examples.pinyin: Miànduì zhǒngzhǒng kùnnan hé tiǎozhàn, wǒmen bìxū bǎochí jiāndìng de xìnniàn hé qīngxǐng de tóunǎo.
examples.english: Faced with all kinds of difficulties and challenges, we must maintain firm conviction and a clear mind.

examples.chinese: 诸位领导，感谢你们今天抽出宝贵的时间参加我们的产品发布会。
examples.pinyin: Zhūwèi lǐngdǎo, gǎnxiè nǐmen jīntiān chōuchū báoguì de shíjiān cānjiā wǒmen de chǎnpǐn fā布huì.
examples.english: Distinguished leaders, thank you all for taking your precious time to attend our product launch conference today.

examples.chinese: 这位资深的电视主持人凭借其独特的风格和专业素养赢得了广大观众的信任。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zīshēn de diànshì zhǔchírén píngjiè qī dúté de fēnggé hé zhuānyè sùyǎng yíngdéle guǎngdà guānzhòng de xìnrèn.
examples.english: This seasoned television anchor has won the trust of a wide audience through his unique style and professional qualities.

examples.chinese: 每个周末早上，我都喜欢在家里煮一碗热粥，配上咸菜和榨菜。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge zhōumò zǎoshang, wǒ dōu xǐhuai zài jiāli zhǔ yi wǎn re zhōu, pèishang xiáncài he zhàcài.
examples.english: Every weekend morning, I like to cook a bowl of hot congee at home, served with pickled vegetables and preserved vegetables.

examples.chinese: 这部电影的主角虽然是个新人演员，但他的表演获得了电影节的最佳男演员奖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de zhǔjué suīrán shì ge xīnrén yǎnyuán, dàn tā de biǎoyǎn huòdéle diànyǐngjié de zuìjiā nán yǎnyuán jiǎng.
examples.english: Although the leading role in this film is a newcomer actor, his performance won the Best Actor award at the film festival.

examples.chinese: 她用砂锅慢慢地煮了一整夜的中药，房间里弥漫着苦涩的药香。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng shāguō màn man de zhǔle yī zhěngyè de zhōngyào, fángjiān lǐ míyǎn zhe kǔsè de yàoxiāng.
examples.english: She slowly boiled Chinese herbal medicine in a clay pot all night, and the room was filled with a bitter medicinal aroma.

examples.chinese: 虽然这部电影在艺术上很创新，但它从未成为主流，只吸引了一小部分电影爱好者。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán zhè bù diànyǐng zài yìshù shang hěn chuàngxīn, dàn tā cóngwèi chéngwéi zhǔliú, zhǐ xīyǐnle yì xiǎo bùfen diànyǐng àihàozhě.
examples.english: Although this film is very innovative artistically, it never became mainstream and only attracted a small group of film enthusiasts.

examples.chinese: 这个城市的住宅价格在过去十年里翻了三倍，许多年轻人已经买不起房子了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de zhùzhái jiàgé zài guòqù shí nián lǐ fānle sān bèi, xǔduō niánqīng rén yǐjīng mǎi bu qǐ fángzi le.
examples.english: Housing prices in this city have tripled over the past decade, and many young people can no longer afford to buy homes.

examples.chinese: 大使馆驻扎在市中心的一个安全地带，周围配备了完善的安保措施。
examples.pinyin: Dàshǐguǎn zhùzhā zài shì zhōngxīn de yī ge ānquán dìdài, zhōuwéi pèibèile wánshàn de ānbǎo cuòshī.
examples.english: The embassy is stationed in a safe area in the city center, surrounded by comprehensive security measures.

examples.chinese: 这条高速公路有专用的应急车道，以便在紧急情况下使用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gāosù gōnglù yǒu zhuānyòng de yìngjí chēdào, yǐbiàn zài jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià shǐyòng.
examples.english: This highway has a dedicated emergency lane for use in urgent situations.

examples.chinese: 我衷心祝愿你在新的工作岗位上能够取得更大的成就。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ衷xīn zhùyuàn nǐ zài xīn de gōngzuò gǎngwèi shang néng gòu qǔdé gèngdà de chéngjiù.
examples.english: I sincerely wish that you can achieve greater accomplishments in your new job position.

examples.chinese: 工程师仔细观察着机器的每个部件，确保齿轮能够平稳地转动。
examples.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī zǐxì guānchá zhe jīqì de měi ge bùjiàn, quèbǎo chǐlún néng gòu píngwěn de zhuǎndòng.
examples.english: The engineer carefully observed every component of the machine to ensure that the gears could rotate smoothly.

examples.chinese: 这个项目的方向突然转向了国际市场，让很多员工措手不及。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù de fāngxiàng túrán zhuǎnxiàng le guójì shìchǎng, ràng hěnduō yuángōng cuòshǒu bújí.
examples.english: The direction of this project suddenly shifted toward the international market, catching many employees off guard.

examples.chinese: 与其冒着风险去赚钱，不如把更多的精力投入到自己真正热爱的事业中。
examples.pinyin: Yǔqī màozhe fēngxiǎn qù zhuàn qián, búrú bǎ gèngduō de jīnglì tóurù dào zìjǐ zhēnzhèng rè'ài de shìyè zhōng.
examples.english: Rather than taking risks to make money, it's better to devote more energy to the career you truly love.

examples.chinese: 站在山顶俯瞰整个城市的夜景，那壮观的景象让我久久不能忘怀。
examples.pinyin: Zhàn zài shānding fǔkàn zhěngge chéngshì de yèjǐng, nà zhuàngguān de jǐngxiàng ràng wǒ jiǔjiǔ búnéng wàngjì.
examples.english: Standing on the mountaintop overlooking the city's nightscape, that sublime view left a lasting impression on me.

examples.chinese: 他通过投资房地产赚了一笔可观的财富。
examples.pinyin: Tā tōngguò tóuzī fángdìchǎn zhuànle yī bǐ kěguān de cáifù.
examples.english: He made a considerable fortune through real estate investment.

examples.chinese: 公司决定对财务部门的违规行为进行彻底追究，确保每一笔账目都得到解释。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng duì cáiwù bùmén de wéiguī xíngwéi jìnxíng chèdǐ zhuījiū, quèbǎo měi yī bǐ zhàngnù dōu dé到dào jiěshì.
examples.english: The company decided to thoroughly investigate the irregular conduct of the finance department to ensure that every transaction was explained.

examples.chinese: 这支探险队配备了最先进的登山装备，才能成功征服这座险峰。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī tànxiǎn duì pèibèi le zuì xiānnjìn de dēngshān zhuāngbèi, cái néng chéngōng zhēngfú zhè zuò xiǎnfēng.
examples.english: Only by equipping themselves with the most advanced mountaineering equipment was this expedition team able to successfully conquer this treacherous peak.

examples.chinese: 许多发展中国家仍然面临自来水供应不足的问题，这严重影响了人民的生活质量。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō fāzhǎnzhōngguó jiā仍然 miànlín zìláishuǐ gōngyìng búzú de wèntí, zhè yánzhòng yǐngxiǎngle rénmín de shēnghuó zhìliàng.
examples.english: Many developing countries still face the problem of insufficient tap water supply, which seriously affects the quality of life of their people.

examples.chinese: 在做出重大投资决定之前，我决定咨询一位有经验的财务顾问。
examples.pinyin: Zài zuòchū zhòngdà tóuzī juéding zhīqián, wǒ juéding zīxún yī wèi yǒu jīngyàn de cáiwù g顾wèn.
examples.english: Before making a major investment decision, I decided to consult with an experienced financial advisor.

examples.chinese: 警察捉住了那个逃犯，他已经在逃亡三个月了。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhuōzhù le nàge táofàn, tā yǐjīng zài táowáng sān ge yuè le.
examples.english: The police caught the fugitive, who had been on the run for three months.

examples.chinese: 在这个充满竞争的社会中,保持自我认识和自我反思对个人的成长至关重要。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège ch充mǎn jìngjìng de shèhuì zhōng, báochíchi zìwǒ rènshi hé zìwǒ fǎnsī duì gèrén de chéngzhǎng zhìguānzhòngyào.
examples.english: In this competitive society, maintaining self-awareness and self-reflection is crucial for personal growth.

examples.chinese: 他通过自学编程，最后成功地开发了一款被数百万人使用的应用程序。
examples.pinyin: Tā tōngguò zìxué biānchéng, zuìhòu chénggōngle de kāifāle le yī ku�ǎn bèi shù bǎi wàn rén shǐyòng de yìngyòng chéngxù.
examples.english: Through self-study of programming, he ultimately successfully developed an application that is used by millions of people.

examples.chinese: 他在办公室里自言自语地反复推敲这份报告的措辞，生怕有任何疏漏。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài bàngōngshì lǐ zìyán-zìyǔ de fǎnfù tuīqiào zhè fèn bàogào de cuòcí, shēngpà yǒu rènhé shūlòu.
examples.english: He muttered to himself repeatedly in the office, carefully deliberating over the wording of the report, afraid of any oversight.

examples.chinese: 离开了城市的喧嚣，他在乡下生活得很自在，每天都能享受宁静的日子。
examples.pinyin: Líkāile chéngshì de xuānxiao, tā zài xiāngxia shēnghuó de hěn zìzai, měi tiān dōu néng xiǎngshòu níngjìng de rìzi.
examples.english: Having left the hustle and bustle of the city, he lived quite comfortably in the countryside, enjoying peaceful days every day.

examples.chinese: 在多元化的社会中，人们对宗教的态度变得越来越包容和理性。
examples.pinyin: Zài duōyuánhuà de shèhuì zhōng, rénmen duì zōngjiào de tàidù biàn de yuèláiyuè bāoróng hé lǐxìng.
examples.english: In a pluralistic society, people's attitudes toward theology have become increasingly tolerant and rational.

examples.chinese: 这家跨国公司的总部设在纽约，但他们在亚洲的业务发展得很快。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā kuàguó gōngsī de zǒngbù shè zài niǔyuē, dàn tāmen zài yàzhōu de yèwù fāzhǎn de hěn kuài.
examples.english: This multinational company's headquarters is located in New York, but their business development in Asia has been very rapid.

examples.chinese: 这位总经理凭借其卓越的领导能力，在短短五年内将公司的市场份额提高了三倍。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zǒngjīnglǐ píngjiè qí zhuóyuè de lǐngdǎo nénghuà, zài duǎnduǎn wǔ nián nèi jiāng gōngsī de shìchǎng fèn'é tíhuà le sān bèi.
examples.english: Through his outstanding leadership abilities, this CEO tripled the company's market share in just five years.

examples.chinese: 这位艺术总监凭借其独特的创意理念，将剧院的整体形象提升到了新的高度。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yìshù zǒngjiān píngjiè qī dúté de chuàngyì lǐniàn, jiāng jùyuàn de zhěngtǐ xíngxiàng tíshēng dào le xīn de gāodù.
examples.english: This artistic director, relying on his unique creative vision, elevated the theater's overall image to new heights.

examples.chinese: 去年我们公司的销售总量比前年增长了百分之三十。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián wǒmen gōngsī de xiāoshòu zǒngliàng bǐ qiánniánzēngzhǎngle bǎifēnzhī sānshí.
examples.english: Last year, our company's total sales volume increased by thirty percent compared to the previous year.

examples.chinese: 海关人员在港口查获了一批走私的名贵药材，这是近年来最大的一次缉私行动。
examples.pinyin: Hǎiguān rényuán zài gǎngkǒu cháj获le yībāi zǒusī de míngguì yàocái, zhè shì jìnnián lái zuìdà de yīcì jìsī xíngdòng.
examples.english: Customs officers seized a shipment of smuggled precious medicinal materials at the port, marking the largest anti-smuggling operation in recent years.

examples.chinese: 乐队奏起了激昂的交响曲，整个音乐厅都沉浸在宏伟的旋律中。
examples.pinyin: Yuèduì zòuqǐle jīangāng de jiāoxiǎngqū, zhěngge yīnyuètīng dōu chénjìnzài hóngwěi de xuánlǜ zhōng.
examples.english: The orchestra played a stirring symphony, and the entire concert hall was immersed in the grand melody.

examples.chinese: 由于市场需求旺盛，这栋商业楼的租金在过去两年里翻了一番。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú shìchǎng xūqiú wàngshèng, zhè dòng shāngyè lóu de zūjīn zài guòqù liǎng nián lǐ fānle yī fān.
examples.english: Due to strong market demand, the rent for this commercial building has doubled over the past two years.

examples.chinese: 他对现在的成就感到不足，仍然在努力追求更高的目标。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì xiànzài de chéngjiù gǎndào búzú,仍然 zài nǔlì zhuīqiú gèng gāo de mùbiāo.
examples.english: He felt dissatisfied with his current achievements and continued to strive for higher goals.

examples.chinese: 他在这个领域的成就足以证明他的专业能力。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zhège lǐngyù de chéngjìu zúyǐ zhèngmíng tā de zhuānyè nénghuà.
examples.english: His achievements in this field are sufficient to prove his professional competence.

examples.chinese: 我的祖父在战争年代失去了左臂，但这从未阻止他为家庭做出贡献。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zǔfù zài zhànzhēng niándài shīqù le zuǒ bì, dàn zhè cóngwèi zǔzhǐ tā wèi jiātíng zuòchū gòngxiàn.
examples.english: My grandfather lost his left arm during the war years, but this never prevented him from making contributions to the family.

examples.chinese: 这个少数民族地区的经济发展速度令人瞩目。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shǎoshù mínzú dìqū de jīngjì fāzhǎn sùdù lìngrén zhǔmù.
examples.english: The economic development speed of this ethnic minority region is remarkable.

examples.chinese: 无论身在何处，我们都应该为祖国的繁荣发展贡献自己的力量。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn shēn zài héchù, wǒmen dōu yīnggāi wèi zǔguó de繁荣 fāzhǎn gòngxiàn zìjǐ de lìliang.
examples.english: No matter where we are, we should all contribute our strength to the prosperity and development of our country.

examples.chinese: 我的祖母虽然已经过世多年，但她对我的影响依然深远。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zǔmǔ suīrán yǐjīng guòshì duō nián, dàn tā duì wǒ de yǐngxiǎng yīrán shēnyuǎn.
examples.english: Although my paternal grandmother passed away many years ago, her influence on me remains profound.

examples.chinese: 经过多年的努力和挫折，他最终实现了自己的梦想。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō nián de nǔlì hé cuòzhé, tā zuìzhōng shíxiàn le zìjǐ de梦想。
examples.english: After years of effort and setbacks, he finally realized his dream.

examples.chinese: 他因贪污腐败的罪行被判处终身监禁。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīn tānwū fǔbài de zuìxíng bèi pànchǔ zh終身 jiānyù.
examples.english: He was sentenced to life imprisonment for his crimes of corruption and bribery.

examples.chinese: 工人们用钻在岩石上打孔，为隧道工程做准备。
examples.pinyin: Gōngrénmen yòng zuān zài yánshí shang dǎ kǒng, wéi suìdào gōngchéng zuò zhǔnbèi.
examples.english: The workers used an auger to drill holes in the rocks in preparation for the tunnel project.

examples.chinese: 这部电影深刻揭露了战争的罪恶，让观众感到震撼。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng shēnkè jiēlù le zhànzhēng de zuìè, ràng guānzhòng gǎndào zhènhuàng.
examples.english: This film profoundly exposes the evils of war, leaving the audience shocked.

examples.chinese: 这部电影作为今年最受欢迎的作品，获得了多项国际奖项。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng zuòwéi jīnnián zuì shòu huānyíng de zuòpǐn, huòdéle duōxiàng guójì jiǎngxiàng.
examples.english: This film, as this year's most popular work, has won multiple international awards.

examples.chinese: 这部电影凭借其出色的叙事手法赢得了最佳影片奖。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng píngjiè qī chūsè de yùshì shǒufǎ yíngdéle zuìjiā yǐngpiàn jiǎng.
examples.english: This film won the Best Picture award thanks to its outstanding narrative technique.

examples.chinese: 由于新政策的出台，之前的合同条款全部作废了。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú xīn zhèngcè de chūtái, zhīqián de héttóng tiáokuǎn quánbù zuòfèi le.
examples.english: Due to the implementation of the new policy, all the previous contract clauses became invalid.

examples.chinese: 公司决定召开一次座谈会，邀请员工代表讨论工作环境的改善方案。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng zhàokāi yī cì zuòtánhuì, yāoqǐng yuángōng dàibiǎo tǎolùn gōngzuò huánjìng de gǎishàn fāng'àn.
examples.english: The company decided to hold a colloquium inviting employee representatives to discuss improvements to the working environment.

examples.chinese: 这支球队在季后赛中作战勇猛，最终赢得了总冠军。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhī qiúduì zài jìhòusài zhōng zuòzhàn yǒngměng, zuìzh终 yíngdéle zǒngguàngjūn.
examples.english: This team fought fiercely in the playoffs and ultimately won the championship.
